builds.title: Nezumi trail scout, Warrior 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2
traits: Leather armor. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 12. Base attack bonus +1. Face 5 by 5 ft., reach 5 ft. unless using the longspear.
Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will +0. Add +2 on saves against poison and disease.
Alertness is the chosen feat. Scent is an optional species feat and is not part of this build.
Cannot gain Shadowlands Taint from exposure. Cloud of Taint and special attacks from Shadowlands creatures can still harm Tesk.
actions: Longspear. Melee +2, 10-ft. reach only. Hit 1d8+1 piercing, critical ×3.
Claw or bite. Melee +2, 5-ft. reach. Hit 1d4+1 normal damage. One such unarmed attack per round.
Javelin. Ranged +2, 30-ft. range increment. Hit 1d6+1 piercing, critical ×2.
builds.tactics: Warns from cover first. Uses the spear to hold a narrow passage or the javelin to cover a retreat. Falls back if the party agrees to verify the route together.

builds.title: Vanara canopy guide, Expert 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2
traits: Leather armor. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 12. Base attack bonus +0. Face 5 by 5 ft., reach 5 ft.
Fortitude +1, Reflex +1, Will +2. Alertness is the chosen feat.
Climb uses Dexterity and can take 10 under pressure for a result of 23. Accelerated climb 30 ft. with one Climb check per round at +8 after the −5 penalty.
actions: Club. Melee −1, 5-ft. reach. Hit 1d6−1 bludgeoning, minimum 1, critical ×2.
Light crossbow. Ranged +1, 80-ft. range increment. Hit 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. Reload as a move-equivalent action.
builds.tactics: Stays near a climbable route, points out safe handholds, and keeps people moving. Uses a loaded crossbow from cover only if the group is forced to defend itself.

builds.title: Ice Caste Dromite locksmith, Expert 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 2.
traits: AC 18 includes leather armor +2, natural armor +3, Dexterity +2, and size +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 16. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fortitude +1, Reflex +2, Will +1.
Cold resistance 5 and bonus Blind-Fight. Skill Focus (Disable Device) adds +3. Ordinary thieves’ tools. The Expert can disable ordinary devices and search for tampering.
Scent 30 ft. normally, 60 ft. upwind or 15 ft. downwind. Move action to find direction and pinpoint within 5 ft. Strong or overpowering scents extend detection.
Naturally Psionic grants 1 bonus power point. Racial Energy Ray has its own use and consumes none of that point.
actions: Small dagger +0 melee, reach 5 ft., 1d3−1 piercing or slashing, minimum 1, critical 19–20/×2.
Small light crossbow +3 ranged, 80-ft. range increment, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. Reload as a move action.
Cold Energy Ray once per day. Standard action, +3 ranged touch at up to 25 ft., 1d6+1 cold, no save, power resistance applies, manifester level 1.
builds.tactics: Inspect the jammed floodgate before turning the lock. Ask the party to hold the upstream walkway. If interrupted, move behind the ratchet housing and use the crossbow from cover.

builds.title: Sharakim seed vault keeper, Wizard 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2.
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft.; Shadow Affinity in darkness or shadowy illumination
traits: Natural armor +1. Touch 10, flat-footed 11. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +0, Will +3.

In darkness or shadowy illumination, add +2 to Hide, Move Silently, Search, and Spot. Attacks suffer −1 in bright sunlight or inside daylight, and gain +1 against orcs and half-orcs. Apply both attack modifiers if both conditions hold.
Generalist Wizard at caster level 1. Scribe Scroll as a class feat, Skill Focus (Spellcraft) as the 1st-level feat. She has no summoned familiar. She carries a spell component pouch.

Prepared spells are three 0-level and two 1st-level spells, including one Intelligence bonus slot. Save DC 13 + spell level. Spellbook: Wizard cantrips and the 1st-level spells alarm, comprehend languages, endure elements, grease, magic missile, and unseen servant.
actions: Quarterstaff +1 melee using one end with two hands, 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Light crossbow +0 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment.

Prepared cantrips: detect magic, mage hand, ray of frost. Ray of Frost +0 ranged touch within 25 ft., 1d3 cold, no save and spell resistance applies. The lighting and target modifiers apply to the ray.

Prepared 1st-level spells: grease and magic missile. Grease lasts 1 round within 25 ft. and ignores spell resistance. In a 10-ft. square, creatures make Reflex DC 14 or fall. Moving through it takes Balance DC 10 at half speed. Failure stops movement and calls for a Reflex save against falling. Failing Balance by 5 or more causes a fall outright.

Grease can instead coat one object. A creature using the object makes Reflex DC 14 or drops it, and saves again when trying to pick it up or use it. Greased armor or clothing grants a +10 circumstance bonus on Escape Artist and grapple checks to resist or escape a grapple or escape a pin.
Magic Missile deals 1d4+1 force within 110 ft. without an attack roll or saving throw. Spell resistance applies.
builds.tactics: Keep the lamp hooded while checking the seed vault’s hinges and disturbed locks. Use Mage Hand for a light object out of reach. If pressed, use Grease to delay pursuit or Magic Missile when bright light would hinder a ray.

builds.title: Sharakim cistern inspector, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2.
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft.; Shadow Affinity in darkness or shadowy illumination
traits: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1 and natural armor +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +2. Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +1.

In darkness or shadowy illumination, add +2 to Hide, Move Silently, Search, and Spot. Attacks suffer −1 in bright sunlight or inside daylight, and gain +1 against orcs and half-orcs. Apply both attack modifiers if both conditions hold.
Skill Focus (Search) adds +3. In darkness or shadowy illumination, Hide +7, Move Silently +7, Search +11, and Spot +7.
Trapfinding permits searching for traps with DC above 20 and using Disable Device on magical traps. He carries ordinary thieves’ tools.

Sneak Attack +1d6 when he flanks a creature or it is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged attacks must be within 30 ft. The target must be vulnerable to critical hits and have no concealment from Oswin.
actions: Short sword +2 melee, 1d6+2 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment. Reload as a move action.
builds.tactics: Inspect the dark cistern steps before anyone pulls the main lever. Keep one route lit for the party and use the shadowed side passage to spot traps or tampering.

builds.title: Underfolk ore assayer, Expert 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 1.
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +1, Will +2.
Skill Focus (Appraise) adds +3. The eight listed ranked class skills use 32 skill points, including the four extra at first level. Hide +5 without Camouflage.
Camouflage still works against darkvision. True seeing negates the racial Hide bonus. Ordinary cover or concealment is still needed to attempt a Hide check.
Dazzled in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell. While dazzled, Search +4, Spot +3, heavy pick +0 melee, and light crossbow +0 ranged.
The heavy pick counts as simple through Weapon Familiarity and is covered by Expert proficiency.
actions: Heavy pick +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical ×4, 5-ft. reach.
Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
builds.tactics: Compare the disputed ore samples against the original mark in the covered counting room. Ask the party to bring the merchants’ seals before the shipments are mixed.

builds.title: Underfolk gallery watch, Ranger 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +2. Armor check penalty −1.
Alertness and class bonus Track. Wild Empathy +0. Favored enemy constructs gives +2 to weapon damage and to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival against constructs.
The listed Hide total uses Camouflage. Hide +5 when its bonus is negated. The racial and Alertness bonuses are already included in Listen.
Camouflage still works against darkvision. True seeing negates the racial Hide bonus. Ordinary cover or concealment is still needed to attempt a Hide check.
Dazzled in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell. While dazzled, Search +3, Spot +7 (+9 against constructs), light pick +1 melee, and longbow +2 ranged. Favored-enemy damage still applies.
actions: Light pick +2 melee, 1d4+1 piercing, critical ×4, 5-ft. reach. Add +2 weapon damage against constructs.
Longbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, 100-ft. increment. Add +2 weapon damage against constructs.
builds.tactics: Listen for the stone sentry’s tread from behind cover. Lead the party to the safe gallery between passes. Keep the ledge clear while the party checks the old counterweight.

builds.title: Fire Caste Dromite caravan outrider, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 2.
traits: AC 19 includes studded leather +3, light wooden shield +1, natural armor +3, Dexterity +1, and size +1. Touch 12, flat-footed 18. BAB +1, grapple −2. Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will −1.
Fire resistance 5. Racial Blind-Fight. Improved Initiative and Fighter bonus Weapon Focus (shortspear).
Scent 30 ft. normally, 60 ft. upwind or 15 ft. downwind. Move action to find direction and pinpoint within 5 ft. Strong or overpowering scents extend detection.
Naturally Psionic grants 1 bonus power point. Racial Energy Ray has its own use and consumes none of that point.
actions: Small shortspear +4 melee, reach 5 ft., or +4 thrown, 20-ft. range increment. Hit 1d4+1 piercing, critical ×2.
Fire Energy Ray once per day. Standard action, +3 ranged touch at up to 25 ft., 1d6+1 fire, no save, power resistance applies, manifester level 1.
builds.tactics: Get the loaded beetles behind a stone bend and stand between the animals and the hazard. Keep the shortspear ready and save the ray for a target outside spear reach.

builds.title: Xeph lantern rigger, Soulknife 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Studded leather +3, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +4, Will +3.
+1 racial bonus to saves against powers, spells and spell-like effects. Base saves appear above.
Improved Initiative. Soulknife bonus feats Weapon Focus (mind blade) and Wild Talent. Reserve 3 PP from Wild Talent and Naturally Psionic. Blade and Burst consume none of that reserve.
The mind blade has hardness 10 and 10 HP. It dissipates when released. It counts as magic for overcoming damage reduction.
Racial Burst 3/day. Standard action. Base land speed becomes 40 ft. for 3 rounds, with +4 to Jump from the increased speed. It costs no PP.
actions: Form mind blade (Su) as a move action. Mind blade +2 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, reach 5 ft.
Light crossbow +2 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment. Reload as a move action.
builds.tactics: Ask the party to clear the square before freeing the jammed lantern counterweight. Use Burst to reach the far stair once the platform is clear. Keep the mind blade in hand if needed.

builds.title: Half-Giant desert pass rescuer, Psychic Warrior 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 2.
traits: Chain shirt +4, touch 10, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple +7 with Powerful Build. Fortitude +5, Reflex +0, Will +1. Fire Acclimated adds +2 on saves against fire effects.
Alertness and Psychic Warrior bonus Improved Initiative. Naturally Psionic supplies both daily PP. Psychic Warrior 1 and Wisdom 13 contribute 0. Manifester level 1.

With room to grow during Expansion: Large size, 10-ft. space/reach, Str 19, Dex 8, AC 12, touch 8, flat-footed 12, Reflex −1, grapple +12 with Powerful Build. Climb and Jump each +6. The enlarged weapon follows the power and Powerful Build uses the next size category.
actions: Large longsword, wielded two-handed: +3 melee, 2d6+4 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. With Expansion the sword becomes Huge: +3 melee, 3d6+6 slashing, same critical, 10-ft. reach.

Racial Stomp once per day. Standard action, 20-ft. cone-shaped spread, grounded creatures only. Reflex DC 10 negates prone and 1d4 nonlethal damage. No power resistance, manifester level 1, no PP cost.

Expansion: 1 PP, standard action, personal, 1 round at manifester level 1. Enlarge by one size category with the carried gear. The effect ends before her next turn. The expanded attack applies to an attack of opportunity in that window. The longer duration is beyond this build’s manifester-level limit.
builds.tactics: Mark the stable ledge and keep the party clear while planning the lift. Use Expansion and the remaining move action to get the rescue line within reach before the effect ends. Use Stomp only after the party clears the cone.

builds.title: Half-Giant glassworks kiln watch, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 2.
traits: Studded leather +3, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple +8 with Powerful Build. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1. Against fire effects the saves are +6, +3, and +3.
Toughness adds 3 HP. Fighter bonus Weapon Focus (warhammer). Climb and Jump include the combined −2 armor check penalty.
Naturally Psionic provides 2 PP. The racial Stomp has its own daily use. Actual space and reach are 5 ft.
actions: Large warhammer +5 melee, 2d6+3 bludgeoning one-handed, critical ×3, reach 5 ft.

Racial Stomp once per day. Standard action, 20-ft. cone-shaped spread, grounded creatures only. Reflex DC 11 negates prone and 1d4 nonlethal damage. No power resistance, manifester level 1, no PP cost.
builds.tactics: Clear the glassworks and keep the kiln passage open while the crew covers the hot channel. If the evacuation is interrupted, stand at the threshold and reserve the cone until workers are clear.

builds.title: Mongrelfolk pawnbroker, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
skills: Use Magic Device +6, or +10 to emulate a nonhumanoid race
builds.senses: Low-light vision at twice human distance.
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +0.
Trapfinding allows Search checks for traps above DC 20 and Disable Device checks against magic traps. Skill Focus (Use Magic Device) adds +3. The eight listed skills each have four ranks.
Apply other magic item requirements normally. An elf-restricted item needs no race check. A nonhumanoid race restriction is a DC 25 Use Magic Device check at +10.
Diffuse Blood gives +2 racial on saves against spells that target or exclude a particular race when the race named by the spell is human, halfling, dwarf, elf, gnome, goblin, or orc.
Immune to sleep spells and similar magical effects. +1 racial on saves against enchantment spells and effects, illusion spells and effects, and poison.
actions: Rapier +0 melee, 1d6 piercing, critical 18–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Shortbow +2 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, 60-ft. increment.

Sneak attack adds 1d6 damage when Mara flanks the target or it is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. The target must be vulnerable to critical hits, with a vital spot Mara can see and reach and no concealment from her.
Sound Imitation (Ex) reproduces any voice or sound the Mongrelfolk has heard. A listener detects the imitation with a DC 16 Will save.
builds.tactics: Mara agreed to inspect an elf-restricted magic clasp. She will demonstrate its catch if the party finds the owner named on the pawn ticket. If cornered, she hides behind the counter and takes the back stair.

builds.title: Mongrelfolk ferry bellkeeper, Expert 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 1.
builds.senses: Low-light vision at twice human distance.
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Each listed skill is a selected Expert class skill with four ranks. Alertness gives +2 Listen and Spot, already included.

Emulate Race (Ex) automatically satisfies the racial requirement of a magic item for any humanoid race. A Mongrelfolk trained in Use Magic Device gets a +4 racial bonus on checks to emulate a nonhumanoid race.
Diffuse Blood gives +2 racial on saves against spells that target or exclude a particular race when the race named by the spell is human, halfling, dwarf, elf, gnome, goblin, or orc.
Immune to sleep spells and similar magical effects. +1 racial on saves against enchantment spells and effects, illusion spells and effects, and poison.
actions: Club +1 melee, 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach.
Sling +1 ranged, 1d4+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 50-ft. increment. Loading takes a move action.
Sound Imitation (Ex) reproduces any voice or sound the Mongrelfolk has heard. A listener detects the imitation with a DC 16 Will save.
builds.tactics: Tavin heard two ferry calls using the same bell. Ask the party to watch the landing, then imitate the damaged bell from shore to see who answers. In a fight, Tavin keeps behind the stone mooring post.

builds.title: Xeph woodland reserve tracker, Ranger 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Studded leather +3, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +1. Fortitude +3, Reflex +5, Will +1.
+1 racial bonus to saves against powers, spells and spell-like effects. Base saves appear above.
Track, Wild Empathy +0, and Point Blank Shot. Favored enemy animals adds +2 to weapon damage and to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks against animals.
Naturally Psionic supplies a 1 PP reserve. Burst is independent of it.
Racial Burst 3/day. Standard action. Base land speed becomes 40 ft. for 3 rounds, with +4 to Jump from the increased speed. It costs no PP.
actions: Longbow +4 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, 100-ft. range increment. Within 30 ft., Point Blank Shot gives +5 attack and 1d8+1 damage. Add +2 damage against animals.
Short sword +1 melee, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, reach 5 ft. Add +2 damage against animals.
builds.tactics: Follow the wolf’s track to the reserve boundary. Keep the party from crowding it, then loop ahead with Burst to flag the snare line before the wolf reaches it.

builds.title: Whisper Gnome night courier, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, small size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +0.
+1 racial on attack rolls against kobolds and goblinoids. +4 dodge AC against Giant-type creatures while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.

Against Giant-type creatures, AC 20 and touch 18 while able to dodge. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot, already included. Trapfinding allows Search checks for traps above DC 20 and Disable Device against magic traps.
actions: Small rapier +1 melee, 1d4 piercing, critical 18–20/×2. +2 to hit against kobolds and goblinoids.
Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action. +5 to hit against kobolds and goblinoids.

Sneak attack adds 1d6 when Nella flanks the target or it is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. The target must be vulnerable to critical hits, with a vital spot Nella can see and reach and no concealment from her.

Racial silence 1/day at caster level 1, regardless of Charisma. Center it on the Whisper Gnome’s body. The 20-ft.-radius emanation moves with the gnome and lasts 1 minute, dismissible. It blocks sound and verbal spell components.
Charisma 10 grants ghost sound (Will disbelief DC 10 on interaction), mage hand, and message 1/day each at caster level 1.
builds.tactics: Nella needs to deliver a ledger slip before the postern closes. She asks the party to find who left the recipient’s lantern unlit. She uses message to speak before crossing, then centers silence on herself if she must move through a stairwell without being heard.

builds.title: Whisper Gnome bellwright, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Studded leather +3, Dexterity +2, small size +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple −2. Fortitude +5, Reflex +2, Will +0. Armor check penalty −1.
+1 racial on attack rolls against kobolds and goblinoids. +4 dodge AC against Giant-type creatures while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.
Against Giant-type creatures, AC 20 and touch 17 while able to dodge. Improved Initiative and Weapon Focus (gnome hooked hammer) are already included. Weapon Familiarity makes the hammer martial.
actions: Small gnome hooked hammer +4 melee with either head wielded alone in two hands. Blunt head deals 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×3. Hook deals 1d4+1 piercing, critical ×4. +5 to hit against kobolds and goblinoids.
Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action. +5 to hit against kobolds and goblinoids.

Racial silence 1/day at caster level 1, regardless of Charisma. Center it on the Whisper Gnome’s body. The 20-ft.-radius emanation moves with the gnome and lasts 1 minute, dismissible. It blocks sound and verbal spell components.
Charisma 8 leaves only the always-available racial silence on the spell-like ability list.
builds.tactics: Tovin asks the party to steady the cracked bell before it rattles the repair platform. He surrounds himself with silence while they lower the clapper. He keeps the platform clear with his hooked hammer if anything threatens the crew.

builds.title: Route warden
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/4 (50 XP)
traits: Knows a nearby route to cover. The route is visible to a creature that watches the warden take it.
actions: Hook staff. Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Sling. Ranged attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
builds.tactics: Uses cover and directs bystanders out of the scene. Offers a route to safety once the other side stops pressing.

builds.title: Ward tender
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2 (100 XP)
traits: Can identify the visible maker's mark on a local ward without rolling.
actions: Ward spark. Ranged spell attack +4, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

Hold the threshold (1/day). Choose a 5-foot square within 30 ft. Each creature there makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) force damage and its speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.
builds.tactics: Protects a door or witness and leaves by a prepared route when challenged in the open.

builds.title: Hunter Killoren trail ward, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +4, Will +0.

Low-light vision, magical sleep immunity, +2 racial saves against enchantments, +2 racial Handle Animal and Survival. The listed weapons use ordinary materials. Apply −2 to attacks using wholly or partly cold-iron weapons, including cold-iron arrows.
Hunter is Irimel’s active aspect for this encounter. Initiative, Hide, Listen, Move Silently, and Spot already include the Hunter +2.
Killoren Hunter feat can pinpoint a living creature within 30 ft. as a move action, with line of effect. An unseen creature keeps total concealment.

Trapfinding permits searching for traps with a DC above 20 and using Disable Device on magical traps. The kit includes ordinary thieves’ tools. Sneak Attack +1d6 applies to eligible attacks, with a 30-ft. limit for ranged attacks.
actions: Rapier +0 melee, 1d6 piercing, critical 18–20/×2, reach 5 ft.
Shortbow +2 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, 60-ft. range increment.
builds.tactics: Search the marked path for old alarms and keep travellers off the flooded stretch. If a living creature moves nearby in the fog, pinpoint it before asking anyone to approach.

builds.title: Half-Ogre levee gatekeeper, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 3.
traits: Space 10 ft. Natural reach 10 ft. Chain shirt +4, natural armor +4, Dexterity +1, size −1. Touch 10, flat-footed 17. Armor check penalty −2.
BAB +1, grapple +10. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +0.

Power Attack and Weapon Focus (glaive). The glaive attack includes Weapon Focus. When Bram chooses Power Attack, his melee attacks take −1 until his next turn. The glaive gains +2 damage. The light spiked gauntlet's damage stays the same.
actions: Large glaive +6 melee, 2d8+7 slashing, critical ×3. Attacks at 15 or 20 ft.
Large spiked gauntlet +5 melee, 1d6+5 piercing, critical ×2. Covers targets within 10 ft.
builds.tactics: Bram closes the levee gate when the height marks disappear underwater. He lends his gate key if the party finds the missing crew first. If defending the platform, he keeps intruders at glaive distance and uses the gauntlet inside that reach.

builds.title: Half-Ogre ridge drummer, Barbarian 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 3.
traits: Space and natural reach 10 ft. Studded leather +3, natural armor +4, size −1. Touch 9, flat-footed 16. Armor check penalty −1.
BAB +1, grapple +10. Fortitude +5, Reflex +0, Will +1. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Fast Movement adds 10 ft. before armor and load modifiers. With studded leather and a light load, speed is 40 ft. and the resulting +4 speed bonus is included in Jump.
actions: Large greatclub +5 melee, 2d8+7 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 10-ft. reach. While raging, +7 to hit and 2d8+10 damage.
Large javelin +0 ranged, 1d8+5 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment. While raging, damage increases to 1d8+7.

Rage once per day and once per encounter for up to 8 rounds. Dessa can enter Rage on her turn without spending an action. While raging, Str 25, Con 20, HP 17, AC 14, touch 7, flat-footed 14, grapple +12, Fortitude +7, Reflex +0, Will +3. When Rage ends, lose the 2 bonus HP and become fatigued for the rest of the encounter (−2 Str and Dex, no running or charging).
builds.tactics: Dessa drums the ridge routes so walkers can count the turns in a whiteout. Her partner missed the last reply. She asks the party to follow the calls downhill and uses rage if the group is trapped on the ridge.

builds.title: Spellscale sluice rescue, Sorcerer 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Neutral good. Unarmored, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +2, Will +2. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Sorcerer caster level 1. Casts spontaneously. Five 0-level slots and four 1st-level slots per day. Save DC 13 or 14 respectively. Carries a spell component pouch and has no familiar.

Blood Quickening: Bahamut active after one hour of meditation. Up to three times during the next 24 hours, choose one evil creature targeted by or in the area of a spell she casts and add 2d6 damage to that creature.
actions: Quarterstaff +0 melee, 1d6 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Light crossbow +2 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.

Magic missile (1st): standard action, one creature within 110 ft., 1d4+1 force, no attack roll or save. Spell resistance applies. With Bahamut active and a use spent on an evil creature, add 2d6 damage.
Mage armor (1st): standard action, touch, 1 hour. On Isette it raises AC to 16 and flat-footed AC to 14. Ordinary touch AC remains 12. The force armor applies against incorporeal touch attacks.

Cantrips known: detect magic (concentration, up to 1 minute, 60-ft. cone), light (object touched, 10 minutes), mage hand (one unattended nonmagical object weighing at most 5 lb. within 25 ft. while concentrating), and read magic.
builds.tactics: Isette wants to open an inspection sluice to reach two missing workers. She casts mage armor before entering and asks the party to keep a rope on the dry side. She saves her meditation’s damage for an evil creature blocking the way.

builds.title: Dragonborn of Bahamut ember road warden, Heart Paladin 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Lawful good. Aura of good. Former human. The rite retains the 30-ft. base speed and human identity for racial effects. The human bonus feat and skill points are gone. Iron Will adds +2 Will.
Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +3. Armor check penalty −4.
Against attacks by Dragon-type creatures, +2 dodge AC (AC 19, touch 13 when eligible for the dodge bonus). Immune to dragons’ frightful presence. Heart is his only aspect.
actions: Longsword +3 melee, 1d8+2 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.
Smite evil once per day. With his longsword, +5 melee and 1d8+3 against an evil target. On another alignment, the normal attack applies and the attempt is still spent.
Heart breath: standard action, supernatural 5-ft. line, 1d8 damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire each use. Reflex DC 13 halves. Roll 1d4 rounds before using it again.
Detect evil at will, as the spell. This Paladin level grants no spells.
builds.tactics: Joren guards a wagon carrying people who fled the dragon’s tribute collectors. He checks the next turn in the road for danger and saves his breath for a target he can catch without putting the wagon crew in the line.

builds.title: Dragonborn of Bahamut ravine rope guard, Wings Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Lawful good. Former dwarf. Keeps the dwarf subtype, the 20-ft. base land speed, and the dwarf +2 Constitution and −2 Charisma adjustments. Rebirth adds +2 Constitution and −2 Dexterity. The rite removes darkvision, stability, and the old armored movement perk.

Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +0. Armor check penalty −4. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (longsword) adds +1 to attack.
Against attacks by Dragon-type creatures, +2 dodge AC (AC 19, touch 13 when eligible for the dodge bonus). Immune to dragons’ frightful presence.
Wings is her only aspect. Jump +7 includes 4 ranks, +3 Strength, +10 racial, −4 armor check penalty, and −6 for her 20-ft. land speed. Her listed equipment is a light load.
actions: Longsword +5 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.

Glide with a light load at 30 ft. with average maneuverability, moving 20 ft. forward per 5 ft. of descent and negating falling damage. Orra has no powered flight at 1 HD. If unconscious or helpless in midair, her involuntary descent limits falling damage to 1d6.
builds.tactics: Orra wants to replace a torn ravine rope before the last travellers arrive. She can glide down with the light messenger line while the party carries the heavier replacement rope along the ridge.

builds.title: Spellscale waystation storyteller, Bard 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2.
traits: Chaotic good. Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +4. Light armor leaves bard spells usable. Armor check penalty −1.

Skill Focus (Perform [storytelling]) adds +3. Bardic knowledge +2. Bard caster level 2. Casts spontaneously, with three 0-level slots and one 1st-level slot per day. Save DC 13 or 14 respectively. Carries a spell component pouch.

Blood Quickening: Hlal active. At level 2 it adds +1 racial to Perform (storytelling) and grants three uses of Heighten Spell that day. He has one 1st-level slot to spend on a heightened cantrip or a 1st-level spell.
actions: Rapier +1 melee, 1d6 piercing, critical 18–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Shortbow +3 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, 60-ft. increment.
Bardic music 2/day, standard action to start. Inspire courage grants +1 morale on attack rolls, weapon damage, and saves against charm and fear while heard and for 5 rounds afterward.

Countersong lets listeners within 30 ft. use his Perform check instead of a lower save against magical attacks that are sonic or language-dependent, for up to 10 rounds. An ongoing eligible effect grants another save using the Perform result. Fascinate affects one attentive creature within 90 ft. outside combat distractions. It uses his Perform result as the Will DC and lasts up to 2 rounds with concentration.

Daze (0): standard action, one Humanoid of 4 HD or less within 30 ft. It takes no actions for 1 round on failed DC 13 Will. Spell resistance applies. Hlal allows Heighten Spell with his sole 1st-level slot for DC 14 and a full-round casting action.

Other cantrips known: detect magic (60-ft. cone), light (object touched, 20 minutes), mage hand (one unattended nonmagical object weighing at most 5 lb. within 30 ft. while concentrating), and prestidigitation.
Cure light wounds (1st): standard action, touch, heals 1d8+2 on a willing living target. Expeditious retreat (1st): standard action, personal, increases land speed to 60 ft. for 2 minutes.
builds.tactics: Meren is keeping families together after the outbound wagons failed to arrive. He tells a story so they can count who is present. He keeps his only 1st-level slot for an injured traveler unless a hostile Humanoid needs to be stopped immediately.

builds.title: Dream Dwarf spring tender, Druid 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
skills: Concentration +7, or +11 to cast defensively or while grappled or pinned
Diplomacy +4, or +6 with creatures of the earth subtype
traits: Hide armor +3 and heavy wooden shield +2. Touch 10, flat-footed 15. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +5, Reflex +0, Will +4.
Dream Sight (Su) sees ethereal creatures as readily as material creatures. Ethereal creatures look translucent and indistinct, so the dwarf can tell them apart.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.

Stonecunning checks unusual stonework within 10 ft. and covers stonework traps. Combat Casting grants +4 on qualifying Concentration checks. Nature Sense is included in Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Wild Empathy +1. Animal companion slot open.

Spell Power adds +1 to effective caster level for divinations or spells with the earth descriptor when in contact with the ground. Apply the increase to level-dependent effects and caster level checks. It stacks with other Spell Power abilities.
actions: Club +1 melee, 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2.
Dagger +0 ranged, 1d4+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 10-ft. increment.

Prepared 0-level spells are detect magic, detect poison, and light. Prepared 1st-level spells are entangle and speak with animals. Spontaneously convert a prepared spell to summon nature’s ally of the same level when available.

On the ground, detect magic and detect poison use caster level 2, and speak with animals lasts 2 minutes. At base caster level 1, speak with animals lasts 1 minute. Detect poison has 30-ft. range on the ground and 25-ft. range at caster level 1.

Entangle uses caster level 1 in either case. For 1 minute, plants in a 40-ft.-radius spread within 440 ft. entangle creatures in or entering the area on a failed Reflex DC 13. On a success they move at half speed through the area. Spell resistance does not apply.

An entangled creature can spend a full-round action on a DC 20 Strength or Escape Artist check to break free and move at half speed. On each of Maera’s turns, the plants try again against creatures in the area that saved or broke free.
builds.tactics: Maera wants to know why animals have stopped drinking at the spring. She speaks with a badger from the bank and uses detect poison on the spillway. If pursued, she falls back through the reeds and casts entangle to slow the approach.

builds.title: Warforged latch maker, Artificer 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
skills: Use Magic Device +4, or +6 to activate a scroll
traits: Composite Plating +2 armor and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +2, Reflex +1, Will +2.
Immune to poison, sleep effects, paralysis, disease, nausea, fatigue, exhaustion, effects causing sickened, and energy drain.
Light Fortification gives a 25% chance to negate the extra effects of a critical hit or sneak attack and roll damage normally.

The official errata allows natural recovery of nonlethal damage and bars natural healing of lethal damage. Healing-subschool spells and supernatural healing of HP or ability damage work at half effect. Repair light damage works at full effect.

Artificer 1 gains Scribe Scroll, Craft Reserve 20 XP, Disable Trap, and Artisan Bonus +2 to Use Magic Device when activating scrolls. Artificer Knowledge +3, DC 15, requires 1 minute of examining an item. Skill Focus (Craft [armorsmithing]) adds +3.

Three 1st-level infusions per day, two base and one for Intelligence. Class caster level 1. The infusions are neither arcane nor divine. The plating’s 5% arcane failure chance applies to arcane spells and does not apply to these infusions.
actions: Slam +0 melee, 1d4 bludgeoning, 5-ft. reach.
Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Repair light damage. Standard action, touch, instant. Restore 1d8+1 HP to an ordinary construct with at least 1 HP or a living construct with at least −9 HP. No save or spell resistance.
Skill enhancement. Cast in 1 round on a touched item using fine black thread. It grants the wearer or wielder +2 circumstance on checks with the chosen skill for 10 minutes.
Trained Craft repair takes 8 hours. Craft (armorsmithing) +9 restores 4 HP by taking 10, including for self-repair.
builds.tactics: Swage needs the worn brass hinge before making a replacement that will fit the old lift cage. The party can retrieve it while Swage repairs the injured construct serving as lift attendant.

builds.title: Warforged drain gate watch, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Adamantine Body +8 armor, heavy steel shield +2, and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 20. Armor check penalty −7 combined. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +0.
Immune to poison, sleep effects, paralysis, disease, nausea, fatigue, exhaustion, effects causing sickened, and energy drain.
Light Fortification gives a 25% chance to negate the extra effects of a critical hit or sneak attack and roll damage normally.

The official errata allows natural recovery of nonlethal damage and bars natural healing of lethal damage. Healing-subschool spells and supernatural healing of HP or ability damage work at half effect. Repair light damage works at full effect.

At 0 HP, a Warforged is disabled and gets one move or standard action per round without losing HP for strenuous actions. At −1 through −9 HP it is inert, unconscious and helpless, and loses HP only if damaged again.
Adamantine Body gives DR 2/adamantine, heavy armor, maximum Dexterity bonus +1, and 35% arcane spell failure from the plating. Weapon Focus (warhammer) is the Fighter bonus feat.
actions: Warhammer +4 melee, 1d8+2 bludgeoning, critical ×3, 5-ft. reach.
Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.
Primary slam +3 melee with a free arm, 1d4+3 bludgeoning, 5-ft. reach. The slam is the only natural weapon and uses 1½ times the Strength bonus.
builds.tactics: Keel stands at the drain gate while the crew clears the waterlogged passage. Keel can stay submerged without breathing while holding the gate open. If threatened, Keel uses the shield to hold the landing.

builds.title: Rilkan warehouse roof scout, Rogue 1 substitution
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Chaotic good. Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +0. Improved Initiative adds +4. Armor check penalty −1. Uses ordinary thieves’ tools.
Trapfinding can locate traps with a Search DC above 20 and disarm magical traps. Kesra took the first Rilkan Rogue substitution and has no sneak attack at this level.
Improved Flanking gives the Rilkan Rogue +4 to attacks when flanking in place of the usual +2. Other Rilkans flanking that same foe also get +4. Allies of other species use the usual flanking bonus.
Racial Knowledge treats all Knowledge checks as trained, even without ranks. Its +1 competence bonus on Knowledge and bardic knowledge checks increases by +1 per two soulmelds currently shaped.
Racial Aid gives +3 to the roll of another Rilkan when you successfully aid them. Use the ordinary bonus when aiding a creature of another species.
actions: Rapier +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 18–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. +5 to hit while flanking via Improved Flanking.
Light crossbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
builds.tactics: Kesra agreed to get two apprentices out before the warehouse is sealed. She checks the roof hatch for a trap, then looks for a way to flank a guard with the cargo inspector if he is nearby.

builds.title: Rilkan quay cargo inspector, Incarnate 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Lawful neutral. Aura strength corresponds to Incarnate level 1. Studded leather +3, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 15. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +4. Armor check penalty −3.

Incarnate 1 grants one essentia and the Incarnum subtype. Meldshaper level 1. Shapes Dissolving Spittle (throat) and Silvertongue Mask (brow), both unbound. Each can hold one point. Reallocate the point as a swift action.

Both soulmelds stay shaped when the point moves. Racial Knowledge is +2 competence while both are shaped. Silvertongue Mask gives +2 insight to Bluff and Diplomacy or +4 when invested. The default is invested in the mask.
Alertness gives +2 to Listen and Spot.
Racial Aid gives +3 to the roll of another Rilkan when you successfully aid them. Use the ordinary bonus when aiding a creature of another species.
actions: Morningstar +0 melee, 1d8 bludgeoning and piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. +4 to hit if he and Kesra are flanking the same foe.
Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.
Detect Opposition at will as the detect chaos spell.
Dissolving Spittle: standard action, +2 ranged touch within 30 ft., 1d6 acid or 2d6 with the point invested. No save. This action provokes attacks of opportunity.
builds.tactics: Bren keeps his mask invested while he checks the manifests. If fighting starts, he can shift the point to Dissolving Spittle. If Kesra has a flank, he draws his morningstar and takes the opposite side.

builds.title: Azurin ferry warden, Soulborn 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Lawful good. Aura (Ex) corresponds to her lawful good alignment. Studded leather +3, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1. Combined armor check penalty −3.

Three essentia from her race, Sapphire Smite, and Healing Soul. The normal capacity is 1 per feat. At the start of the day she puts 1 in Sapphire Smite and 1 in Healing Soul for 24 hours. The third point remains unspent.
At Soulborn 1, Lysa gets her essentia from her race and feats. Soulborn meldshaping starts at 4th level and class essentia starts at 6th.
actions: Longsword +3 melee, 1d8+2 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.

Smite Opposition twice per day with Sapphire Smite. With her longsword, +5 melee for 1d8+4 against a chaotic or evil target. Another alignment receives the ordinary attack and still expends the attempt.
Healing Soul once per day as a swift action. Heal 2 HP to herself.
builds.tactics: Lysa is holding the ferry until a missing child reaches the landing. She keeps the gate open for the party, shields the ramp, and saves Smite Opposition for an attacker whose allegiance she has confirmed.

builds.title: Azurin mill causeway watch, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Chaotic good. Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Improved Initiative is the Fighter bonus feat.
Three essentia from her race, Cobalt Charge, and Midnight Dodge. Invests 1 in each feat for 24 hours. The normal capacity is 1 per feat. One point remains unspent.

Midnight Dodge grants +1 dodge AC against one opponent designated on Rena’s turn. She may change the target each turn without moving any essentia. AC 16 against that opponent, or 14 while under the charge penalty. Losing her Dexterity bonus also removes the dodge bonus.
actions: Greatsword +4 melee, 2d6+4 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Javelin +3 ranged, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.
Cobalt Charge with the greatsword: +7 melee, 2d6+5 slashing. This includes the ordinary +2 charge attack bonus and a +1 insight bonus to attack and damage. Charge imposes −2 AC until her next turn.
builds.tactics: Rena keeps the causeway clear while mill workers cross. She chooses the opponent most likely to reach her, then charges only when she has a clear lane. If the gate or workers block that lane, she holds the bottleneck.

builds.title: Dream Dwarf seam reader, Expert 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 1.
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Dream Sight (Su) sees ethereal creatures as readily as material creatures. Ethereal creatures look translucent and indistinct, so the dwarf can tell them apart.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.

Each listed Expert class skill has four ranks. Skill Focus (Search) adds +3. Stonecunning adds another +2 when checking unusual stonework, including a stonework trap. A search is possible within 10 ft. even without actively looking.
actions: Heavy mace +1 melee, 1d8+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2.
Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
builds.tactics: Ornek surveys a bricked-up passage after glimpsing an ethereal traveler through its entrance. He marks the seam for the party and uses ordinary tools to check the wall.

builds.title: Tibbit mews courier, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft. Cat form also has scent.
traits: Chaotic good. Humanoid form uses studded leather +3, Dexterity +3, and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Cat form: Tiny, STR 3, DEX 18, HP 8, AC 16, touch 16, flat-footed 12, initiative +8, grapple −12, Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +1. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Worn armor and thieves’ tools meld.
Trapfinding and sneak attack +1d6. Search can locate traps with DC above 20. Magical traps can be disarmed with Disable Device. Pell returns to humanoid form to manipulate his tools.
Cat form cannot speak, manipulate fine objects, cast spells with verbal or somatic components, use scrolls, or activate magic items.
actions: Small dagger +1 melee, 1d3 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.

Cat form: claw −2 melee, 1 piercing and slashing. Full attack: two claws at −2 and bite −7 for 1 piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning. All critical hits are ×2. Tiny reach requires entering the target’s space and normally provokes. The listed damage includes the minimum 1 before damage reduction.

Add 1d6 sneak attack to a qualifying attack against a target denied Dexterity to AC or when flanking with melee. Ranged sneak attack requires a target within 30 ft. The cat’s 0-ft. reach cannot flank, but it can still sneak attack a target denied Dexterity to AC.

Feline Transformation lets a Tibbit become a house cat at will as a standard action. The rules give no duration limit. Returning to humanoid form takes a full-round action. Wait one hour after returning before transforming again.
builds.tactics: Pell scouts the mews in cat form while the porter makes his rounds. He returns to humanoid form in an alcove and uses his tools to open the tack-room lock. The party can warn him if the porter returns during the change.

builds.title: Tibbit grain loft watch, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft. Cat form also has scent.
traits: Chaotic neutral. Studded leather +3, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +3, and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 16. BAB +1, grapple +0. Fortitude +3, Reflex +3, Will +1. Armor check penalty −3. Improved Initiative adds +4.

Cat form: Tiny, STR 8, DEX 18, HP 11, AC 16, touch 16, flat-footed 12, initiative +8, grapple −8, Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +1. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Worn armor, shield, and weapons meld. Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity to hit with natural weapons.
Cat form cannot speak, manipulate fine objects, cast spells with verbal or somatic components, use scrolls, or activate magic items.
actions: Small longsword +5 melee, 1d6+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Small javelin +5 ranged, 1d4+3 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.

Cat form: claw +7 melee, 1 piercing and slashing. Full attack: two claws at +7 and bite +2 for 1d3−1 piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning (minimum 1). All critical hits are ×2. The cat normally provokes when entering an enemy’s space to attack.

Feline Transformation lets a Tibbit become a house cat at will as a standard action. The rules give no duration limit. Returning to humanoid form takes a full-round action. Wait one hour after returning before transforming again.
builds.tactics: Rusk waits in cat form near the loft opening. He listens for movement and can use scent to pinpoint a creature within 5 ft. in the dark. If someone threatens the storekeeper, he retreats behind the sacks to spend a full round returning to humanoid form, then uses his shield and longsword.

builds.title: Destroyer Killoren grove steward, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Chain shirt +4 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will −1.

Low-light vision, magical sleep immunity, +2 racial saves against enchantments, +2 racial Handle Animal and Survival. The listed weapons use ordinary materials. Apply −2 to attacks using wholly or partly cold-iron weapons, including cold-iron arrows.
Destroyer is Daranvar’s active aspect. Weapon Focus (longspear) is the Fighter bonus feat. The Killoren Destroyer feat can daze a foe hit by an eligible smite.
actions: Longspear +4 melee, 1d8+3 piercing, critical ×3, reach 10 ft., usable against foes beyond adjacent squares. Club +3 melee adjacent, 1d6+2 bludgeoning one-handed, critical ×2.

Destroyer smite twice per day, at most once per hour. Smite with longspear +6 for 1d8+4 or club +5 for 1d6+3. Valid targets are aberrations, constructs, humanoids, oozes, outsiders, and undead. An invalid target spends the use.
On a successful smite against an eligible target, Killoren Destroyer requires Will DC 12 or dazes that target for 1 round.
builds.tactics: Keep the construct on the path and away from the seedlings while the party looks for its control mark. Hold the crossing with the longspear. Save the smite for a clear hit on the construct.

builds.title: Skarn stone stair marshal, Monk 1 substitution
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Lawful good. Unarmored, Dexterity +1 and Wisdom +2. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +3, Will +4. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Spine Strike replaces Monk unarmed strike. Monk features such as flurry of blows and Stunning Fist work with his arm spines. The Medium Monk 1 damage die is 1d6. He has no essentia pool.
actions: Arm spine +3 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach.
Flurry of blows as a full attack: two arm spine attacks at +1/+1, each 1d6+3 piercing. The −2 attack penalty also applies to his other attacks until just before his next turn.

Stunning Fist once per day as his Monk bonus feat. Declare before the spine attack roll. On a hit, Fortitude DC 12 or stunned for 1 round. A missed attack or an immune target expends the use. Constructs, oozes, plants, undead, incorporeal creatures, and creatures immune to critical hits cannot be stunned by it.
Shuriken +1 ranged, 1d2+3 piercing, critical ×2, 10-ft. increment.
builds.tactics: Corven is clearing the stone stair after a landing has started to give way. If a pursuer catches him in place, he tries to stun it and asks the party to get the last climbers around the crack.

builds.title: Skarn lockgate inspector, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Lawful neutral. Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1. Armor check penalty −4.
Power Attack is the Fighter bonus feat. Cobalt Power supplies one essentia and the Incarnum subtype. Capacity is 1. Invest the point in Cobalt Power once per day for 24 hours.

Cobalt Power grants +1 insight on attack rolls or ability checks to succeed at a bull rush, overrun, or sunder. It also adds up to +1 insight damage on Power Attack, capped by the attack penalty taken.
An arm cannot attack with both its spines and a weapon it wields in the same round. Attacking with spines on an arm carrying a shield removes that shield’s AC bonus until the start of your next turn.
actions: Longsword +4 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. With Power Attack set to −1 and Cobalt Power invested: +3 melee, 1d8+5. Choose Power Attack before making attack rolls. Its modifier lasts until her next turn.

Primary arm spine +4 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. As a single attack, use the sword arm’s spines in place of the sword to keep the shield bonus. Using the shield arm costs 2 AC until the start of her next turn, leaving AC 15 and flat-footed AC 14.
Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.
builds.tactics: Sera is holding the lockgate while the crew checks a jammed chain. She keeps her shield up if the lane is crowded and uses a sword-arm spine if someone knocks the sword from her hand.

builds.title: Duskling ropeway guide, Totemist 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
skills: Jump +4 or +6 with 1 essentia in landshark boots
traits: Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1.

Two essentia, one racial and one from Totemist. Capacity 1 per investment. Meldshaper level 1. Shapes two unbound melds, blink shirt and landshark boots. Wild Empathy +1. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Class illiteracy applies.
Default allocation is 1 essentia in racial speed and 1 in blink shirt, giving 35-ft. movement and a 20-ft. teleport.
Racial movement gives a +5-ft. enhancement bonus to land speed per invested essentia. It applies with light or no armor and a light load.
Reallocate essentia among the eligible investments as a swift action on your turn. Pool size and the capacity of each investment are separate.
actions: Club +1 melee, 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach.
Light crossbow +2 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Blink shirt teleports the Totemist alone at will as a standard action. Range is 10 ft. plus 10 ft. per invested essentia. Take no further actions until the next turn.

Landshark boots give +4 competence on Jump, or +6 with 1 essentia. Moving the point from blink shirt to the boots keeps 35-ft. speed, changes teleport range from 20 to 10 ft., and raises Jump from +4 to +6.
builds.tactics: Iriavel can take a coil of line across the broken end of a ropeway by jumping or teleporting. He tells the party which span he can cross before asking them to brace the worn anchor.

builds.title: Diopsid scree hoist watch, Barbarian 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Neutral good. Unarmored, +4 natural armor. Touch 10, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +0, Will +1. Alertness gives +2 Listen and Spot. Barbarian illiteracy applies.
Fast movement adds 10 ft. with his light load and no armor. The 40-ft. speed gives +4 to Jump. His matching lower arm steadies his Large longsword, and it is a one-handed attack for him.
Immune to sleep effects. Monstrous Humanoid type.
Wings can be unfurled as an immediate action to descend at 60 ft. per round without falling damage. They grant no flight. A paralyzed, unconscious, or otherwise incapacitated Diopsid cannot use them.
Bioluminescence can be lit or doused at will as a free action. It sheds light in a 10-ft. radius and shadowy illumination for 20 ft. beyond that.
actions: Large longsword +4 melee, 2d6+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. No oversized attack penalty with the lower arms available for support.
Javelin +1 ranged, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.

Rage once per day, at most once per encounter, lasts 8 rounds. STR 20 and CON 20. HP 17, AC 12 (touch 8, flat-footed 12), grapple +6, Fortitude +7, Reflex +0, Will +3. Large longsword +6 for 2d6+5, javelin +1 for 1d6+5. Climb +9 and Jump +13. Remove 2 HP when it ends, then apply fatigue for the rest of the encounter (−2 Strength and Dexterity, no running or charging).
builds.tactics: Rivet keeps watch beside a scree hoist that has lost a guide chain. He can take the line down to a lower ledge with his wings while the party works the brake. If anything comes over the side, he braces the longsword with his lower hand.

builds.title: Diopsid iron gantry guard, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Lawful neutral. Custom studded leather +3, natural armor +4, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 17. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Improved Initiative adds +4.

Limb Symmetry lets this Fighter take Two-Weapon Fighting with Dexterity 12. Both Medium greatswords use two hands and gain 1½ times the Strength bonus. If using both weapons on a full attack, apply −4 to each attack because the off-hand weapon is non-light.
Immune to sleep effects. Monstrous Humanoid type.
Wings can be unfurled as an immediate action to descend at 60 ft. per round without falling damage. They grant no flight. A paralyzed, unconscious, or otherwise incapacitated Diopsid cannot use them.
Bioluminescence can be lit or doused at will as a free action. It sheds light in a 10-ft. radius and shadowy illumination for 20 ft. beyond that.
actions: One Medium greatsword +4 melee, 2d6+4 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Full attack with two greatswords, +0/+0 melee, 2d6+4 slashing each, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. This uses all four hands.
Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment. Free a hand before throwing it.
builds.tactics: Tongs can signal across the gantry with light while the porters cross. If something charges the line, Tongs makes one swing while moving into position and uses both swords only after settling into place.

builds.title: Duskling forest corridor watch, Barbarian 1 substitution
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
skills: Jump +9 at 40 ft., +5 at 30 or 35 ft.
traits: Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Class illiteracy applies.

One essentia, invested in Incarnum Speed by default. In light gear it gives 40-ft. speed and initiative +7. Without that investment, base speed is 30 ft. and initiative +5 with Improved Initiative. Moving the point to the racial feature instead gives 35-ft. speed and initiative +5.

The optional 1st-level Duskling Barbarian substitution uses a d10 Hit Die. Incarnum Speed replaces Fast Movement. Each invested point gives a +10-ft. enhancement bonus to base land speed with up to medium armor and a medium load. Each point also gives +2 insight on initiative checks, regardless of armor or load. The two enhancement bonuses to speed do not stack.
Reallocate essentia among the eligible investments as a swift action on your turn. Pool size and the capacity of each investment are separate.
actions: Greatclub +3 melee, 1d10+3 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. While raging, +5 melee and 1d10+6 damage.
Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment. While raging, 1d6+4 damage.

Ordinary rage once per day, at most once per encounter, up to 8 rounds. While raging, HP 15, AC 12, touch 9, flat-footed 11, grapple +5, Fortitude +7, Reflex +1, Will +3. STR 19, CON 20, Climb +7, and Jump +11 at 40 ft. Remove 2 bonus HP at the end. Fatigue lasts through the encounter with −2 Strength and Dexterity and no running or charging.
builds.tactics: Darevia wants a party to escort a delayed family through the forest corridor before it closes at dusk. She keeps a point in Incarnum Speed as she moves between clearings and rages to hold the narrow opening if a creature follows.

builds.title: Diabolus dry causeway keeper, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Chaotic good. Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +1. Against spells and spell-like effects: Fortitude +6, Reflex +4, Will +3. Armor check penalty −1.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (trident) adds +1 to melee and thrown trident attacks. Diaboli treat a trident as simple.

Tail poison has five doses per day from Constitution 14. The initial Fortitude save is DC 12, with no secondary effect. Table ruling for this encounter. Treat tail damage as piercing and spend one available dose per damaging tail hit. A hit that deals no damage spends no dose.
actions: Trident +4 melee or +4 thrown, 1d8+2 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. melee reach or 10-ft. range increment.
Tail −2 melee, 1d4+1 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Full attack with trident +4 and tail −2. The tail attack uses the secondary penalty.
On a damaging tail hit with a dose available, spend it and apply Fortitude DC 12. Failure sickens for 2d4 rounds. The tail still deals its normal damage if there is no dose left.
builds.tactics: Zareth wants to get a loaded handcart across the causeway before the water rises. He can warn another tail-code speaker about a loose stone. If something attacks the cart, he uses his trident from the narrow approach and adds the tail if he can stand and make a full attack.

builds.title: Diabolus echo stair interpreter, Sorcerer 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Chaotic good. Unarmored, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +2, Will +2. Against spells and spell-like effects: Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +4.

Spell Focus (Enchantment) adds +1 to enchantment save DCs. Sorcerer caster level 1. Spontaneous casting, five 0-level slots and four 1st-level slots per day. Carries a spell component pouch and has no familiar.

Tail poison has four doses per day from Constitution 12. The initial Fortitude save is DC 11, with no secondary effect. Table ruling for this encounter. Treat tail damage as piercing and spend one available dose per damaging tail hit. A hit that deals no damage spends no dose. Vessa can translate tail code into Common.
actions: Trident +0 melee or +2 thrown, 1d8 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. melee reach or 10-ft. range increment. Weapon Familiarity makes the trident simple.

Tail −5 melee, 1d4 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Full attack with trident +0 and tail −5. A damaging tail hit spends an available dose and sickens the target for 2d4 rounds unless it makes a DC 11 Fortitude save.

Charm person (1st): standard action, one Humanoid within 25 ft., Will DC 15 negates, duration 1 hour. Spell resistance applies. A target threatened or attacked by Vessa or her allies gets +5 on the save. On a failure, the target treats Vessa as a trusted ally. An unusual request takes a successful opposed Charisma check. A threat by Vessa or her allies breaks the spell.
Shield (1st): standard action, personal, 1 minute. AC becomes 16 and flat-footed AC 14. Ordinary touch AC remains 12. Stops magic missile and protects against incorporeal touch.

Cantrips known: daze, detect magic, light, and mage hand. Daze takes a standard action and targets one Humanoid with 4 HD or fewer within 25 ft. The target takes no actions for 1 round unless it makes a DC 14 Will save. Spell resistance applies.
builds.tactics: Vessa is relaying silent warnings along a stair where voices carry. She translates for surface travellers. She casts shield if someone corners her, and would rather persuade a frightened humanoid to let her pass than stay to fight.

builds.title: Korobokuru pass rescuer, Barbarian 1
builds.difficulty: CR 1
traits: Leather armor. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 13. Base attack bonus +1. Face 5 by 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Add +4 dodge AC against giants while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.
Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will −1. Add +2 on saves against poison and +2 on saves against spells or spell-like effects. Add +1 to attacks against goblinoids.
Toughness adds 3 HP. Fast movement adds 10 ft. with light gear. Illiterate as a first-level Barbarian.

Rage once per day, up to 6 rounds. Str 17, Con 17, HP 13, AC 12, Fortitude +5, Will +1. Rage HP go away when it ends. Patient or concentration-dependent tasks such as spellcasting and moving silently are unavailable during rage.
After rage, fatigued for the rest of the encounter: Str 11, Dex 10, AC 13, Reflex +0. Cannot charge or run.
actions: Short sword. Melee +3, reach 5 ft., 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. While raging +5, 1d6+3. While fatigued +2, 1d6.
Thrown dagger. Ranged +3, 10-ft. range increment, 1d4+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. While raging +3, 1d4+3. While fatigued +2, 1d4.
builds.tactics: Rig a safety line and get travelers off the exposed path. Stand between them and an attacker. Use rage if the evacuation is threatened. Withdraw once the last traveler reaches cover.

builds.title: River Spirit Folk ferry healer, Adept 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2
skills: Swim +7 for hazards or special actions
traits: River lineage. Breathes air and water. No routine swim check. Take 10 under pressure for Swim 17, and run while swimming in a straight line.
Unarmored. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 10. Base attack bonus +0. Fortitude +0, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Add +2 on saves against spells or spell-like effects with water in their names, water shugenja spells, and water-related wu jen spells.
Skill Focus (Heal) adds +2 in D&D 3.0. Prepared divine spells CL 1, DC 11 + spell level where applicable. Carries a divine focus.
actions: Club. Melee −1, reach 5 ft., 1d6−1 bludgeoning (minimum 1), critical ×2.
Prepared cantrips. Cure minor wounds twice per day, touch, restores 1 HP per cast. Create water once per day, creates up to two gallons of clean water.
Prepared 1st-level spells. Cure light wounds once per day, touch, restores 1d8+1 HP. Bless once per day, allies in a 50-ft. burst gain +1 morale to attack rolls and saves against fear for 1 minute.
River lineage. Speak with animals once per day for up to 1 minute, CL 1, fish only.
builds.tactics: Move injured passengers behind cover, use healing on the worst injury, and use the river route when the landing is unsafe. Cast bless if allies need to hold the crossing.

builds.title: Catfolk market mediator, Bard 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2.
traits: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, and natural armor +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +2.
Skill Focus (Diplomacy) gives +3. Listen and Move Silently already include racial bonuses. Bardic Knowledge +2.
Caster level 1. She knows four 0-level spells and can cast two per day. Light armor is compatible with her bard spells.
One Bardic Music use per day shared by Inspire Courage, Countersong and Fascinate. Begin a performance as a standard action. She can't cast spells while performing.
actions: Light crossbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action. Dagger −1 melee, 1d4−1 piercing or slashing, minimum 1, critical 19–20/×2.
Inspire Courage +1 morale on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, and saves against charm and fear, for allies who hear her. It lasts while they hear her and for 5 rounds afterward.

Countersong lasts up to 10 rounds. Roll Perform (oratory) +7 each round. A creature within 30 ft. can substitute that result for a lower save against a sonic or language-dependent magical attack. A creature already under such an ongoing effect that allows a save saves again each round it hears her, using her Perform result.

Fascinate one creature within 90 ft. that can see, hear, and pay attention to her. Tavira must see it too. Its Will save DC is her Perform result. If it saves, she must wait 24 hours before trying again. On failure it listens without acting for up to 1 round of concentration, with −4 on reactive skill checks. Nearby combat prevents Fascinate. A possible threat prompts a new Perform check and save. An overt threat ends it.
0-level spells known: detect magic, light, mage hand, message.
builds.tactics: Compare the two versions of the trade terms before the market closes. Ask the witness to read the tally aloud, or use Message to confer privately across the crowd. If the crowd panics, use Inspire Courage to steady allies who can hear her.

builds.title: Chaos Gnome lantern mender, Sorcerer 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2.
traits: Unarmored, Dexterity +3 and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 11. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +2.
+4 dodge AC against Giant-type creatures while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.

Against Giant-type creatures, AC 18 or AC 22 with mage armor while able to dodge. Touch 18 includes the dodge bonus. Skill Focus (Spellcraft) and racial Listen bonus are included. Immune to confusion effects. Familiar slot open.
Luck of Chaos (Ex) allows one reroll per day of a roll the gnome just made, before the DM announces success or failure. Keep the new result even if it is worse.
Spell Power adds +1 effective caster level to spells with the chaos descriptor. It applies to level-dependent spell variables and caster level checks and stacks with other Spell Power abilities.
actions: Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Small dagger +0 melee, 1d3−1 piercing or slashing, minimum 1 damage, critical 19–20/×2.

Five 0-level slots and four 1st-level slots per day. Known 0-level spells are detect magic, light, message, and ray of frost. Known 1st-level spells are mage armor and protection from law. Base caster level 1 and spell save DC 13 + spell level.
Mage armor gives AC 18, flat-footed 15, for 1 hour. Ray of frost is a +4 ranged touch attack within 25 ft. for 1d3 cold damage. Spell Power casts protection from law at caster level 2 for 2 minutes.

Protection from law wards one creature touched. It grants +2 deflection AC and +2 resistance on saves against lawful creatures’ attacks or effects. It blocks new possession and suppresses ongoing mental control regardless of alignment. It also blocks contact by lawful summoned creatures. The contact ward ends if the subject attacks a blocked creature or forces the barrier against it. Spell resistance can bypass the contact ward.
Entropic shield 1/day at caster level 1. The personal effect lasts 1 minute and gives ranged attacks that require an attack roll a 20% miss chance.

Daze, flare, and prestidigitation 1/day each at caster level 1. Daze affects a humanoid of 4 HD or less. On a failed Will DC 13 save, the target takes no actions for 1 round. Flare is Fortitude DC 13 or dazzled for 1 minute.
builds.tactics: Orrin wants help drying out the flooded lantern stock before the procession arrives. He uses mage armor if the work area is threatened and protection from law at the first sign of trouble from a lawful summoned creature.

builds.title: Dvati crossroad chorus, Bard 2 twin pair
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3 for the pair. ECL 3 (2 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Chaotic good. The listed combat stats are per twin. One Hit Die roll per level, using 6 and 4 on d6s. Each twin gets 5 from the dice and 4 from Constitution, for 9 HP each. Track each body’s hit points independently.

Each has studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +3. Armor check penalty −1. Skill Focus (Perform [sing]) adds +3. Bardic knowledge +3.

One shared pool of two bardic music uses, three 0-level spell slots, and one 1st-level slot per day. Bard caster level 2. Both carry components. Both twins normally take the casting actions together, with one providing materials. One twin can cast alone if the other takes no actions during the casting. Even a free action by the other twin ruins the attempt and loses the spell.
Pair Link gives both twins +3 to hit when they flank the same foe together. When one twin successfully aids the other’s attack or AC, the bonus is +4.

Echo Attack requires both twins to spend a move action speaking while flanking the same creature. Make one Perform (sing) check for the Will save DC. On a failed save choose +1 to both twins’ attacks against that creature or +1 to their AC against its attacks for one round. A creature must be able to hear and be flanked.
Table ruling for these encounters. Roll initiative once for the pair and resolve both turns on that count. Declare shared casting and Echo Attack together.
actions: Each twin has a short sword +1, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, and a shortbow +3, 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, 60-ft. increment. When both flank with swords, each is +4 to hit, or +5 with the Echo Attack bonus to attack.

Inspire courage starts as a standard action and spends one shared music use. +1 morale on attacks, weapon damage, and saves against charm and fear for allies who hear it, while it is heard and for five rounds afterward. Countersong helps listeners within 30 ft. use their Perform result against sonic or language-dependent magical attacks. Fascinate affects one attentive target within 90 ft. outside combat distractions and uses one Perform (sing) check as the Will DC.
Expeditious retreat (1st): standard action, personal, base land speed rises to 60 ft. for 2 minutes. Both twins benefit on the same plane. It spends their one shared 1st-level slot.
Cure light wounds (1st): standard action, touch, restores 1d8+2 HP to one willing living target, including one twin. It uses the same shared 1st-level slot as expeditious retreat.
Cantrips known: detect magic, light, mage hand, message, and prestidigitation.
builds.tactics: Aven and Iven are directing travellers along a forked road. If they need to reach both ends quickly, they declare one shared casting of expeditious retreat. If a traveller is hurt, they keep the same slot for cure light wounds instead.

builds.title: Dvati split floodgate wardens, Fighter 1 twin pair
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2 for the pair. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Lawful good. The listed combat stats are per twin. Both share the maximum first Hit Die result of 10. Each gets 5 from the die and 2 from Constitution, for 7 HP each. Damage to either twin is tracked separately.

Each has a chain shirt +4 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1. Armor check penalty −2. Improved Initiative adds +4, and Weapon Focus (spear) adds +1 to spear attacks.
Pair Link gives both twins +3 to hit when they flank the same foe together. When one twin successfully aids the other’s attack or AC, the bonus is +4.

Echo Attack requires both twins to spend a move action speaking while flanking the same creature. Make one Perform (sing) check for the Will save DC. On a failed save choose +1 to both twins’ attacks against that creature or +1 to their AC against its attacks for one round. A creature must be able to hear and be flanked.
Table ruling for these encounters. Roll initiative once for the pair and resolve both turns on that count. Declare shared casting and Echo Attack together.
actions: Each twin has a spear +5 melee, 1d8+4 piercing, critical ×3, 5-ft. reach. Thrown spear +3, 1d8+3 piercing, critical ×3, 20-ft. increment.

When both flank the same foe, each spear is +8. On a failed Echo Attack save against one shared 1d20+2 Perform (sing) check, choose +9 spear attacks against that foe or AC 16 against its attacks for one round.
Aid Another as a standard action in melee. Make a spear attack roll against AC 10 to give the other twin +4 on the relevant attack or to AC against the next attack from that opponent.
builds.tactics: Mara and Sera guard two pin wheels on opposite sides of the floodgate. They can warn each other through the stone telepathically. If a creature forces the crossing, they take both sides of it or have one help the other secure a clear strike.

builds.title: Chaos Gnome roadside mediator, Cleric 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2.
traits: Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +1, size +1. Touch 12, flat-footed 17. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +4.
+4 dodge AC against Giant-type creatures while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.
Against Giant-type creatures, AC 22 and touch 16 while able to dodge. Skill Focus (Diplomacy) and racial Listen bonus are included. Immune to confusion effects.
Luck of Chaos (Ex) allows one reroll per day of a roll the gnome just made, before the DM announces success or failure. Keep the new result even if it is worse.

A chaotic good cleric devoted to the ideals of freedom and charity. Chaos and Good domains add +1 caster level to chaos and good spells respectively. The Chaos domain bonus stacks with racial Spell Power.
actions: Small light mace +1 melee, 1d4 bludgeoning, critical ×2.
Small dart +2 ranged, 1d3 piercing, critical ×2, 20-ft. increment.

Prepared 0-level spells are detect magic, guidance, and light. Prepared 1st-level spells are bless and cure light wounds, with protection from law in the domain slot. Base caster level 1 and spell save DC 12 + spell level. Spontaneously trade non-domain prepared spells for cures of the same level or lower.
Protection from law uses effective caster level 3 and lasts 3 minutes.
Turn undead 4/day. Turning check 1d20+1 and turning damage 2d6+2, as a 1st-level cleric.

Protection from law wards one creature touched. It grants +2 deflection AC and +2 resistance on saves against lawful creatures’ attacks or effects. It blocks new possession and suppresses ongoing mental control regardless of alignment. It also blocks contact by lawful summoned creatures. The contact ward ends if the subject attacks a blocked creature or forces the barrier against it. Spell resistance can bypass the contact ward.
Entropic shield 1/day at caster level 1. The personal effect lasts 1 minute and gives ranged attacks that require an attack roll a 20% miss chance.
