Daze, flare, and prestidigitation 1/day each at caster level 1. Daze affects a humanoid of 4 HD or less. On a failed Will DC 11 save, the target takes no actions for 1 round. Flare is Fortitude DC 11 or dazzled for 1 minute.
builds.tactics: Pella has stopped both wagons at the bridge until the damaged cargo is counted. She asks the party to hear each driver’s claim. If a lawful summoned guard intervenes, Pella casts protection from law on the person closest to it.

builds.title: Shifter Wildhunt trail ranger, Ranger 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +1.
Alertness and bonus Track. Wild Empathy +0. Favored enemy magical beasts adds +2 weapon damage and +2 to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot and Survival against magical beasts.
Wildhunt shifts once per day as a free action for 6 rounds. Constitution rises from 14 to 16. HP rises from 10 to 11 and Fortitude from +4 to +5. Remove the 1 bonus HP when shifting ends.

Wildhunt scent detects a creature at 30 ft., 60 ft. upwind, or 15 ft. downwind. Double those ranges for strong odors and triple them for overpowering odors. A move action identifies direction. Within 5 ft., pinpoint the source.

While shifting, a Wildhunt Shifter with Track can follow scent using Survival. A typical fresh trail is DC 10 and adds +2 per hour, with adjustments for odor and group size. Ignore surface and poor-visibility modifiers.
actions: Short sword +2 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Longbow +4 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, 100-ft. increment.
builds.tactics: Iona follows a fresh scent once the party identifies which equipment belonged to the missing pack train. She saves Wildhunt for the stretch where the trail crosses bare rock.

builds.title: Shifter Razorclaw latchguard, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +3 or +4 while shifting. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1.
Weapon Focus (short sword) is the Fighter bonus feat. Healing Factor is a shifter feat. Its extra round makes this shift last 6 rounds. Heal 1 HP when a shift ends while Dane is alive.
Razorclaw shifts once per day as a free action. Strength rises from 15 to 17 and two claws become available while shifting.
actions: Short sword +4 melee, 1d6+2 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. While shifting, +5 melee and 1d6+3 piercing if used alone.
Light crossbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
While shifting, one claw as a standard action or both as a full attack. Each claw is +4 melee, 1d4+3 piercing and slashing.
First-printing mixed full attack while shifting. Apply −2 to both attacks. Short sword +3 melee for 1d6+3 and light off-hand claw +2 melee for 1d4+1.
builds.tactics: Dane asks the party to secure the mill latch while the repairers file through. He uses Razorclaw if something gets through the gap and switches between a single short sword attack and a two-claw full attack when he has the time and room.

builds.title: Buomman north gate listener, Monk 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Lawful good. This encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Unarmored with Dexterity +2 and Wisdom +3. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +2. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +5. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Wisdom 16 and Charisma 8 reflect the racial adjustments. Monk unarmed damage is 1d6. Racial Listen and Perform (sing) bonuses are included.

The racial vow is against speech. A breach deals 1 Wisdom damage and applies −2 on attack rolls, saves, and checks for 24 hours. A further breach before expiry deals another point of Wisdom damage and extends the same penalty for another 24 hours.

After the first vow breach, Wisdom 15 and Wisdom modifier +2. AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 12. Fortitude +2, Reflex +2, Will +2. Initiative checks +4, Listen +6, Perform (sing) +3. Stunning Fist DC 12 until Wisdom recovers.
actions: Unarmed strike +2 melee, 1d6+2 bludgeoning (lethal or nonlethal), critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Full-attack flurry +0/+0 for 1d6+2 each, with its −2 attack penalty also applying to other attacks before his next turn. On a vow breach, +0 single attack or −2/−2 flurry.

Stunning Fist once per day as a Monk bonus feat. Declare before rolling. On a hit, Fortitude DC 13 or stun for 1 round. A miss expends the use. Constructs, oozes, plants, undead, incorporeal creatures, and creatures immune to critical hits are immune.
Shuriken +2 ranged, 1d2+2 piercing, critical ×2, 10-ft. increment.
builds.tactics: Morrow listens beside the north gate while the last visitors come in. He can give their keeper a Buommi departure song and point to the sheltered entrance. If a pursuer gets through, he tries to stop it with a stunning strike.

builds.title: Buomman cairn road healer, Cleric 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Neutral good Cleric of Fharlanghn, Protection and Travel domains. This encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +5. Armor check penalty −4.

Nonverbal Spell uses audible Buommi song in place of verbal words. It keeps the vow and spends no higher-level slot. Magical silence still stops these castings. She keeps one hand free for somatic components.

Cleric caster level 1. Three prepared cantrips, two prepared 1st-level spells and one domain slot. Save DC 13 for cantrips and 14 for 1st-level spells if applicable. As a good Cleric, she can exchange a prepared non-domain spell for a cure spell of that level.

Travel domain freedom of movement applies automatically for up to 1 round per day against magical effects that impede movement. Turn undead twice per day (turning check 1d20−1, turning damage 2d6 HD).

The racial vow is against speech. A breach deals 1 Wisdom damage and applies −2 on attack rolls, saves, and checks for 24 hours. A further breach before expiry deals another point of Wisdom damage and extends the same penalty for another 24 hours.
actions: Heavy mace +1 melee, 1d8+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach.

Prepared cantrips are detect magic (60-ft. cone, concentrate up to 1 minute), guidance (touch, +1 competence on one attack, save, or skill check within 1 minute), and light (object touched, 10 minutes).
Bless (1st): allies within a 50-ft. burst centered on her gain +1 morale on attacks and saves against fear for 1 minute.
Shield of faith (1st): touch, +2 deflection AC for 1 minute. On herself AC 19, touch 13, flat-footed 18.

Longstrider (1st-level Travel domain slot): personal, land speed 40 ft. for 1 hour. Spontaneous cure light wounds can instead use bless or shield of faith’s slot and heals one willing living target for 1d8+1 HP by touch.
Protection domain ward once per day, standard action and touch. Give +1 resistance on the next saving throw within 1 hour.
builds.tactics: Lumen follows the cairns looking for an injured road surveyor. She sings as she casts and points out the stones the party can use to mark the way back. If someone needs healing, she gives up a prepared non-domain spell.

builds.title: Catfolk perimeter escort, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2.
traits: Chain shirt +4, Dexterity +4, and natural armor +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 15. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +1.
Chain shirt check penalty −2. Jump includes +4 for speed 40 ft. Listen and Move Silently include +2 racial bonuses and have no purchased ranks.
Two-Weapon Fighting is the Fighter bonus feat. Catfolk Pounce is a separate feat. It applies only when Keshar charges a flat-footed opponent.
actions: Short sword +3 melee, 1d6+2 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. With both short swords in a normal full attack, +1/+1, for 1d6+2 on the main hand and 1d6+1 on the off hand.

Charge one attack at +5, 1d6+2 piercing. With Catfolk Pounce on a qualifying charge, make both short sword attacks at +3/+3, with normal damage by hand. Apply the charge’s −2 AC until the start of his next turn.
builds.tactics: Move the healer toward the camp by the clear path and keep a separate exit open. If combat blocks the way, charge only when there is a clear line and a flat-footed foe for the pounce.

builds.title: Badger Hengeyokai cave surveyor, Expert 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 2.
builds.size: Medium in human and hybrid form
builds.speed: Human 30 ft., hybrid 20 ft. and burrow 10 ft.
builds.senses: Low-light vision in hybrid and animal forms
builds.languages: Common, Hengeyokai; badger communication in hybrid or animal form
traits: Human scores listed. Hybrid Con 15 with the other scores unchanged. Leather armor gives AC 12, touch 10, and flat-footed 12 in either form.
Human Fortitude +1, Reflex +0, Will +0. Hybrid Fortitude +2, Reflex +0, Will +0. Base attack bonus +0. Skill Focus (Profession, mine surveyor) adds +2 under 3.0.

Animal form: Tiny badger, AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12, initiative +3. Walk 30 ft., burrow 10 ft. Str 8, Dex 17, Con 15. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +0. Merged gear. Add +10 circumstance to Disguise in animal form.
Use the same 5 maximum HP in all forms under the original 3.0 polymorph hit-point rule. Start in hybrid form. Two supernatural changes per day, each full-round and provoking an attack of opportunity.
actions: Club in human or hybrid form. Melee +1, 5-ft. reach, 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2.
Animal form. One claw +1 melee for 1d2−1, minimum 1. Full attack: two claws +1 each and secondary bite −4 for 1d3−1, minimum 1 per hit. Tiny natural reach 0 ft.
builds.tactics: Check timber supports before anyone enters. Use the animal form to inspect a tight gap if necessary. Report back in hybrid form and help guide people out if the tunnel shifts.

builds.title: Illumian lock surveyor, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2.
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +0.
Luminous Sigils (Su) orbit the head and give candlelight. Douse them as a standard action to suspend power sigil bonuses and word abilities. Restore them as a free action.

Aesh and Uur add +2 to Strength and Dexterity checks and related skill checks. Bonuses are already included. With sigils doused, initiative drops to +2 and Climb, Hide, Move Silently, Open Lock, and Tumble drop to +7.

Glyphic Resonance (Ex) applies when a spell’s name includes glyph, rune, sigil, or symbol. If the Illumian’s character level is below the spell’s caster level, take a −4 racial penalty on its saves. At or above that caster level, gain immunity to the spell.
+2 racial bonus on saves against spells with the shadow descriptor.

Final Utterance lasts 2 rounds. Trapfinding allows Search checks for traps above DC 20 and Disable Device checks against magic traps. Evasion negates damage on a successful Reflex save for half while in light or no armor. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot.
actions: Rapier +3 melee, 1d6+2 piercing, critical 18–20/×2.
Shortbow +3 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, 60-ft. increment.

Sneak attack adds 1d6 when Eshara flanks the target or it is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. The target must be vulnerable to critical hits, with a vital spot Eshara can see and reach and no concealment from her.
Aeshuur gives +2 dodge AC against a creature Eshara damages with a sneak attack or critical hit. The bonus lasts until the start of Eshara’s next turn and requires lit sigils.
builds.tactics: Eshara will survey the lock chamber if the party keeps the winch still. She douses her sigils before hiding and relights them to work at the lock. In a fight she flanks an opponent with an ally to trigger Aeshuur.

builds.title: Neraph lamp ramp outrider, Ranger 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Chaotic good. The encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Studded leather +3, natural armor +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 15. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1.

Ranger martial proficiency covers the annulat through Weapon Familiarity. Point Blank Shot adds +1 on ranged attack rolls and damage within 30 ft. Wild empathy +0, Track as a bonus feat, and no spells at Ranger 1.
Favored Enemy is outsiders with the Chaotic subtype. Against them add +2 weapon damage and +2 to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks. Chaotic alignment alone does not qualify.

Neraph Camouflage is an extraordinary ability. Declare it on one charge attack or thrown-weapon attack per enemy per encounter. Those options share the one use against that enemy. The target loses its Dexterity bonus to AC against that attack, with ordinary consequences such as eligibility for sneak attack.
actions: Longsword +3 melee, 1d8+2 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. On a charge +5 melee, with AC 15 until the next turn. Camouflage on that charge denies Dexterity AC for the attack.
Annulat +3 ranged, 1d6+2 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 30-ft. increment. Point Blank Shot brings this to +4 and 1d6+3 within 30 ft. before range modifiers. Reduce a target’s cover bonus by 2.

Camouflaged annulat example at 20 ft.: against a target with AC 16 from base 10, Dexterity +2, and ordinary cover +4, roll at +4 against AC 12. The camouflage removes +2 Dexterity and annulat proficiency reduces cover to +2. This uses the same per-target option as a camouflaged charge.
builds.tactics: Teo wants to bring a replacement lamp across the ramp. He asks the party to check the rail and keeps his one camouflage use against each opponent for whichever opening exists first: a clear charge or a clear throw.

builds.title: Neraph split ledge courier, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Chaotic neutral. The encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Studded leather +3, natural armor +2, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 15. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1.
Trapfinding, sneak attack +1d6, and Point Blank Shot. Search can locate traps above DC 20 and Disable Device can handle magical traps. Use ordinary thieves’ tools.

Neraph Camouflage is an extraordinary ability. Declare it on one charge attack or thrown-weapon attack per enemy per encounter. Those options share the one use against that enemy. The target loses its Dexterity bonus to AC against that attack, with ordinary consequences such as eligibility for sneak attack.
actions: Short sword +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Charge at +3, with AC 16 until the next turn.
Javelin +3 ranged, 1d6+1 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment. Within 30 ft., Point Blank Shot gives +4 and 1d6+2 before range modifiers.

A camouflaged javelin within 30 ft. can deal 1d6+2 plus 1d6 sneak attack against a qualifying creature. Camouflage denies Dexterity AC on that throw. Once used, Mai cannot camouflage a charge or another throw against that creature this encounter.
builds.tactics: Mai needs to get a message across the split ledge before the watch moves. She uses Jump to cross when the gap is safe and watches for a trapped foothold. If a guard corners her, she can use a camouflaged javelin once against that guard and then retreats.

builds.title: Illumian inscription reader, Wizard 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Unarmored. Touch 11, flat-footed 10. With mage armor, AC 15 and flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Luminous Sigils (Su) orbit the head and give candlelight. Douse them as a standard action to suspend power sigil bonuses and word abilities. Restore them as a free action.
At 1st level, Naen adds +1 to Intelligence checks and Intelligence-based skill checks. With sigils doused, Decipher Script and Knowledge (arcana) drop to +6 and Spellcraft to +9.

Glyphic Resonance (Ex) applies when a spell’s name includes glyph, rune, sigil, or symbol. If the Illumian’s character level is below the spell’s caster level, take a −4 racial penalty on its saves. At or above that caster level, gain immunity to the spell.
+2 racial bonus on saves against spells with the shadow descriptor.
Final Utterance lasts 1 round. Feats are Scribe Scroll and Skill Focus (Spellcraft). Familiar slot is unfilled. Prepared spells use caster level 1 and save DC 12 + spell level.
actions: Dagger −1 melee, 1d4−1 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Minimum 1 damage on a hit.
Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Prepared 0-level spells are detect magic, light, and read magic. Prepared 1st-level spells are grease and mage armor.
Mage armor gives +4 armor AC for 1 hour. Grease makes a 10-ft. square slippery within 25 ft. for 1 round, Reflex DC 13 or fall. Moving through the area requires a DC 10 Balance check at half speed.
builds.tactics: Veyric asks the party to search for the missing rubbing before anyone touches the inscribed threshold. He examines the marks by sigil light and uses grease to hinder pursuit if the group has to retreat.

builds.title: Stonechild cartwright, 2 Outsider HD and Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 4. ECL 7.
traits: Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, natural armor +4, and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 20. Armor check penalty −4. BAB +3, grapple +9. Fortitude +11, Reflex +4, Will +4.
Immune to acid and poison.
Blind-Fight is racial. The other feats are Skill Focus (Craft [stoneworking]), Power Attack, and Weapon Focus (warhammer). Weapon Focus and Skill Focus are included in the totals.
Search gives +2 synergy on Survival to follow tracks. Knowledge (the planes) gives +2 synergy on Survival on other planes. Apply both when both conditions hold.
Miren is on the Material Plane. Her two racial Hit Dice and one Fighter Hit Die give three Hit Dice total. The +4 level adjustment gives effective character level 7.
actions: Warhammer +10 melee, 1d8+6 bludgeoning, critical ×3, 5-ft. reach. For Power Attack, subtract up to 3 from melee attack rolls and add the same number to damage with the one-handed warhammer.
Javelin +4 ranged, 1d6+6 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.
Magic Stone 3/day, caster level 3. Miren can throw an enchanted pebble at +5.

Each use of Magic Stone (Sp) enchants up to three touched pebbles for 30 minutes or until discharged. The printed spell lists 1d6+1 damage on a hit, or 2d6+2 against undead. Use a normal ranged attack with a +1 enhancement bonus, at a 20-ft. increment if thrown or 50 ft. if slung.
builds.tactics: Miren checks the cracked axle before anyone pulls the cart across the ford. She asks the party to bring the two stone bearing blocks from upstream. If the disturbance reaches the bank, she uses her shield to cover the crew and saves enchanted pebbles for undead.

builds.title: Stonechild quarry marker, Stonechild monster class 3
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 3.
traits: Studded leather +3, natural armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. Armor check penalty −1. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +7, Reflex +3, Will +2.
Immune to acid and poison.

Nalin has one racial Hit Die at monster-class level 3, which is effective character level 3. The progression gives him +4 Strength, +6 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, and −2 Charisma. The second Hit Die and Blind-Fight arrive at level 4.
Each listed class skill has four ranks. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot, already included. Nalin is on the Material Plane.
actions: Longspear +4 melee, 1d8+4 piercing, critical ×3, hits at 10 ft.
Heavy mace +4 melee, 1d8+3 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach.
Magic Stone 1/day, caster level 3. Nalin can throw an enchanted pebble at +3.

Each use of Magic Stone (Sp) enchants up to three touched pebbles for 30 minutes or until discharged. The printed spell lists 1d6+1 damage on a hit, or 2d6+2 against undead. Use a normal ranged attack with a +1 enhancement bonus, at a 20-ft. increment if thrown or 50 ft. if slung.
builds.tactics: Nalin is replacing chipped boundary markers before the quarry crews change shifts. He asks the party to walk the new line with him and find the marker that moved overnight. If threatened, he keeps watch from behind the boundary wall with three enchanted pebbles at hand.

builds.title: Kalashtar witness mediator, Psion 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Unarmored with Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +1, Will +3.
+2 racial on saving throws against mind-affecting spells and abilities and against possession.
Kalashtar sleep. They are immune to dream, nightmare, and other effects that rely on their ability to dream.
Telepathy discipline. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot, already included. Psionic Talent adds 2 power points.

Six power points per day. Two base, one bonus from Intelligence, one racial, and two from Psionic Talent. Class manifester level 1, with at most 1 power point spent per manifestation. Save DC 13 + power level.
actions: Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Dagger −1 melee, 1d4−1 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2, minimum 1 damage.

Known 1st-level powers are inertial armor, mind thrust, and mindlink. Each costs 1 power point at this level. Inertial armor gives +4 armor AC for 1 hour. Mind thrust is mind-affecting and deals 1d10 damage to one target within 25 ft. Will DC 14 negates. Power resistance applies.

Racial Mindlink (Ps) 1/day is separate from the power point reserve. Resolve it as a Wilder of half the Kalashtar’s Hit Dice, rounded down, minimum manifester level 1. It grants no general manifester levels.

With the Expanded Psionics Handbook, use its Mindlink rules. At manifester level 1, use a standard action to link with one willing creature of Intelligence 3 or higher within 25 ft. for 10 minutes. The willing target gets no saving throw. Power resistance applies as harmless. Treat it as mind-affecting.

For racial Mindlink without the Expanded Psionics Handbook, link with one willing creature of Intelligence 3 or higher within 30 ft. for 1 round at character level 1. This mind-affecting link allows no saving throw or spell resistance.
Once formed, either link carries telepathic communication across any distance on the same plane without requiring a shared language. The bond conveys no influence or control.
builds.tactics: Seravakri asks each witness for permission before opening a mindlink. She listens to both accounts of the warehouse dispute and asks the party to check which crates were signed in. If threatened, she uses inertial armor and withdraws to the public room.

builds.title: Shadowswyft covered stair runner, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Chaotic good. This encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Initiative includes Improved Initiative +4 and the species bonus +2.
Trapfinding and sneak attack +1d6. She can Search for traps above DC 20 and use Disable Device on magical traps. The 40-ft. land speed adds +4 to Jump.
Light Blindness is extraordinary. Abrupt exposure to bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds the Shadowswyft for 1 round. Afterward, it remains dazzled while in the affected area.

While blinded, AC 11 and touch AC 8 after losing Dexterity AC and taking −2 AC. Move at half speed, 20 ft. Sight-dependent checks fail. Search and most Strength- or Dexterity-based skill checks take −4 when they can be attempted. Opponents have total concealment (50% miss chance).
Dazzled in bright light after the first round. AC 16 and movement 40 ft. Short sword +0, light crossbow +2, Search +4, and Spot +4.
actions: Short sword +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Light crossbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.

Sneak attack adds +1d6 when the target is otherwise eligible and denied Dexterity AC or flanked by her melee attack. Ranged attack requires a target within 30 ft. Total concealment from blindness prevents the sneak attack while she cannot see the target’s vital area.
builds.tactics: Mheer is carrying the stairs’ spare key before the watch closes the covered passage. She can check the landing in dim light. If the upper shutter opens suddenly onto the sun, she feels for the rail and asks the party to guide her toward shade.

builds.title: Shadowswyft gloam road lookout, Ranger 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Chaotic good. This encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +3, Reflex +5, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Initiative includes the species bonus +2.

Point Blank Shot adds +1 to ranged attack and damage within 30 ft. Favored enemy undead adds +2 to weapon damage and Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival against undead. Track is a bonus feat. Wild empathy +0. No spells at Ranger 1.
Light Blindness is extraordinary. Abrupt exposure to bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds the Shadowswyft for 1 round. Afterward, it remains dazzled while in the affected area.

While blinded, AC 11 and touch AC 8 after losing Dexterity AC and taking −2 AC. Move at half speed, 20 ft. Sight-dependent checks fail. Search and most Strength- or Dexterity-based skill checks take −4 when they can be attempted. Opponents have total concealment (50% miss chance).
Dazzled in bright light after the first round. AC 16 and movement 40 ft. Longsword +1, longbow +3 or +4 within 30 ft. before range modifiers, Search +4, and Spot +4.
actions: Longsword +2 melee, 1d8+1 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Longbow +4 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, 100-ft. increment. Point Blank Shot gives +5 and 1d8+1 within 30 ft.
A longbow hit against undead within 30 ft. deals 1d8+3 with Point Blank Shot and Favored Enemy. When dazzled that shot is +4 and deals the same damage.
builds.tactics: Pohl watches for undead along a road where two stone arches give cover after dusk. He asks the party to walk the late travellers through the arches. If daylight blinds him, he backs away from the road on the first round and resumes watching when he can see.

builds.title: Kalashtar quay interpreter, Expert 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 1.
skills: Disguise +6, or +8 to impersonate a human
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +1, Will +4.

Kalashtar sleep. They are immune to dream, nightmare, and other effects that rely on their ability to dream.
Skill Focus (Diplomacy) adds +3, already included. Each of the seven listed Expert skills has four ranks.
Naturally Psionic gives one racial power point. Use racial Mindlink once per day without spending that point. Tarenkhad has no known class powers or general manifester level.
actions: Club +0 melee, 1d6 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach.
Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.

Racial Mindlink (Ps) 1/day is separate from the power point reserve. Resolve it as a Wilder of half the Kalashtar’s Hit Dice, rounded down, minimum manifester level 1. It grants no general manifester levels.

With the Expanded Psionics Handbook, use its Mindlink rules. At manifester level 1, use a standard action to link with one willing creature of Intelligence 3 or higher within 25 ft. for 10 minutes. The willing target gets no saving throw. Power resistance applies as harmless. Treat it as mind-affecting.

For racial Mindlink without the Expanded Psionics Handbook, link with one willing creature of Intelligence 3 or higher within 30 ft. for 1 round at character level 1. This mind-affecting link allows no saving throw or spell resistance.
Once formed, either link carries telepathic communication across any distance on the same plane without requiring a shared language. The bond conveys no influence or control.
builds.tactics: Tarenkhad has one daily mindlink and saves it for a willing passenger with whom the dock crew shares no language. He asks the party to keep the berth open while he establishes the link and locates the passenger’s missing luggage.

builds.title: Elan archive conservator, Seer Psion 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Touch 11, flat-footed 10. With Inertial Armor, AC 15, touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Manifester level 1, Seer discipline. 5 PP per day: 2 class, 1 Intelligence, 2 Elan. Each known power costs 1 PP. No known power here requires a save.
Investigator adds +2 to Search and Gather Information. Psion bonus feat Combat Manifestation gives +4 on Concentration to manifest defensively or while grappled or pinned.
Resistance: 1 PP, immediate action, +4 racial bonus to all saves until the start of the next action. Resilience: immediate action, reduce incoming damage by 2 HP per PP spent.
Repletion: 1 PP for 24 hours without food or water. A flat-footed Elan cannot use either immediate defense. All three abilities draw from the same reserve.
actions: Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft. Reload as a move action. Dagger −1 melee, 1d4−1 piercing or slashing (minimum 1), critical 19–20/×2.
Inertial Armor, 1 PP. Standard action, personal. Gain +4 armor AC for 1 hour. This armor bonus applies against incorporeal touch attacks.
Call to Mind, 1 PP. Take 1 minute to retry a failed Knowledge check with a +4 competence bonus.

Detect Psionics, 1 PP. Standard action, 60-ft. cone, concentration up to 1 minute. First round detects presence, second reveals number and strongest aura, third locates and gives the strength of each aura.
builds.tactics: Read the overwritten entry from the gallery where the original ledger still catches the light. Reserve enough points for one defense. If threatened, use cover and the crossbow while the party gets the ledgers clear.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.languages: Common, Dwarven, and communication with badgers as speak with animals.
builds.title: Wildren ashbank burrow scout, Barbarian 1
traits: Chaotic good. Material Plane. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1, touch 11, flat-footed 12. Barbarian fast movement adds 10 ft. to land speed in light armor with a light load.
BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +6, Reflex +1, Will +1. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot. Illiterate.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while firmly grounded. Strength-based resistance is +7 before Fury or rage, +9 with one, and +11 with both.

Fury (Ex), 1/day. After taking at least 1 point of damage, the Wildren can activate Fury at the start of its next turn. For one round, it gains +4 Strength and takes −2 AC. It cannot end Fury voluntarily. Fury stacks with barbarian rage.

Barbarian rage 1/day lasts 9 rounds (3 + raging Constitution modifier of +6). It adds +4 Strength, +4 Constitution, and +2 morale on Will saves, and applies −2 AC. Fortitude becomes +8, Will becomes +3, and current and maximum HP rise by 2 for the duration. After rage, Rusk is fatigued for the rest of the encounter.
actions: One claw +4 melee as a standard attack, or two claws at +4 each in a full attack. Each deals 1d4+3 piercing and slashing, critical ×2, reach 5 ft.
With Fury or rage alone, claws attack at +6 each for 1d4+5 and AC drops to 11. With both active, claws attack at +8 each for 1d4+7 and AC drops to 9 for the one round of overlap.
builds.tactics: Rusk uses scent to check the ashbank for missing woodcutters. He follows a trail through broken ground and burrows through loose earth if a surface passage collapses. When injured, he decides at the start of his next turn whether to spend Fury.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.languages: Common, Dwarven, and communication with badgers as speak with animals.
builds.title: Wildren cutbank warren guard, Fighter 1
traits: Neutral good. Material Plane. Scale mail +4, touch 10, flat-footed 14. Armor check penalty −4. The medium armor leaves land speed at 20 ft.
BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +6, Reflex +0, Will +1. Alertness and the Fighter bonus feat Weapon Focus (claw).
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while firmly grounded. Strength-based resistance is +6, or +8 during Fury.

Fury (Ex), 1/day. After taking at least 1 point of damage, the Wildren can activate Fury at the start of its next turn. For one round, it gains +4 Strength and takes −2 AC. It cannot end Fury voluntarily. Fury stacks with barbarian rage.
actions: One claw +4 melee as a standard attack, or two claws at +4 each in a full attack. Each deals 1d4+2 piercing and slashing, critical ×2, reach 5 ft.
During Fury, claws attack at +6 each for 1d4+4 and AC drops to 12 for one round.
builds.tactics: Dara asks the local badgers which exit is blocked, then guards the open tunnel while the party escorts trapped workers out. She can dig a fresh one-person warren in loose soil if she has an hour.

builds.title: Sea Kin tidal basin healer, Druid 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
skills: Swim +12 on hazards and special actions
traits: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +5.

Constitution 14 gives 112 rounds of held breath, or 56 rounds if she takes a standard or full-round action each round. Each such action spends one extra round. Once the budget runs out, make a Constitution check each round, starting at DC 10 and increasing by 1 each round. Failure starts drowning.
With a swim speed, she can take 10 on Swim checks for hazards or special actions even when threatened.
Nature Sense adds +2 to Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Skill Focus (Heal) adds +3. Wild Empathy +0. No companion accompanies her on this inspection.
Caster level 1, save DC 13 + spell level, three prepared cantrips and two prepared 1st-level spells, including one Wisdom bonus slot. She carries a druidic focus and spell component pouch.
actions: Spear +0 melee wielded two-handed, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, reach 5 ft.
Prepared cantrips: guidance, know direction, purify food and drink. Purify Food and Drink makes up to 1 cubic foot of ordinary spoiled or fouled food and water fit for consumption at caster level 1.

Prepared 1st-level spells: cure light wounds and speak with animals. Cure Light Wounds heals 1d8+1 HP to a living creature touched. Speak with Animals lasts 1 minute at caster level 1. She can convert a 1st-level slot to Summon Nature’s Ally I, such as a porpoise in suitable water.
builds.tactics: Examine the water at the surface before diving to inspect the intake. Use Heal on the crew and cast at the surface. A small supply can be purified for drinking while the party looks for the source of the fouling.

builds.title: Spiker mill gate duelist, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Lawful neutral. This encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Natural armor +1, chain shirt +4, and Dexterity +3 after the racial armor cap. Touch 13, flat-footed 15. Armor check penalty −4. With the shirt removed, AC 15, touch 14, flat-footed 11.
BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +0. The armor cap applies to AC. Initiative and Reflex still use Dexterity +4.
Two-Weapon Fighting is the Fighter bonus feat. Weapon Focus (longsword) adds +1 to longsword attacks. The natural spikes are a light off-hand option with the racial proficiency.
Natural armor +1, acid resistance 5, and DR 2/piercing or slashing. Either piercing or slashing bypasses the DR. The official errata corrects the first printing’s DR label.
actions: Longsword +4 melee, 1d8+2 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Natural spikes alone +3 melee, 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach.

Two-weapon full attack: longsword +2 for 1d8+2 and light off-hand spikes +1 for 1d6+1. Apply −2 to both attacks and half the Strength bonus to off-hand damage. The spikes occupy the off-hand attack in this sequence.
Javelin +5 ranged, 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.
builds.tactics: Parry waits at the mill gate while the workers bring down the shutters. He keeps his chain shirt on while holding the approach. If he needs to climb the service ladder, he can take off the shirt first to free his reach and improve Climb.

builds.title: Spiker cistern grapple warden, Monk 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Lawful good. This encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Unarmored, natural armor +1, Dexterity +1, Wisdom +2. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +7 with Improved Grapple. Fortitude +4, Reflex +3, Will +4. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot.

Improved Grapple is his Monk bonus feat. Grip can initiate a grapple with a +3 melee touch attack without provoking for the attempt, then makes the opposed grapple check at +7. Winning that check establishes the grapple and deals 1d6+3 unarmed damage.
Natural armor +1, acid resistance 5, and DR 2/piercing or slashing. Either piercing or slashing bypasses the DR. The official errata corrects the first printing’s DR label.
actions: Unarmed strike +3 melee, 1d6+3 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Unarmed flurry +1/+1, 1d6+3 each. Spike attack separately at +3 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2.

In an existing grapple, use Damage Your Opponent and win the opposed check at +7 to deal 1d6+3 piercing with the spikes in place of unarmed damage. There is no spike damage on unrelated grapple checks.
With the grappling Attack Your Opponent option, attack AC with the light spikes at −1 after the −4 penalty, for 1d6+3 piercing. The Improved Grapple bonus does not add to that attack roll.
builds.tactics: Grip leads the last cistern workers past a broken grate. He can hold a foe in a grapple while the party clears the steps. He only uses his spikes to deal damage if the threat persists.

builds.title: Sea Kin tidal lock warden, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
skills: Swim +10 on hazards and special actions
traits: Studded leather +3, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1.

Constitution 14 gives 112 rounds of held breath, or 56 rounds if he takes a standard or full-round action each round. Each such action spends one extra round. Once the budget runs out, make a Constitution check each round, starting at DC 10 and increasing by 1 each round. Failure starts drowning.
With a swim speed, he can take 10 on Swim checks for hazards or special actions even when threatened.

Improved Initiative and Fighter bonus Weapon Focus (trident). Weapon Familiarity makes the net and trident simple weapons. Fighter grants proficiency with them. The two armor penalties total −2, doubled to −4 for Swim.
actions: Trident +4 melee wielded one-handed, 1d8+2 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. The swim speed permits normal piercing melee attacks underwater.

Net +2 ranged touch when folded (−2 unfolded), maximum 10 ft., used from the dry platform against a Small to Large target. A hit entangles the target, giving −2 on attacks, −4 Dexterity, half speed, and no running or charging. The target needs Concentration DC 15 to cast a spell. Emmoran can hold the trailing rope and win an opposed Strength check to limit movement to the rope’s reach.

Escape the net with Escape Artist DC 20 or burst it with Strength DC 25, either as a full-round action. The net has 5 HP and takes Emmoran 2 rounds to refold. Thrown weapons are ineffective underwater.
builds.tactics: Have the party hold the dry platform while checking the lock’s catch below. Keep the trident for underwater defence. Use the net only from the platform against a target above water.

builds.title: Feral Gargun glacier wayfinder, 2 Monstrous Humanoid HD and Ranger 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 5.
traits: Leather armor +2, natural armor +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple +11 with Powerful Build. Fortitude +6, Reflex +7, Will +4.
Space and natural reach 5 ft. Powerful Build allows the use of a Large battleaxe in one hand. Two racial Hit Dice, Ranger 1, and +2 level adjustment give effective character level 5.
Cold resistance 5. Alertness, Weapon Focus (claw), and class bonus Track. Wild Empathy −1.
Favored enemy Giant grants +2 weapon damage and +2 to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot and Survival against giants.
Mountain Movement treats standing long jumps and high jumps as running jumps. An accelerated Climb check moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 penalty.
Acclimated removes the Dungeon Master’s Guide p. 90 altitude penalties and persists after time at lower elevations.
Goliath Blood counts the Feral Gargun as a Goliath for effects keyed to race, including race-restricted magic items.
actions: Large battleaxe +7 melee, 2d6+4 slashing, critical ×3, 5-ft. reach.
Primary claws +8 melee, 1d6+4 piercing and slashing each, 5-ft. reach. Use both claws on a full attack when fighting with claws alone.
With a full attack using the battleaxe in one hand, add the free claw at +3 melee, 1d6+2 piercing and slashing.
builds.tactics: Sava wants the party to help move the waymarks above the crumbling ice. She shows them where a new path crosses the ridge, then checks for giant tracks before leading anyone across.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.title: Bariaur switchback scout, Ranger 1
traits: Chaotic good. Material Plane. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +1 (+3 against spells and spell-like abilities that require a Will save).
Studded leather barding supplies +3 armor and an armor check penalty of −1. As Medium nonhumanoid armor it costs 50 gp and weighs 20 lb. It leaves land speed at 40 ft. with a light load.

Spell resistance 12 (11 + one class level). Against an applicable spell or spell-like ability, the caster must roll 12 or higher on 1d20 + caster level. Lowering spell resistance is a standard action that does not provoke. It returns at the start of the Bariaur’s next turn unless kept down.
Quadruped. Strength-based checks to resist bull rush or trip are +7. Light load up to 114 lb. with Strength 16.

Track is a Ranger bonus feat. Wild empathy +0. Point Blank Shot adds +1 to ranged attack and damage rolls within 30 ft. Favored enemy undead adds +2 to the listed Listen, Spot, and Survival checks against undead and +2 to weapon damage against them. It also applies to Bluff and Sense Motive against undead.
actions: Longsword +4 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Longbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 100 ft. Within 30 ft. longbow +4 for 1d8+1.

Powerful Charge. When a charge is legal, make one ram attack at +6 for 2d6+4 bludgeoning. Move at least 10 ft. along a clear path and up to 80 ft. on a normal full-round charge. AC drops to 13 until the start of her next turn.
builds.tactics: Mara scouts the switchback for a messenger who never reached the ford. She uses the bow when the path bends. On the straight stretch she can charge a foe blocking the crossing.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.senses: Normal vision. Blindsense 20 ft. in water only.
builds.title: Darfellan sea-cave guide, Barbarian 1
traits: Chaotic good. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1, touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +5. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +1. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Oru spent 2 skill points to learn Common. Illiterate.
Barbarian fast movement raises land speed to 30 ft. in light armor with a light load. Swim speed stays 40 ft.
Hold Breath (Ex). At Constitution 16, budget 128 rounds before drowning checks in a calm dive. Track exertion under the drowning rules.
Echolocation grants blindsense 20 ft. in water, confined to the water. It locates creatures without removing concealment.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks to perform special actions or avoid hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
Racial Hatred adds +2 to attack and damage rolls against sahuagin.

Rage 1/day lasts 8 rounds at the increased Constitution modifier. It gives +4 Strength, +4 Constitution, +2 morale on Will saves, and −2 AC. HP rises by 2, Fortitude becomes +7, Will becomes +3, and AC drops to 11. Oru is fatigued when rage ends.
actions: Primary bite +5 melee, 1d6+6 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, critical ×2. Against sahuagin the bite is +7 for 1d6+8.
While raging the primary bite is +7 for 1d6+9, or +9 for 1d6+11 against sahuagin.
builds.tactics: Oru dives through the flooded cave mouth to find stranded gatherers. Use echolocation to locate nearby creatures in murky water. Surface at the air pocket before holding off pursuers on the rock shelf.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.senses: Normal vision. Blindsense 20 ft. in water only.
builds.title: Darfellan shoal guard, Fighter 1
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1, touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +5. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +0. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (shortspear) is the Fighter bonus feat.
Hold Breath (Ex). At Constitution 14, budget 112 rounds before drowning checks in a calm dive. Track exertion under the drowning rules.
Echolocation grants blindsense 20 ft. in water, confined to the water. It locates creatures without removing concealment.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks to perform special actions or avoid hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
Racial Hatred adds +2 to attack and damage rolls against sahuagin.
actions: Shortspear +6 melee or +3 thrown, 1d6+4 piercing, critical ×2, range increment 20 ft. Against sahuagin, +8 melee or +5 thrown for 1d6+6.

Shortspear-and-bite full attack. Shortspear +6 for 1d6+4 piercing and secondary bite +0 for 1d6+2 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing. Against sahuagin, shortspear +8 for 1d6+6 and secondary bite +2 for 1d6+4.
With the spear set aside, primary bite +5 melee for 1d6+6. Against sahuagin, +7 for 1d6+8.
builds.tactics: Tava leads the rope team across the submerged channel and emerges onto the ledge at the far gate. Keep the exit clear. Fight from the ledge and use the full attack if a sahuagin reaches it.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.title: Bariaur stoneford guard, Fighter 1
traits: Neutral good. Material Plane. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +5. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +3 (+5 against spells and spell-like abilities that require a Will save). Iron Will adds +2 to Will saves.
Studded leather barding supplies +3 armor and an armor check penalty of −1. As Medium nonhumanoid armor it costs 50 gp and weighs 20 lb. It leaves land speed at 40 ft. with a light load.

Spell resistance 12 (11 + one class level). Against an applicable spell or spell-like ability, the caster must roll 12 or higher on 1d20 + caster level. Lowering spell resistance is a standard action that does not provoke. It returns at the start of the Bariaur’s next turn unless kept down.
Quadruped. Strength-based checks to resist bull rush or trip are +8. Light load up to 150 lb. with Strength 18. Weapon Focus (greatsword) is the Fighter bonus feat.
actions: Greatsword +6 melee, 2d6+6 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. A greatsword charge is +8 for the same damage.
Powerful Charge. When a charge is legal, make one ram attack at +7 for 2d6+6 bludgeoning. With either charge, AC drops to 12 until the start of his next turn.
builds.tactics: Kel holds the stone ford while livestock cross. A hostile spellcaster can test his spell resistance or target the crossing instead. Kel can voluntarily lower his resistance so an allied spell gets through if he has time to plan for it.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Aventi cistern keeper, Cleric 1
traits: Lawful good, cleric of Aventernus. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1, touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +5. Combat Casting adds +4 on Concentration checks to cast defensively or while grappled or pinned.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water without a time limit.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.

Water Spell Power (Ex) grants +1 effective caster level for spells with the [Water] descriptor. The trait provides no spells or spell slots. A spell’s name or presence in a domain list does not supply the descriptor.
Human Blood means an Aventi counts as human for race-related effects, including human-only magic items. The Aventi traits do not grant the standard human bonus feat or extra skill points.

Ocean and Good domains. Ocean grants up to 10 rounds per level of water breathing, redundant with Amphibious. Good adds +1 caster level to Good spells. The spells on this card have no Good descriptor.
actions: Spear +1 melee, 1d8+1 piercing, critical ×3. Turn undead 5/day, check 1d20+2 and turning damage 2d6+3 HD.
Prepared cantrips are create water, guidance, and light. Create water [Water] is CL 2 and creates up to 4 gallons of drinkable water at up to 30 ft. Guidance and light stay at CL 1.
Prepared first-level spells are bless and cure light wounds (1d8+1 healing). The Ocean domain slot is endure elements. All three are CL 1.
builds.tactics: Selka swims under the collapsed stairs to reach the cistern’s dry upper chamber. She uses create water to fill the survivors’ jug and marks an exit so the party can bring them out.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Aventi sluice guide, Fighter 1
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +2, touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +0. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (shortspear) is the Fighter bonus feat.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water without a time limit.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.

Water Spell Power (Ex) grants +1 effective caster level for spells with the [Water] descriptor. The trait provides no spells or spell slots. A spell’s name or presence in a domain list does not supply the descriptor.
Human Blood means an Aventi counts as human for race-related effects, including human-only magic items. The Aventi traits do not grant the standard human bonus feat or extra skill points.
actions: Shortspear +5 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2. Thrown shortspear above water +4 for 1d6+3 piercing, range increment 20 ft.
Use the piercing melee attack underwater. The normal underwater penalties for slashing and bludgeoning weapons do not apply to the shortspear thrust.
builds.tactics: Kerrin swims a rope through the flooded sluice and secures it at the exit. He holds position in the current while the party uses the line. If a foe follows, he fights with the shortspear in melee.

builds.title: Changeling docket clerk, Expert 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 1.
skills: Disguise +6, or +16 with Minor Change Shape
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +1, Will +3.
+2 racial on saving throws against sleep and charm effects.
Skill Focus (Diplomacy) adds +3. Natural Linguist makes Speak Language a class skill. Elven comes from Intelligence, and two skill points buy Dwarven and Giant.

Minor Change Shape (Su) is an at-will full-round action that physically alters the Changeling’s body, including facial features, skin color and texture, and size within the limits of disguise self. Clothing and possessions keep their appearance.
Minor Change Shape grants +10 circumstance on Disguise checks when used to create a disguise. The form lasts until another change. True seeing reveals the natural form, and death restores it.
actions: Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Dagger −1 melee, 1d4−1 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2, minimum 1 damage.
builds.tactics: Rem needs someone to compare two copies of the same docket before the hearing begins. As the relief clerk, Rem showed a different face but wore the same office coat. If the party brings the witness upstairs, Rem can repeat the change in front of them.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Hadozee rigging scout, Rogue 1
traits: Neutral good. Padded armor +1 and Dexterity +4. Touch 14, flat-footed 11. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +0.

Gliding. While using its membranes to glide, a Hadozee takes no damage from a fall of any height. It can travel 20 ft. horizontally for each 5 ft. descended, with glide speed 40 ft. and average maneuverability in the p. 41 player rules. Gliding requires descent.
Hadozee have +4 racial bonuses on Balance and Climb. They keep their Dexterity bonus to AC while climbing and can climb with one hand occupied.
Dodge is Renn’s first-level feat. AC +1 against one designated opponent, including while climbing. Lose the dodge bonus in situations that deny the Dexterity bonus to AC.
Trapfinding. Sneak attack +1d6 against a target denied its Dexterity bonus to AC or flanked by Renn. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. Concealment prevents sneak attack.
actions: Dagger +1 melee, 1d4+1 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Thrown dagger +4 for 1d4+1 piercing, range increment 10 ft.
On a clear crossing, a drop of 5 ft. allows a glide of up to 20 ft. horizontally. A drop of 10 ft. allows up to 40 ft. horizontally with the 40-ft. glide speed.
builds.tactics: Renn checks the raised catwalk for a release catch. He carries the signal cord in one hand while climbing, then glides from the damaged landing to the lower platform.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Hadozee gantry guard, Fighter 1
traits: Chaotic good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +0. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (shortspear) is the Fighter bonus feat.

Gliding. While using its membranes to glide, a Hadozee takes no damage from a fall of any height. It can travel 20 ft. horizontally for each 5 ft. descended, with glide speed 40 ft. and average maneuverability in the p. 41 player rules. Gliding requires descent.
Hadozee have +4 racial bonuses on Balance and Climb. They keep their Dexterity bonus to AC while climbing and can climb with one hand occupied.
actions: Shortspear +5 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2. Thrown shortspear +4 for 1d6+3 piercing, range increment 20 ft.
Climb with the shortspear in one hand and keep Dexterity +2 to AC. From the gantry, glide across a clear 20-ft. gap to a platform 5 ft. lower.
builds.tactics: Daro gets to the winch platform to lower the rescue line. He uses the spar as cover while waiting for a clear descent to the platform and handles the shortspear once he lands.

builds.title: Changeling stage understudy, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
skills: Disguise +5, or +15 with Minor Change Shape
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +4, Will +0.
+2 racial on saving throws against sleep and charm effects.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot, already included. Trapfinding allows Search checks above DC 20 for traps and Disable Device checks against magic traps.

Minor Change Shape (Su) is an at-will full-round action that physically alters the Changeling’s body, including facial features, skin color and texture, and size within the limits of disguise self. Clothing and possessions keep their appearance.
Minor Change Shape grants +10 circumstance on Disguise checks when used to create a disguise. The form lasts until another change. True seeing reveals the natural form, and death restores it.
actions: Rapier +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 18–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Shortbow +2 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, 60-ft. increment.

Sneak attack adds 1d6 when Serr flanks the target or it is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. The target must be vulnerable to critical hits, with a vital spot Serr can see and reach and no concealment from Serr.
builds.tactics: Serr can cover for a missing performer while the party searches the wings. Serr makes the physical change backstage, then puts on the performer’s costume separately. If the rigging comes loose, Serr moves the visitors away from it before looking for the source.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Shoal Halfling lock runner, Rogue 1
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +4, size +1. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +3, Reflex +7, Will +1. Against fear, add another +2 morale to these listed saves.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water equally.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
+1 racial on all saving throws. A +2 morale bonus on saves against fear stacks with the racial save bonus.
Trapfinding. Sneak attack +1d6 against a target denied its Dexterity bonus to AC or flanked by Tess. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. Concealment prevents sneak attack.
Climb, Jump, and Move Silently have no racial bonus. The 20-ft. land speed gives −6 to Jump. Listen retains the +2 racial bonus.
actions: Small dagger +1 melee for 1d3 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Above water, Small sling +5 ranged for 1d3 bludgeoning, critical ×2, range increment 50 ft. Point Blank Shot makes it +6 for 1d3+1 within 30 ft.
The sling attack includes +1 for Small size. Shoal Halflings gain no separate racial bonus with slings or thrown weapons.
builds.tactics: Tess swims through the low sluice and checks the lock from the other side. If a foe follows, she retreats to the dry step before using the sling.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Shoal Halfling shoal guard, Fighter 1
traits: Lawful good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple −1. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +3. Iron Will adds +2 to Will. Against fear, add another +2 morale to these listed saves.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water equally.

+1 racial on all saving throws. A +2 morale bonus on saves against fear stacks with the racial save bonus.
Weapon Focus (shortspear) is the Fighter bonus feat. The attack bonus includes +1 for Small size. Shoal Halflings gain no separate racial bonus with thrown weapons.
actions: Small shortspear +5 melee for 1d4+2 piercing, critical ×2. Thrown above water +6 for 1d4+2 piercing, range increment 20 ft.
Use the piercing melee attack underwater. The usual underwater attack and damage penalties for slashing and bludgeoning weapons do not apply to the shortspear thrust.
builds.tactics: Nerin holds the flooded arch while the crew opens the route to the sandbar. Use the shortspear in melee until everyone can surface.

builds.title: Feral Gargun river salvage guide, Feral Gargun monster class 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 2.
traits: Unarmored. Natural armor +1, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 11. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +3, Reflex +3, Will +2.
Space and natural reach 5 ft. Toughness adds 3 hp. Four ranks each in Climb and Survival. Jump is untrained.
At monster-class level 2, Gorren has one racial Hit Die, 1d4 claws and cold resistance 5. The second racial Hit Die, Powerful Build, and 1d6 claws arrive at level 3.
Mountain Movement treats standing long jumps and high jumps as running jumps. An accelerated Climb check moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 penalty.
Acclimated removes the Dungeon Master’s Guide p. 90 altitude penalties and persists after time at lower elevations.

Primary claws +4 melee, 1d4+3 piercing and slashing each, 5-ft. reach. Use both claws on a full attack when fighting with claws alone.
With a full attack using the shortspear in one hand, add the free claw at −1 melee, 1d4+1 piercing and slashing.
builds.tactics: Gorren points out the ledge where a toll chest dropped during the ferry crossing. He offers to climb down on the river side if the party holds the raft against the pier.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Seacliff Dwarf harbor guard, Fighter 1
traits: Lawful good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +2. Iron Will adds +2 to Will.
+2 racial on saves against poison and +2 racial on saves against spells and spell-like effects.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.
Stonecunning. +4 dodge AC against giants while dodge bonuses apply. No racial attack bonus against orcs or goblinoids.

Strong Swimmers gives +2 racial on Swim checks and doubles the Constitution score used to calculate breath-holding time. Seacliff dwarves use normal Swim checks and breathe air. Constitution 16 gives 64 calm rounds with the cited DMG baseline, or 32 with Stormwrack p. 11. Track exertion under the chosen procedure.
Dwarven waraxe counts as martial. Weapon Focus (dwarven waraxe) is the Fighter bonus feat.
actions: Dwarven waraxe +5 melee, 1d10+3 slashing one-handed, critical ×3. Shortspear +4 melee for 1d6+3 piercing or +2 thrown above water, range increment 20 ft.

On a successful Swim check move up to 5 ft. as a move action or 10 ft. as a full-round action. Use the shortspear’s piercing attack if he must fight underwater. Apply the normal Swim or firm-footing requirement for an unpenalized underwater attack.
builds.tactics: Brott dives to cut a jammed line in the lower harbor passage. He returns to the landing before using his waraxe and braces on firm stone when he has to hold the gate.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Seacliff Dwarf stone-passage scout, Rogue 1
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +0. Skill Focus (Search) adds +3 to Search.
+2 racial on saves against poison and +2 racial on saves against spells and spell-like effects.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.
Stonecunning gives +2 Search to notice unusual stonework and permits a check within 10 ft. Trapfinding also permits her to search for other difficult traps.

Strong Swimmers gives +2 racial on Swim checks and doubles the Constitution score used to calculate breath-holding time. Seacliff dwarves use normal Swim checks and breathe air. Constitution 14 gives 56 calm rounds with the cited DMG baseline, or 28 with Stormwrack p. 11. Track exertion under the chosen procedure.

+4 dodge AC against giants while dodge bonuses apply. No racial attack bonus against orcs or goblinoids. Sneak attack +1d6 against a flanked target or one denied Dexterity to AC, if the target has no concealment.
actions: Short sword +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. The piercing attack avoids the usual slashing and bludgeoning penalties underwater when she has firm footing or succeeds on her Swim check.
Search +11 for unusual stonework. Check the groove around the flooded passage door before touching the release.
builds.tactics: Vessa inspects the stonework before flooding reaches the next landing. She can slip under the water to check the passage but returns to air before trying the release.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.title: Air mephling bell loft guide, Bard 1
traits: Neutral good. Material Plane. Touch 14, flat-footed 14. Studded leather armor +3, Dexterity +3, size +1. Armor check penalty −1. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +2.
Bardic music 1/day. Inspire courage adds +1 morale on attack and weapon damage rolls and on saves against charm and fear. Allies must hear the performance.
Bardic knowledge +1. Bard can cast Bard spells in light armor without arcane spell failure. Matching air spells gain +1 caster level. None of these cantrips have the Air descriptor.
actions: Breath Weapon (Su), 1/day. Standard action, 15-ft. cone of dust and grit (piercing), 1d8 damage, Reflex DC 11 half. No attack roll.
Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft. Within 30 ft. Point Blank Shot gives +5 to hit for 1d6+1.
Bard cantrips, CL 1, two casts per day. Detect magic, ghost sound (Will DC 13 if interacted with), light, and message.
builds.tactics: Pip flies up through the bell loft’s broken hatch, signals the party with his flute, and guides them across the narrow gallery. If a creature blocks the exit, he waits for his allies to clear the cone before using his breath.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.senses: Normal vision. Body Lamp senses solid objects to 60 ft. in loose soil while active.
builds.title: Asherati sandlock scout, Rogue 1
builds.speed: 30 ft., sandswim 30 ft. in leather armor with a light load
traits: Chaotic good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, natural armor +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +0. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot.
Sandswim (Su) works in sand, dust, ash, and softsand. Slipsand, packed dirt, and rock are excluded. Under sand it allows normal breathing. It gives no protection from water or dangerous gases.
The player entry gives land speed in light armor or with a light load. Heavier armor or a medium load limits it to 5 ft. A heavy load prevents movement.

Body Lamp (Su) glows at will, with bright light to 60 ft. and shadowy illumination to 120 ft. In loose soil the Asherati can make out solid objects to 60 ft. for navigation and general identification. Other creatures in the sand see an orange glow. The glow confers no finer perception or advantage against invisibility or concealment. The Asherati cannot Hide while glowing.
Bonus feat Heat Endurance gives +2 on saves against fire effects and heat protection level 1, with no heat saves needed through 120°F.
Water Vulnerability. Completely wet causes −1 on attack rolls, ability checks, and skill checks. Immersion prevents breath-holding and immediately triggers Constitution checks against drowning.

Hide and Move Silently each include +2 racial. Sand adds another +2 to Hide when unlit. Trapfinding. Sneak attack +1d6 against a flanked target or one denied Dexterity to AC, if there is no concealment. Ranged sneak attack is limited to 30 ft.
actions: Short sword +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. Shortbow +3 for 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft.
Body Lamp flash, 1/day as a free action. All creatures within 30 ft. must pass Fortitude DC 12 or be dazzled for 1 minute (−1 on attack rolls, Search, and Spot).
builds.tactics: Rashen follows loose sand to a blocked sandlock. He turns on Body Lamp to find the release frame below the sand. On the surface he extinguishes the glow before hiding. He warns the party to clear the radius before flashing.

builds.title: Asherati cistern guard, Fighter 1
builds.speed: 20 ft. in breastplate, sandswim 5 ft. in breastplate
