The breastplate is medium armor and limits Sandswim to 5 ft. The eagle’s claw counts as martial for Asheratis. Weapon Focus (eagle’s claw) is the Fighter bonus feat.
actions: Eagle’s claw +5 melee, 1d6+3 slashing and piercing, critical 18–20/×2. Javelin +2 for 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, range increment 30 ft.
Body Lamp flash, 1/day as a free action. All creatures within 30 ft. must pass Fortitude DC 11 or be dazzled for 1 minute (−1 on attack rolls, Search, and Spot).
builds.tactics: Neral guards the dry landing beside a cistern overflow. He can move through the sand beside the landing at 5 ft. while armored. He takes the dry route around the overflow and keeps his allies outside the flash radius before using it.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.title: Earth mephling cutwall digger, Druid 1
traits: Neutral good. Material Plane. Leather armor +2, heavy wooden shield +2, size +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. Armor check penalty −2 with the shield. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +0, Will +5.

Nature sense adds +2 to Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Wild empathy +1. Combat Casting adds +4 to Concentration when casting defensively or while grappled or pinned. This encounter starts with no animal companion present.
Matching earth spells gain +1 caster level. None of the prepared spells listed have the Earth descriptor.
actions: Breath Weapon (Su), 1/day. Standard action, 15-ft. cone of rock shards and pebbles (bludgeoning), 1d8 damage, Reflex DC 12 half. No attack roll.
Small club +4 melee, 1d4+3 bludgeoning, critical ×2.
Druid spells prepared, CL 1. Cantrips are create water, guidance, and light. First level spells are cure light wounds (1d8+1) and entangle (Reflex DC 14, lasts 1 minute and needs vegetation).
builds.tactics: Flint digs around a blocked root cellar through loose earth. If an attacker follows outside, he uses entangle where roots and weeds grow, then gives the party room to pass.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.senses: Normal vision. Water Sense 100 ft. with a Survival check.
builds.title: Bhuka dry-channel guide, Druid 1
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +5.
Sure Feet (Ex) treats shallow sand as normal terrain, costing 1 square per square entered, and deep sand as shallow sand, costing 2 squares for a Medium Bhuka.
Glare Resistance (Ex) prevents the dazzled condition from bright sunlight.

+2 racial on Constitution checks or Fortitude saves against harmful heat and dehydration. Bonus feat Heat Endurance gives +2 on saves against fire effects, heat protection level 1, and comfort through 120°F.
+2 racial on Knowledge (nature), which is always a class skill.
Nature Sense adds +2 on Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Skill Focus (Survival) adds +3. Wild empathy +1. The encounter starts with no animal companion present.
actions: Water Sense (Ex) uses Survival to detect drinkable water within 100 ft. The DC depends on depth. Surface DC 10, up to 10 ft. deep DC 12, 11–20 ft. DC 15, 21–40 ft. DC 20, 41–70 ft. DC 25, and 71–100 ft. DC 30. Akari rolls at Survival +12. A drinkable source 30 ft. below her and within range uses DC 20, so she needs an 8 or higher on the die.
Quarterstaff +0 melee with one end for 1d6 bludgeoning, critical ×2.

Prepared druid spells, CL 1. Cantrips are create water, guidance, and light. Create water makes up to 2 gallons. First-level spells are cure light wounds for 1d8+1 healing and entangle (Reflex DC 14, vegetation required).
builds.tactics: Akari guides the party along a dry channel to locate a drinkable seep. Use Water Sense at a bend where the source is within range. She uses create water for immediate relief while the party finds a way to the seep.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.senses: Normal vision. Water Sense 100 ft. with a Survival check.
builds.title: Bhuka duneline scout, Ranger 1
traits: Chaotic good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +2.
Sure Feet (Ex) treats shallow sand as normal terrain, costing 1 square per square entered, and deep sand as shallow sand, costing 2 squares for a Medium Bhuka.
Glare Resistance (Ex) prevents the dazzled condition from bright sunlight.

+2 racial on Constitution checks or Fortitude saves against harmful heat and dehydration. Bonus feat Heat Endurance gives +2 on saves against fire effects, heat protection level 1, and comfort through 120°F.
+2 racial on Knowledge (nature), which is always a class skill.

Track is a Ranger bonus feat. Wild empathy +0. Favored enemy animals adds +2 on Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, Survival, and weapon damage rolls against animals. Water Sense uses the normal Survival modifier.
actions: Water Sense (Ex) uses Survival to detect drinkable water within 100 ft. The DC depends on depth. Surface DC 10, up to 10 ft. deep DC 12, 11–20 ft. DC 15, 21–40 ft. DC 20, 41–70 ft. DC 25, and 71–100 ft. DC 30. Taren rolls at Survival +6. A source 15 ft. deep and within range uses DC 15, so he needs a 9 or higher on the die.
Shortspear +2 melee for 1d6+1 piercing, critical ×2. Shortbow +4 for 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft. Within 30 ft. Point Blank Shot gives +5 to hit and 1d6+1 damage.
On a straight clear move through only deep sand, 30 ft. of movement budget covers three 5-ft. squares. In shallow sand the same budget covers six squares.
builds.tactics: Taren crosses the shallow shoulder of the dune to check the trail and marks a safe approach for the party. If they need water, he checks for a nearby drinkable source with Water Sense.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.title: Fire mephling kiln watch, Sorcerer 1
traits: Neutral. Material Plane. Touch 14, flat-footed 11. Unarmored, Dexterity +3, size +1. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +2. Improved Initiative adds +4 initiative.
Matching Fire spells gain +1 caster level. Burning hands is CL 2. Mage armor is CL 1 and adds +4 armor for 1 hour. With mage armor AC is 18, touch 14, flat-footed 15.
actions: Breath Weapon (Su), 1/day. Standard action, 15-ft. cone of flame (fire), 1d8 damage, Reflex DC 11 half. No attack roll.
Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft.

Sorcerer spells known, five cantrip casts and four first-level casts per day. Cantrips at CL 1 are detect magic, light, mage hand, and prestidigitation. First-level spells are mage armor and burning hands (15-ft. cone, 2d4 fire, Reflex DC 14 half).
builds.tactics: Cinder watches an old kiln passage. If warned, she puts up mage armor and uses the bend to avoid catching the kiln hands in either cone. Track her breath and spell uses separately.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.title: Uldra winter-trail guide, Druid 1
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +2, size +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +2, Will +5.
Nature Scholar (Ex) grants +2 racial on Knowledge (nature) and makes it a class skill.
Cold Resistance (Ex). Cold environments do not harm the Uldra or its equipment. Against attacks that deal cold damage, the Uldra has cold resistance 5.

Frosty Touch (Su). A free action frosts the hands. While frosty, unarmed attacks deal +1 cold damage. A wielded melee weapon deals +1 cold on a hit while held. The extra cold does not stack with a magic weapon’s cold damage.
Fey Blood. Uldras are Fey. Effects limited to Humanoids do not affect them, and effects that target Fey apply. They have no special cold iron weakness.
Nature Sense adds +2 to Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Skill Focus (Knowledge [nature]) adds +3. Wild empathy +1. The encounter begins without an animal companion present.
actions: Small quarterstaff +1 melee with one end for 1d4 bludgeoning, plus 1 cold with Frosty Touch active while holding it. Critical ×2.

Racial spell-like abilities, CL 1 from one Hit Die. Ray of frost 3/day, ranged touch +3 for 1d3 cold with no save. Speak with animals 1/day for 1 minute. Touch of fatigue 1/day, melee touch +1, Fortitude DC 13 negates, duration 1 round. The save is Wisdom-based.
Prepared druid spells, CL 1. Cantrips are create water, guidance, and light. First-level spells are cure light wounds for 1d8+1 healing and entangle (Reflex DC 14, vegetation required).
builds.tactics: Rimewillow uses speak with animals to ask a fox which trail remains open. She takes the party through a cold hollow and uses the staff only if something blocks the way.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.title: Uldra pass shelter guard, Monk 1
traits: Lawful good. Unarmored, size +1, Dexterity +2, Wisdom +3. Touch 16, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +5. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot.
Nature Scholar (Ex) grants +2 racial on Knowledge (nature) and makes it a class skill.
Cold Resistance (Ex). Cold environments do not harm the Uldra or its equipment. Against attacks that deal cold damage, the Uldra has cold resistance 5.

Frosty Touch (Su). A free action frosts the hands. While frosty, unarmed attacks deal +1 cold damage. A wielded melee weapon deals +1 cold on a hit while held. The extra cold does not stack with a magic weapon’s cold damage.
Fey Blood. Uldras are Fey. Effects limited to Humanoids do not affect them, and effects that target Fey apply. They have no special cold iron weakness.
Improved Unarmed Strike and Stunning Fist are Monk bonus feats. Stunning Fist is 1/day. Declare before the attack roll. On a damaging hit, Fortitude DC 13 prevents a one-round stun.
actions: Small Monk unarmed strike +1 melee for 1d4 bludgeoning, plus 1 cold with Frosty Touch. Unarmed flurry as a full attack uses two strikes at −1 each, same damage on each hit.

Racial spell-like abilities, CL 1 from one Hit Die. Ray of frost 3/day, ranged touch +3 for 1d3 cold with no save. Speak with animals 1/day for 1 minute. Touch of fatigue 1/day, melee touch +1, Fortitude DC 13 negates, duration 1 round. The save is Wisdom-based.
builds.tactics: Stillrime guards the shelter entrance as the party brings travelers through the pass. He activates Frosty Touch before engaging and uses the ray if a target stays out of reach. Apply normal cold resistance to his separate cold damage.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.title: Water mephling sluice rescuer, Monk 1
traits: Lawful good. Material Plane. Unarmored, size +1, Dexterity +2, Wisdom +2. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −2. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +4. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for hazards or special actions, and permits taking 10 even under pressure. She still needs to breathe air.

Improved Unarmed Strike and Stunning Fist are Monk bonus feats. Stunning Fist is 1/day, declared before the attack roll. On a damaging hit the target must pass Fortitude DC 12 or be stunned for one round.
actions: Breath Weapon (Su), 1/day. Standard action, 15-ft. cone of caustic liquid (acid), 1d8 damage, Reflex DC 13 half. No attack roll.
Small Monk unarmed strike +3 melee, 1d4+2 bludgeoning, critical ×2. Unarmed flurry +1/+1 on a full attack, 1d4+2 each.
builds.tactics: Ripple swims a rope to the sluice ladder, surfaces, then helps the party guide workers onto the dry ledge. She saves the caustic breath for a clear cone on land.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Neanderthal passage keeper, Barbarian 1
builds.speed: 40 ft. in light armor with a light load
traits: Chaotic good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +5. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +1. Fast movement raises land speed to 40 ft. with this gear and adds +4 to Jump.

Climate Tolerant (Ex) waives environmental Fortitude saves between −20°F and 140°F. It gives no protection from fire or cold damage and counts as Cold Endurance only for feat and prestige-class prerequisites.
+2 racial on Listen, Spot, and Survival.
Human Blood treats the Neanderthal as human for race-based effects and human-only items. The profile gives no human bonus feat or skill points.
Primitive Weapon Mastery adds +1 to greatclub and javelin attacks. Barbarian proficiency covers both weapons. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Oren is illiterate.

Rage 1/day lasts 8 rounds with the improved Constitution modifier. It gives +4 Strength, +4 Constitution, +2 morale on Will saves, and −2 AC. HP rises by 2, Fortitude becomes +7, Will becomes +3, and AC drops to 11. Oren is fatigued when rage ends.
actions: Greatclub +6 melee with two hands for 1d10+6 bludgeoning, critical ×2. While raging, greatclub +8 for 1d10+9.
Javelin +3 thrown for 1d6+4 piercing, critical ×2, range increment 30 ft. While raging, javelin stays +3 and deals 1d6+6.
builds.tactics: Oren waits by the shelter passage while the party brings people in from the cold. His climate trait covers the ambient cold within its range. Resolve fire or cold attacks normally.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Neanderthal cairn scout, Ranger 1
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +2.

Climate Tolerant (Ex) waives environmental Fortitude saves between −20°F and 140°F. It gives no protection from fire or cold damage and counts as Cold Endurance only for feat and prestige-class prerequisites.
+2 racial on Listen, Spot, and Survival.
Human Blood treats the Neanderthal as human for race-based effects and human-only items. The profile gives no human bonus feat or skill points.
Vela spends 2 skill points to read and write Common. Primitive Weapon Mastery adds +1 to shortbow and shortspear attack rolls. Her Ranger proficiencies cover both weapons.
Track is a Ranger bonus feat. Wild empathy +0. Favored enemy animals adds +2 to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, Survival, and weapon damage rolls against animals.
actions: Shortbow +5 for 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft. Point Blank Shot raises it to +6 for 1d6+1 within 30 ft.
Shortspear +4 melee for 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2. A longsword +3 for 1d8+2 slashing provides a comparison because it is outside the mastery list.
builds.tactics: Vela follows tracks between the cairns and reads an old Common warning marker where the route forks. She guides the party through the sheltered cut before the wind rises.

builds.title: Elan night courier escort, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Chain shirt +4, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1.
Improved Initiative and Fighter bonus Weapon Focus (longsword). Climb and Jump include −3 combined armor and shield check penalty.
2 PP per day from Naturally Psionic. The reserve powers the racial abilities.
Resistance: 1 PP, immediate action, +4 racial bonus to all saves until the start of the next action. Resilience: immediate action, reduce incoming damage by 2 HP per PP spent.
Repletion: 1 PP for 24 hours without food or water. A flat-footed Elan cannot use either immediate defense. All three abilities draw from the same reserve.
actions: Longsword +4 melee, 1d8+2 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, reach 5 ft.
Javelin +2 thrown, 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. range increment.
builds.tactics: Signal the courier through with the hooded lamp. Put the shield between the courier and trouble. If the route is too long to stop for supplies, spend 1 PP on Repletion before leaving and keep the other for a defense.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
builds.speed: 30 ft.; swim 30 ft. in amorphous form
builds.title: Slyth sluice keeper, Druid 1
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +4, Reflex +3, Will +5.

Alternate Form (Su). Enter amorphous form as a standard action. It gives a 30-ft. swim speed and passage through openings as small as 2 inches in diameter. Return to normal form with a full-round action that does not provoke.

In amorphous form all worn and carried equipment melds and magic items stop functioning. Material and natural armor cease to apply. Dexterity, any effective deflection bonus, and armor from force effects can apply.

In amorphous form the Slyth cannot attack, be flanked, or be stunned, and is immune to critical hits. Other supernatural abilities stop. Spells with verbal, somatic, material, or focus components cannot be cast.
The form lasts up to 10 minutes per class level. After returning to normal, wait as long as the actual time spent in amorphous form before changing again.
Water Breathing (Ex) allows indefinite breathing underwater. Immunities (Ex) cover polymorphing and poison. Sonic resistance 5.
Armor is AC 15 in normal form and AC 13 in amorphous form, with touch 13 and flat-footed 10 in amorphous form.

Nature Sense adds +2 to Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Combat Casting adds +4 to Concentration when casting defensively or while grappled or pinned. Wild empathy +1. No animal companion is present in this encounter.
actions: Quarterstaff +0 melee with one end for 1d6 bludgeoning, critical ×2. Use it in normal form.

Druid spells prepared, CL 1. Cantrips are create water, guidance, and light. First-level spells are cure light wounds for 1d8+1 healing and entangle (Reflex DC 14, vegetation required). These prepared spells require components, so cast them only in normal form.

At one class level, plan for a maximum of 10 minutes in amorphous form. After a six-minute swim through the grate, return to normal in a space large enough to stand and wait six minutes before shifting again.
builds.tactics: Plip follows the flooded channel through the grate to reach the sluice release from the other side. She returns to normal form before working the release or casting.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
builds.speed: 30 ft.; swim 30 ft. in amorphous form
builds.title: Slyth seep-vault scout, Wizard 1
traits: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +4. Improved Initiative adds +4. Scribe Scroll is the Wizard bonus feat.

Alternate Form (Su). Enter amorphous form as a standard action. It gives a 30-ft. swim speed and passage through openings as small as 2 inches in diameter. Return to normal form with a full-round action that does not provoke.

In amorphous form all worn and carried equipment melds and magic items stop functioning. Material and natural armor cease to apply. Dexterity, any effective deflection bonus, and armor from force effects can apply.

In amorphous form the Slyth cannot attack, be flanked, or be stunned, and is immune to critical hits. Other supernatural abilities stop. Spells with verbal, somatic, material, or focus components cannot be cast.
The form lasts up to 10 minutes per class level. After returning to normal, wait as long as the actual time spent in amorphous form before changing again.
Water Breathing (Ex) allows indefinite breathing underwater. Immunities (Ex) cover polymorphing and poison. Sonic resistance 5.
With mage armor already active, AC is 17 in either form, touch 13 and flat-footed 14. Without it, AC is 13 in either form.
actions: Light crossbow +3 for 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft. The crossbow cannot be used in amorphous form.

Wizard spells prepared, CL 1. Cantrips are detect magic, light, and mage hand. First-level spells are mage armor (+4 force armor for 1 hour) and grease (Reflex DC 14, duration 1 round). Cast only in normal form because each requires components.
Cast mage armor before shifting. After three minutes scouting the seep, return using a full-round action in the vault and wait three minutes before shifting again.
builds.tactics: Murra checks the seep opening before the party forces the vault door. Cast mage armor in advance and use amorphous form for the swim. Return to normal before using a spell or crossbow.

builds.title: Goliath route rigger, Expert 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 2.
traits: Space 5 ft. Natural reach 5 ft. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +8 with Powerful Build. Fortitude +2, Reflex +1, Will +2.
Powerful Build lets Kethan wield Large weapons. Determine weapon reach from his actual Medium size and the weapon’s reach property.
Skill Focus (Sense Motive) adds +3. Sense Motive already includes the species’ +2 bonus. Each listed skill has four Expert class ranks.

Mountain Movement allows standing long jumps and high jumps using the running Jump rules. Accelerated climbing moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 Climb penalty. Climb checks still apply.
Acclimated removes the altitude penalties under Mountain Travel in the Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 90. Acclimation persists after time at low elevation.
actions: Large longspear +4 melee, 2d6+6 piercing, critical ×3. Hits at 10 ft. but cannot hit adjacent targets.
Large club +4 melee, 1d8+4 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. May instead throw it at +1 with a 10-ft. range increment.
builds.tactics: Kethan asks the party to check the downhill anchors before he crosses to rig a line. He takes a standing jump across the break and can climb at half speed while attaching the line. If cornered on the path, he uses the longspear at 10 ft. and the club up close.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
builds.speed: 20 ft.; fly 40 ft. (average, light load or less)
builds.title: Gloaming shaft guide, Sorcerer 1
traits: Neutral good. Unarmored, with Dexterity +3 and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 11. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +2. Improved Initiative adds +4. No familiar is present.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and checks while in bright light.
Luminescence (Ex). As a standard action, set skin light anywhere from off to torch brightness. The setting persists until changed. The glow fades over 10 minutes after death.

Shadow Spells. Add +1 caster level when casting illusion (shadow) spells.

actions: Small light crossbow +4 ranged for 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft.

Sorcerer spells known, CL 1. Detect magic, mage hand, message, and prestidigitation share five cantrip slots. Mage armor and silent image share four 1st-level slots. Mage armor raises AC to 18 for 1 hour, touch 14, flat-footed 15. Silent image has Will DC 14 on interaction.
Set luminescence to a dim glow before descending. Keep carried equipment within a light load of 19½ lb.
builds.tactics: Iskra scouts the broad shaft on the wing, then marks the landing with a steady glow. She keeps room to turn and lands before taking any heavy pack from a climber.

Sneak Attack adds 1d6 precision damage if the target is flanked in melee or denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. Concealment prevents sneak attack.

When passing within 5 ft. of a portal, roll Search against DC 20 even without actively searching. Kes finds it on a 14 or higher in dim light or a 15 or higher in sustained bright light after recovering his sight.
builds.tactics: Kes keeps his glow off and sweeps the passage close to the walls. If the shutter throws sudden daylight into the passage, Kes takes cover until his sight returns, then resumes the search.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.speed: 20 ft. in armor (base land speed 30 ft.)
builds.title: Aasimar lantern escort, Paladin 1
traits: Lawful good. Material Plane. Scale mail +4, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +2.
Acid resistance 5, cold resistance 5, and electricity resistance 5.
Aura of good. Detect evil at will as the spell. Weapon Focus (longsword) adds +1 to longsword attack rolls.
actions: Longsword +5 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Smite Evil 1/day with a normal melee attack. With the longsword against an evil target, attack at +8 for 1d8+4. An attempt against a non-evil target has no smite effect and uses the daily use.

Daylight (Sp), 1/day at CL 1 from character level. Standard action, touch one object. Bright light in a 60-ft. radius and shadowy illumination for another 60 ft. Lasts 10 minutes and can be dismissed. It applies bright-light penalties without damaging creatures harmed only by actual sunlight. A lightproof cover blocks the effect on a small object. Where it overlaps magical darkness, use the otherwise prevailing light.
builds.tactics: Iona leads the last ferrymen out of a dark quay passage. She puts daylight on a lantern and gives it to a ferryman so she can defend the group. Save Smite Evil for a confirmed evil foe.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.speed: 20 ft. in armor (base land speed 30 ft.)
builds.title: Aasimar Ysgard stair keeper, Cleric 1
traits: Neutral good, cleric of Pelor. This encounter takes place on Ysgard. Chainmail +5 and light wooden shield +1. Touch 10, flat-footed 16. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +0, Will +5. Improved Initiative adds +4 initiative.
Acid resistance 5, cold resistance 5, and electricity resistance 5.

Healing and Sun domains. Healing adds +1 caster level to spells of the Healing subschool, including spontaneous cures. Once per day use greater turning in place of a regular turning attempt. Undead that would be turned by that attempt are destroyed instead.
actions: Heavy mace +1 melee, 1d8+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2.
Turn undead 5/day. Turning check 1d20+2 determines the highest individual HD affected. Turning damage is 2d6+3 total HD. One attempt may be greater turning.

Prepared cleric spells, CL 1 unless stated. Cantrips are detect magic, guidance, and light. First-level spells are bless and protection from evil. Domain slot is cure light wounds at CL 2 for 1d8+2 healing.

Daylight (Sp), 1/day at CL 1 from character level. Standard action, touch one object. Bright light in a 60-ft. radius and shadowy illumination for another 60 ft. Where it overlaps magical darkness, use the otherwise prevailing light.
builds.tactics: Teren keeps watch at a stair in Ysgard where travelers lost their lanterns. He lights the handrail and helps them reach the upper landing. If undead block the stair, he uses turning and saves healing for the injured.

builds.title: Goliath rockfall lookout, Barbarian 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2.
traits: Space and natural reach 5 ft. Studded leather +3, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +9 with Powerful Build. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1.

Improved Initiative adds +4. Fast Movement adds 10 ft. before armor and load modifiers. With the listed gear and a light load, speed is 40 ft. and Jump includes the +4 speed bonus. Barbarian illiteracy applies.

Mountain Movement allows standing long jumps and high jumps using the running Jump rules. Accelerated climbing moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 Climb penalty. Climb checks still apply.
Acclimated removes the altitude penalties under Mountain Travel in the Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 90. Acclimation persists after time at low elevation.
actions: Large greatsword +5 melee, 3d6+6 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, reach 5 ft. In Mountain Rage, +7 melee, 3d6+10 slashing, 10-ft. reach.
Large javelin +2 ranged, 1d8+4 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment. In Mountain Rage, +1 ranged and 1d8+7 piercing.

Mountain Rage once per day, at most once per encounter, for up to 7 rounds. Rova can enter it on her turn without spending an action. Become Large with 10-ft. space and reach, Strength 25, Constitution 19, HP 16, AC 11, touch 8, flat-footed 10, grapple +12, Fortitude +6, Reflex +1, Will +3, Climb +10, and Jump +14. Weapons stay Large and the grapple size modifier stays +4. Remove 2 bonus HP when rage ends. Fatigue lasts through the encounter, with −2 Str and Dex and no running or charging.
builds.tactics: Rova calls the watch when stones start moving above the quarry path. She holds anyone at the marked turn until the path is clear, and uses Mountain Rage to defend the shelter if a creature follows the crew down.

builds.difficulty: CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Deep Imaskari vault surveyor, Wizard 1
builds.languages: Common, Roushoum, Aquan, Celestial, Draconic, Undercommon

+4 on Hide checks while underground.
actions: Light crossbow +1 ranged for 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft.

Wizard spells prepared, CL 1. Cantrips are detect magic, light, and mage hand. First-level spells are mage armor and grease. Mage armor raises AC to 15 for 1 hour, touch 11 and flat-footed 14. Grease lasts 1 round and has Reflex DC 15.
Spellbook includes Wizard cantrips and seven 1st-level spells: alarm, detect secret doors, expeditious retreat, grease, mage armor, magic missile, and shield.
After casting grease at the first doorway, use Spell Clutch to prepare it again. Cast it separately when pursuit reaches the second doorway.
builds.tactics: Neris checks a lower vault for two routes out. She casts mage armor before entering and uses the corners and her underground Hide bonus to avoid pursuit between doors.

builds.difficulty: CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

actions: Light mace +1 melee for 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2.

After casting the prepared bless, use Spell Clutch to prepare bless again. Save the second casting for a fresh clash after the first duration ends.
builds.tactics: Serran meets refugees at the waystation and casts bless as they get through the first barricade. He uses the lull to regain bless and saves the second casting for the defense of the inner doors.

builds.title: Sparrow Hengeyokai dispatch runner, Rogue 1

Animal form. Observe or move without an attack. In hybrid form, fly while carrying a light dagger or a small dispatch.
builds.tactics: Find a clear route past a blocked road. Carry the message in a visible satchel in hybrid form or scout as an animal before returning to collect it. Avoid trading blows for a lost route.

builds.title: Chitine gallery scout, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 5 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +2).

Sensitive to Sunlight (Ex). Sunlight and bright magical light such as daylight dazzle a chitine, imposing −1 on attack rolls, Search checks, and Spot checks.
Multiweapon Fighting is a racial bonus feat. Short swords count as simple weapons for weapon familiarity.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity for the light short swords. Trapfinding. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to eligible hits.
actions: One Small short sword +7 melee for 1d4+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2.

Four light short swords as a full attack with Multiweapon Fighting. Each attacks at +5. The primary sword deals 1d4+1 piercing and each off-hand sword deals 1d4 piercing. All threaten on 19–20 and deal ×2 on a critical hit.
While dazzled, the single attack is +6, the full-attack swings are +4 each, and Search is +3.
builds.tactics: Qid circles the party along the ceiling with her hands free, then descends to a ledge. She draws her swords once she has footing and uses the four-sword full attack when she can stay in place.

When crossing the rafters, use Climb +14 and take 10 even while threatened for a result of 24. Keep hands free when using the ceiling route.
builds.tactics: Awa checks the silk stays above the broken gangway. He climbs past the damaged section, takes footing on a brace, and draws a short sword if someone threatens the crossing.

builds.title: Raptoran glider and ropeway rigger, Expert 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 1.
builds.senses: Low-light vision and Unerring Direction on the Material Plane
traits: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +2, Will +2. Skill Focus (Use Rope) adds +3.
Glides 40 ft. with average maneuverability and 20 ft. forward for each 5 ft. down. At 1 Hit Die this build can glide from height only. Maintain a light load, up to 43 lb. at Strength 12.
An unconscious or helpless Raptoran aloft descends in a corkscrew and takes 1d6 falling damage. Jump, Climb and Spot above include the racial bonuses.
actions: Dagger +1 melee, 1d4+1 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2, reach 5 ft.
Light crossbow +2 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment. Reload as a move action.
builds.tactics: Check the knots and use the upper landing to glide a light messenger line down. Ask the party to secure the near anchor. Keep anyone needing rescue off the glider’s load.

builds.title: Grimlock passage guardian, Barbarian 1

builds.speed: 40 ft. with fast movement; base 30 ft.
traits: Chaotic neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +2 and natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple +7. Fortitude +5, Reflex +5, Will +3. Improved Initiative adds +4. Fast Movement and illiteracy.
Blindsight (Ex) locates foes within 40 ft. with line of effect. Foes beyond 40 ft. have total concealment. Blindsight does not reveal color or visual detail.
Losing either hearing or smell negates blindsight. With one sense remaining, the grimlock functions as if it had Blind-Fight. Losing both leaves it effectively blinded.
Scent (Ex) detects opponents within 30 ft. under ordinary conditions. Spend a move action to determine the direction. Pinpoint the source within 5 ft.
Immune to gaze attacks, visual effects, and illusions or other attacks that rely on sight. Sound- and scent-based effects can still affect a grimlock.
+10 racial bonus on Hide checks in mountains or underground.
Martial Weapon Proficiency (battleaxe) is the racial bonus feat. Power Attack can trade up to 3 points of melee attack bonus for twice that amount of damage when wielding the battleaxe in two hands.
actions: Battleaxe +7 melee in two hands for 1d8+6 slashing, critical ×3.

Rage 1/day for up to 8 rounds. During rage, AC 14, HP 35 at full health, grapple +9, Fortitude +7, Reflex +5, Will +5, and two-handed battleaxe +9 for 1d8+9. When rage ends, lose the 6 HP from increased Constitution and become fatigued for the rest of the encounter.

If a silence effect takes away hearing, use scent to find the direction of a creature within 30 ft. or pinpoint it within 5 ft. Without blindsight, Blind-Fight allows a reroll of a melee miss chance from concealment when attacking a located creature.
builds.tactics: Diamond Hand waits where the passage bends within 40 ft. When a silence spell breaks her blindsight, she backs toward her hunt-bonded companion and uses scent to locate anyone close enough to threaten them.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 6 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3).

Amphibious (Ex) allows indefinite breathing in air and water. Swim speed 50 ft. gives +8 on Swim checks for hazards and special actions and allows taking 10 even under pressure.
Keen Sight (Ex) can spot moving creatures or objects even if invisible or ethereal. An invisible or ethereal target that keeps still can avoid this detection.

Electricity resistance 10. Immune to poison and paralysis. Slippery (Ex) provides immunity to magical and ordinary webs. Racial bonuses are +8 on Escape Artist and +4 on Search and Spot.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (shortspear) adds +1 to attacks with the shortspear.
actions: Shortspear +7 melee for 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2.

Adhesive (Ex). Coating a shield takes 1 hour and materials worth 20 gp. A missed melee attack against the kuo-toa triggers Reflex DC 11 + its Constitution modifier. On a failed save a held weapon sticks and is pulled from its wielder’s grip, or a natural-weapon attacker is grappled. The coating expires after three days or one catch. A DC 20 Strength check frees the weapon or limb.
The shield starts with a fresh coating. The save to avoid it is Reflex DC 14. Once it catches a weapon or limb, mark the coating spent.
After one round of blindness from abrupt bright light, sustained bright light reduces the shortspear attack to +6, Search to +9, and saves to Fortitude +4, Reflex +3, Will +4.
builds.tactics: Lilli keeps her coated shield between herself and an attacker on the landing. If daylight floods the shore, she withdraws into the deeper passage when she can do so safely.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 6 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3).
builds.title: Kuo-toa sluice scout, Rogue 1
traits: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, natural armor +6. Touch 13, flat-footed 18. BAB +2, grapple +3. Fortitude +2, Reflex +8, Will +6.
Amphibious (Ex) allows indefinite breathing in air and water. Swim speed 50 ft. gives +8 on Swim checks for hazards and special actions and allows taking 10 even under pressure.

actions: Rapier +5 melee for 1d6+1 piercing, critical 18–20/×2.
Use Swim +12 to take 10 for a result of 22 when crossing a hazardous sluice. Use Escape Artist +16 if caught in a mundane snare. Webs do not impede this scout.

A moving invisible swimmer can be seen through Keen Sight if the scout can otherwise see the swimmer’s location. A perfectly still opponent can evade the ability. Seeing an ethereal target does not allow a mundane rapier to strike it.
builds.tactics: Rripp waits below the sluice, watching for movement in the dim channel. He signals the party when the moving scout crosses his view, then swims around the obstruction.

+10 racial bonus on Hide checks in mountains or underground.
Track is the chosen racial Hit Die feat. Martial Weapon Proficiency (battleaxe) is the racial bonus feat.

Use Track with scent to follow a fresh trail. Roll Survival +0 against a typical DC of 10. Travel at half speed while tracking unless taking the penalty for moving faster.
builds.tactics: Cold Water follows a fresh scent trail up the fissure. At the fork, he uses a move action to determine a nearby scent’s direction. If an overpowering odor spoils the trail, he falls back to familiar ground.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
builds.title: Orog forge guard, Fighter 1

Fire resistance 5 and cold resistance 5.
+2 racial bonus on Craft (armorsmithing) and Craft (weaponsmithing) checks.
Racial proficiency with the greatsword and throwing axe.
Orc Blood. An orog counts as an orc for racial effects, including the use or creation of magic items with orc-specific powers.
Weapon Focus (greatsword) adds +1 to greatsword attacks. Power Attack can trade 1 point of melee attack bonus for 2 damage with the greatsword.
actions: Masterwork greatsword +8 melee in two hands for 2d6+7 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. With Power Attack, attack at +7 for 2d6+9.
After an abrupt exposure to daylight blinds him for 1 round, sustained bright light reduces the normal greatsword attack to +7, Craft checks to +6, and saves to Fortitude +3, Reflex −1, Will −1.
builds.tactics: Gorvak holds the passage by the forge in low light. He moves the fight away from the surface opening when a shutter lets daylight through. His resistance reduces the first 5 points of fire or cold damage from an applicable instance.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).

Racial proficiency with the greatsword and throwing axe.
Orc Blood. An orog counts as an orc for racial effects, including the use or creation of magic items with orc-specific powers.
Skill Focus (Perform) adds +3 to Perform (percussion). Bardic Knowledge +2. Bardic music 1/day. Leather armor does not cause arcane spell failure for his Bard spells.
actions: Greatsword +3 melee in two hands for 2d6+4 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Throwing axe +1 ranged for 1d6+3 slashing, critical ×2, range increment 10 ft.
Inspire Courage grants allies who can hear the performance +1 morale on saves against charm and fear, attack rolls, and weapon damage. It lasts while they hear him play and for 5 rounds afterward.
Bard spells known, CL 1. Detect magic, light, mage hand, and message share two cantrip slots.
builds.tactics: Maig sounds the drum while workers flee the foundry. Once everyone has heard the beat, he stops playing and uses message to warn a worker ahead if pursuers close in.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.title: Tiefling lockhouse runner, Rogue 1

Cold resistance 5, electricity resistance 5, and fire resistance 5.

Trapfinding. Sneak attack +1d6 when a target is denied Dexterity bonus to AC or when Sella flanks it. Ranged sneak attack requires a target within 30 ft. A target with concealment cannot be sneak attacked.
actions: Rapier +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 18–20/×2. Shortbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft. Within 30 ft. Point Blank Shot gives +5 to hit for 1d6+1.

Darkness (Sp), 1/day at CL 1 from character level. Standard action, touch one object. Shadowy illumination in a 20-ft. radius for 10 minutes, dismissible. Creatures in the area have concealment (20% miss chance), even against darkvision, including the Tiefling’s own. Ordinary lights and lower-level light spells do not brighten the area. A lightproof cover over a small object blocks the effect until removed.
builds.tactics: Sella checks the floodgate for a trap and picks the lock if the gate is safe. If the party needs to retreat, she uses darkness on a copper token and leaves it at the bend. She looks for sneak attacks where the target has no concealment. A lightproof pouch can cover the token before the duration ends.

builds.title: Quaggoth shaft guide, racial Hit Dice only
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 5 (3 racial HD, LA +2).
traits: Neutral beast-follower. Unarmored, Dexterity +1 and natural armor +4. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple +8. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +4.
Climb speed 30 ft. gives +8 on Climb checks and lets the quaggoth take 10 even under pressure.
Immune to fear. Scent normally detects creatures within 30 ft. Spend a move action for direction, and pinpoint the source within 5 ft.

Rage (Ex). After taking damage in combat, check the following round for a 50% chance to rage. Magic-followers instead rage on 1 in 6 and drop their weapons. Rage grants +4 Strength and imposes −4 AC. The quaggoth fights with claws and bite until it or its opponent dies and cannot end the rage voluntarily.
Two primary claws each deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage. The secondary bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Apply Strength modifiers to these base dice.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4.
actions: One claw +8 for 1d4+5. Full attack with two claws at +8 each for 1d4+5 and a secondary bite at +3 for 1d4+2. All threaten on 20 and deal ×2 on a critical hit.
If rage triggers, AC drops to 11 and grapple rises to +10. Full attack becomes two claws at +10 for 1d4+7 each and a bite at +5 for 1d4+3. Hit points and saves stay the same.
Take 10 with Climb +13 for a result of 23 while using the shaft wall.
builds.tactics: Rusk climbs the shaft first to reach a brace for the party’s rope. Check for rage the round after he takes damage. If he rages, he fights the attacker with claws and bite.

builds.title: Quaggoth switchback guard, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 4. ECL 6 (3 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +2).
traits: Neutral magic-follower. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1 and natural armor +4. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +4, grapple +9. Fortitude +6, Reflex +4, Will +4.
Climb speed 30 ft. gives +8 on Climb checks and lets the quaggoth take 10 even under pressure.
Immune to fear. Scent normally detects creatures within 30 ft. Spend a move action for direction, and pinpoint the source within 5 ft.

Rage (Ex). After taking damage in combat, check the following round for a 50% chance to rage. Magic-followers instead rage on 1 in 6 and drop their weapons. Rage grants +4 Strength and imposes −4 AC. The quaggoth fights with claws and bite until it or its opponent dies and cannot end the rage voluntarily.
Two primary claws each deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage. The secondary bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Apply Strength modifiers to these base dice.

Dyed fur grants +2 circumstance on Hide in shadow. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4. Fighter bonus feat is Weapon Focus (club). The 4th-Hit-Die ability increase went to Strength.
actions: Club +10 melee in two hands for 1d6+7 bludgeoning, critical ×2. Without the club, the natural full attack is two claws at +9 for 1d4+5 each and a secondary bite at +4 for 1d4+2.

After taking damage, check next round. On 1 on a d6, Borr drops his club, rages, and uses two claws at +11 for 1d4+7 each and a bite at +6 for 1d4+3. AC drops to 13 and grapple rises to +11. Hit points and saves stay the same.
builds.tactics: Borr waits beside the switchback where shadows break up his dyed fur. He holds the turn with his club until driven back or forced into rage.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.title: Tiefling smokeway guard, Fighter 1
traits: Neutral good. Material Plane. Chain shirt +4, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 15. Total armor check penalty −3. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +0.
Cold resistance 5, electricity resistance 5, and fire resistance 5.
Weapon Focus (longsword) is the Fighter bonus feat. When a melee attack misses because of concealment, Blind-Fight lets Verren reroll the miss chance once. His ranged attacks gain no reroll.
actions: Longsword +5 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Javelin +3 ranged, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, range increment 30 ft.

Darkness (Sp), 1/day at CL 1 from character level. Standard action, touch one object. Shadowy illumination in a 20-ft. radius for 10 minutes, dismissible. Creatures in the area have concealment (20% miss chance), even against darkvision, including the Tiefling’s own. Ordinary lights and lower-level light spells do not brighten the area. A lightproof cover over a small object blocks the effect until removed.
builds.tactics: Verren guides the last workers to the cross-passage and holds the gate. He can put darkness on the gate latch when a pursuer enters the straight passage. He stays close enough to use his longsword and applies his Blind-Fight reroll only to a melee miss caused by concealment.

builds.title: Tanarukk coal-gate sentry, racial Hit Dice only
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 8 (5 racial HD, LA +3).
traits: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +2 and natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +5, grapple +9. Fortitude +6, Reflex +6, Will +5.
Fire resistance 10 and spell resistance 14. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Weapon Focus (battleaxe) adds +1 on battleaxe attacks. Illiterate.

Control Flame (Sp), 1/day, caster level 5. As a standard action, change an existing nonmagical fire within 10 ft. Dim it to coals or brighten it to daylight brightness and twice its normal illumination radius. The effect lasts 5 minutes. Heat output and fuel consumption stay the same.

The natural bite deals 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage before Strength. In a full attack with a weapon, apply a −5 penalty to the bite attack and add half the Strength bonus to its damage.
Orc Blood allows the tanarukk to use or create items with orc-specific powers as an orc.
actions: Battleaxe +10 melee in two hands for 1d8+6 slashing, critical ×3. On a full attack, add bite +4 for 1d6+2, critical ×2. Bite alone +9 for 1d6+6, critical ×2.
Use the one daily activation to dim the coal gate’s nearest brazier from within 10 ft.
builds.tactics: Khar dims the brazier by the passage and watches the first landing with darkvision. If challenged, he uses the battleaxe and adds a bite when he can make a full attack.

builds.title: Tanarukk ember-gallery scout, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 4. ECL 9 (5 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3).
traits: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +4 and natural armor +4. Touch 14, flat-footed 16. BAB +5, grapple +8. Fortitude +6, Reflex +10, Will +4.

Fire resistance 10 and spell resistance 15. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Finesse applies to the rapier and bite. Trapfinding. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 on eligible hits.

Control Flame (Sp), 1/day, caster level 5. As a standard action, change an existing nonmagical fire within 10 ft. Dim it to coals or brighten it to daylight brightness and twice its normal illumination radius. The effect lasts 5 minutes. Heat output and fuel consumption stay the same.

The natural bite deals 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage before Strength. In a full attack with a weapon, apply a −5 penalty to the bite attack and add half the Strength bonus to its damage.
Orc Blood allows the tanarukk to use or create items with orc-specific powers as an orc.
actions: Rapier +9 melee for 1d6+3 piercing, critical 18–20/×2. On a full attack, add bite +4 for 1d6+1, critical ×2. Bite alone +9 for 1d6+4, critical ×2.
Within 10 ft. of a nonmagical signal flame, brighten it for 5 minutes to show the group which route is open. The flame’s heat and fuel consumption stay the same.
builds.tactics: Varka leads the way through the dim gallery and brightens the signal flame once the escape route is open. She uses the rapier and follows with a bite when a full attack is possible.

builds.title: Raptoran beacon sentry, Fighter 5
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 5. ECL 5.
builds.speed: Walk 30 ft. Fly or glide 40 ft. (average).
builds.senses: Low-light vision and Unerring Direction on the Material Plane
traits: Chain shirt +4 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 14. BAB +5, grapple +7. Fortitude +6, Reflex +4, Will +2. Strength 14 allows a light load up to 58 lb.

With Constitution 14, fly safely for 2 consecutive rounds. Can fly for up to 4, becoming fatigued at the end. More than 10 minutes actual flight in a day also causes fatigue. Glide between bouts. A medium or heavy load, fatigue, or exhaustion prevents powered flight.
Feats are Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot, Weapon Focus (footbow), and Weapon Specialization (footbow). The footbow is masterwork with a +2 Strength rating.
actions: Footbow +10 ranged, critical ×3 and 110-ft. range increment. Damage 1d8+4 with one hand drawing, or 1d8+5 with both hands drawing and the feet holding the bow. Within 30 ft., add +1 attack and damage from Point Blank Shot.

Ground footbow shots require prone posture and take −4 on attack rolls. Rapid Shot is a full attack with an extra shot and −2 to both attacks. Use it from a stable prone firing position on the ground. At more than 30 ft. the ground volley is +4/+4.

Shortspear wielded two-handed, +7 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Diving charge +9 melee: move at least 30 ft. and descend at least 10 ft. Double damage on a hit. Apply the ordinary charge requirements and AC penalty.
builds.tactics: Use a brief powered bout to reach a beacon platform, then glide to the lower perch and signal across the ravine. Make single moving shots in the air. Use the ground volley only once there is secure footing and cover.

builds.speed: 30 ft.; fly 40 ft. (poor) in natural winged form
builds.title: Fey’ri canopy scout, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
traits: Neutral. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +4. Touch 14, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +6, Will +1. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Immune to magic sleep. +2 racial bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects.

Change Shape (Su). At will as a standard action, assume a humanoid form. The form lasts until changed again or until death. Use the new form’s size and movement modes. Retain the original type, ability scores, Hit Dice, hit points, saves, and spellcasting. Gain +10 on Disguise when using the ability for a disguise.
The natural winged form has a 40-ft. fly speed with poor maneuverability. Core flight requires a light load or less.
Elven Blood makes the fey’ri count as an elf for elf-specific effects and items.
Four Demonic Abilities are darkness 1/day, detect thoughts 1/day, fire resistance 10, and +2 racial on saves against poison. Caster level 1. Trapfinding and Sneak Attack +1d6.
actions: Shortbow +4 ranged for 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft. Rapier +0 melee for 1d6 piercing, critical 18–20/×2.
Detect thoughts is Will DC 12. Darkness uses caster level 1. Both are racial spell-like abilities.
Assume a human disguise at Disguise +14. The human form moves 30 ft. on land. Return to natural form before taking off at fly 40 ft. with poor maneuverability.
builds.tactics: Vaelis approaches the checkpoint in a human disguise. Once past the watch, she returns to her natural shape before crossing the broad gap on the wing. She keeps her load light and leaves enough room to turn.

builds.speed: 30 ft.; fly 40 ft. (poor) in natural winged form
builds.title: Fey’ri courtyard courier, Sorcerer 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 4 (1 class HD, LA +3).
traits: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +2. Improved Initiative adds +4. No familiar is present.
Immune to magic sleep. +2 racial bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects.

Change Shape (Su). At will as a standard action, assume a humanoid form. The form lasts until changed again or until death. Use the new form’s size and movement modes. Retain the original type, ability scores, Hit Dice, hit points, saves, and spellcasting. Gain +10 on Disguise when using the ability for a disguise.
The natural winged form has a 40-ft. fly speed with poor maneuverability. Core flight requires a light load or less.
Elven Blood makes the fey’ri count as an elf for elf-specific effects and items.
Four Demonic Abilities are dimension door 1/day, charm person 1/day, detect thoughts 1/day, and fire resistance 10. Dimension door is the marked choice, giving LA +3. Caster level 1.
actions: Light crossbow +3 ranged for 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft.

Dimension door reaches 440 ft. at caster level 1. Its passenger allowance starts at caster level 3. After using it, Nyrel can take no further actions until the next turn. Charm person is Will DC 14 and detect thoughts is Will DC 15.

Sorcerer spells known, CL 1. Detect magic, mage hand, message, and prestidigitation share five cantrip slots. Mage armor and grease share four 1st-level slots. Mage armor raises AC to 17 for 1 hour, touch 13, flat-footed 14. Grease is Reflex DC 14 and lasts 1 round.
builds.tactics: Nyrel scouts the courtyard in a humanoid guise, then uses dimension door to carry the message across the closed gate after the party clears the far side.

builds.title: Troglodyte cistern guide, racial Hit Dice only
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 4 (2 racial HD, LA +2).
skills: Hide +10 (+14 in rocky or underground surroundings)
traits: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +1 and natural armor +6. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +6, Reflex +1, Will +1. Improved Initiative adds +4.

Stench (Ex). Anger or fear triggers the musk. Living creatures within 30 ft. other than troglodytes make a Fortitude save or become sickened for 10 rounds. The DC is 10 + half the racial Hit Dice + the Constitution modifier. A successful save protects the creature from that individual troglodyte’s stench for 24 hours.
Poison immunity prevents the effect. Apply normal bonuses against poison to the save. Delay poison or neutralize poison removes the sickness.
Color-changing skin gives +4 on Hide checks, rising to +8 in rocky or underground surroundings.

Two claw attacks deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage each and the bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage before Strength. Bonus Multiattack reduces the secondary attack penalty from −5 to −2.
actions: Claw +3 for 1d4+2. On a full attack, two claws at +3 for 1d4+2 each and a bite at +1 for 1d4+1. Critical ×2 on all three.
When anger or fear triggers Stench, allies and foes who are living and within 30 ft. make a DC 14 Fortitude save unless exempt. On a failure, apply sickened for 10 rounds.
builds.tactics: Sethrik follows the cistern wall using Hide +14. If a threat corners the group, he calls for his non-troglodyte companions to move past the 30-ft. range before they hold the passage.

builds.title: Dekanter Goblin gallery lookout, racial Hit Dice only
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 6 (2 racial HD, LA +4).
traits: Neutral. Dexterity +2, natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +2, grapple +7. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +5.
Cold resistance 5 and fast healing 3. Recover 3 HP per round from damage the ability can heal.
Power Attack can trade up to 2 points of melee attack bonus for the same damage bonus.
actions: Horn +7 melee, 1d6+5 piercing, critical ×3. Full attack with the horn and two secondary claws at +2 each for 1d4+2 each, critical ×2.
builds.tactics: Orrik watches the higher gallery. He prefers to stay by the narrow bend if a fight breaks out, where he has room to use his claws.

builds.title: Dekanter Goblin cold passage guard, Barbarian 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 7 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +4).
builds.speed: 30 ft. with fast movement, base 20 ft.
traits: Neutral good. Studded leather +3, Dexterity +2, natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 17, armor check penalty −1. BAB +3, grapple +9. Fortitude +6, Reflex +5, Will +5.
Cold resistance 5 and fast healing 3. Recover 3 HP per round from damage the ability can heal.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Power Attack can trade up to 3 points of melee attack bonus for the same damage bonus. Fast movement and illiteracy.
actions: One-handed battleaxe +9 melee, 1d8+6 slashing, critical ×3. Add one secondary horn at +4 for 1d6+3, critical ×3, or one secondary claw at +4 for 1d4+3, critical ×2, on a full attack.

Rage 1/day for up to 9 rounds. AC 17, full HP 38, grapple +11. Fortitude +8, Reflex +5, Will +7. Battleaxe +11 for 1d8+8. The secondary horn or claw is +6, with 1d6+4 or 1d4+4 damage respectively. Lose the 6 rage HP and become fatigued for the rest of the encounter when rage ends.
builds.tactics: Tavra listens for the first returning crew before she opens the cold passage. She stays between the crew and the older branch of the mine.

builds.title: Troglodyte grate warden, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 5 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +2).
skills: Hide +7 (+11 in rocky or underground surroundings)
traits: Neutral. Leather armor +2, heavy steel shield +2 and natural armor +6. Touch 10, flat-footed 20. Armor check penalty −2. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +9, Reflex +0, Will +0.

Stench (Ex). Anger or fear triggers the musk. Living creatures within 30 ft. other than troglodytes make a Fortitude save or become sickened for 10 rounds. The DC is 10 + half the racial Hit Dice + the Constitution modifier. A successful save protects the creature from that individual troglodyte’s stench for 24 hours.
Poison immunity prevents the effect. Apply normal bonuses against poison to the save. Delay poison or neutralize poison removes the sickness.
Color-changing skin gives +4 on Hide checks, rising to +8 in rocky or underground surroundings.

Two claw attacks deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage each and the bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage before Strength. Bonus Multiattack reduces the secondary attack penalty from −5 to −2.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4. Fighter bonus feat Weapon Focus (javelin) adds +1 on javelin attacks.
actions: Javelin +3 ranged for 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, range increment 30 ft.
Club +5 in one hand for 1d6+3 bludgeoning, critical ×2. While holding the club and shield, add only the secondary bite at +3 for 1d4+1 on a full attack.
Stench is Fortitude DC 15. A creature protected against Vess by a successful save still rolls against a different troglodyte if exposed to its stench.
builds.tactics: Vess holds a javelin while watching the grate and switches to a club if a foe closes. He has the non-troglodyte crew wait beyond the range of his Stench.

builds.title: Maenad shoal rescuer, Wilder 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1.
traits: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. With Force Screen, AC 17, touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +1, Will +1.
Skill Focus (Swim) adds +3. Wilder manifester level 1. Reserve 5 PP per day, from 2 class, 1 Charisma and 2 species. Force Screen is the sole known power.

Wild Surge +1 can increase Force Screen to manifester level 2 for the same 1 PP, extending its duration to 2 minutes. Immediately roll for 5% psychic enervation. On enervation, lose 1 PP and become dazed until the end of your next turn.

Outburst (Ex) once per day for up to 4 rounds. This encounter uses a standard action to start it. While active, Str 14, Int 8, Wis 6, grapple +2, Will +0, Swim +9, Spot +2, and Profession (sailor) +2.
actions: Shortspear +1 melee, 5-ft. reach, or +1 thrown, 20-ft. range increment. One-handed damage 1d6+1 piercing, critical ×2. With Outburst, melee +2 and damage 1d6+2 on melee or thrown hits.
Sonic Energy Ray once per day. Standard action with a scream, +1 ranged touch to 25 ft., 1d6−1 sonic, ignores object hardness. No save. Power resistance applies. Manifester level 1. Costs no PP.
Force Screen, 1 PP. Standard action, personal. Gain a +4 shield bonus to AC for 1 minute. The shield bonus also applies against incorporeal touch attacks.
builds.tactics: Mark the shallow route with the depth line. Ask the party to secure its shore end before swimming out for the marooned pilot. Use Outburst when the extra strength would help, and keep the once-daily ray for a clear target.

builds.title: Gray Orc wayhouse keeper, Cleric 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (2 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Neutral evil. Chain shirt +4, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 14, armor check penalty −2. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +6.
Light Sensitivity (Ex) gives −1 on attack rolls in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell.
Scent (Ex). Detect creatures by smell at 30 ft. in still air, 60 ft. upwind and 15 ft. downwind. Use a move action to determine direction. Pinpoint a scent source within 5 ft.
Cleric of Luthic. Earth domain grants 3 shared uses/day to turn or destroy air creatures or rebuke or command earth creatures. Healing domain adds +1 caster level to Healing spells.
Combat Casting adds +4 to Concentration while casting defensively, grappled, or pinned.
actions: Light mace +3 melee, 1d6+2 bludgeoning, critical ×2.
Caster level 2, or 3 for Healing spells. Four orisons, DC 13 when relevant. Detect magic, guidance, light, and resistance.

First level, three slots plus one domain slot, DC 14 when relevant. Bless (+1 morale on attacks and saves against fear for 2 minutes), cure light wounds (1d8+3 healing), shield of faith (+2 deflection AC for 2 minutes), and domain magic stone. Spontaneous inflict spells can replace prepared non-domain spells.
Magic stone enchants up to three pebbles for 30 minutes or until discharged. Thrown stone +3, 1d6+1 bludgeoning or 2d6+2 against undead, 20-ft. range increment.
Rebuke or command undead 3/day. Turning check 1d20, turning damage 2d6+2. Earth domain has its own pool and the same check and damage.
builds.tactics: Maura keeps a lamp ready at the door and checks arriving travelers for injuries. If the wayhouse comes under attack, she casts bless before moving to cover.

builds.title: Gray Orc windward tracker, Ranger 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Neutral. Studded leather +3, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13, armor check penalty −1. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +2.
Light Sensitivity (Ex) gives −1 on attack rolls in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell.
Scent (Ex). Detect creatures by smell at 30 ft. in still air, 60 ft. upwind and 15 ft. downwind. Use a move action to determine direction. Pinpoint a scent source within 5 ft.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot, already included. Favored enemy animals gives +2 weapon damage and +2 to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival used against animals.
Track is a bonus feat. Wild empathy check 1d20. Magical beasts with Intelligence 1 or 2 impose −4.
actions: Greataxe +4 melee, 1d12+4 slashing, critical ×3. Longbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, 100-ft. range increment. Add +2 to damage against animals.
Track by scent with Survival +6, or +8 when tracking animals. Fresh scent trails typically start at DC 10 and rise by 2 per hour.
builds.tactics: Keshen pauses where the trail turns into the wind. He marks the path for the party before moving down to the crossing.

builds.title: Derro tunnel guide, racial Hit Dice only
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 4 (3 racial HD, LA +1 under Underdark).
traits: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, size +1, and natural armor +2. Touch 14, flat-footed 15. BAB +3, grapple +0. Fortitude +3, Reflex +6, Will +6. Spell resistance 15.

Madness (Ex) gives −6 Wisdom and +6 Charisma, uses Charisma in place of Wisdom on Will saves, and grants immunity to confusion and insanity effects. Miracle or wish can restore sanity, reversing those ability adjustments and ending the trait.
Vulnerability to Sunlight (Ex). Take 1 Constitution damage per hour in sunlight. Constitution 0 is fatal. Recover 1 point per 24 hours spent underground or otherwise sheltered from sunlight.
+4 racial bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks.
Racial Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to eligible hits under the Rogue rules. Poison Use (Ex) protects the derro from accidentally poisoning itself while handling poison.
Racial spell-like abilities, CL 3. At will, darkness and ghost sound. Once per day each, daze and sound burst. Save DCs use Charisma.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Blind-Fight allows one reroll of a concealment miss chance on a melee attack.
actions: Small light crossbow +7 ranged for 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft. Small dagger +5 melee for 1d3+1 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2.
Ghost sound is Will DC 13 to disbelieve if interacted with. Daze is Will DC 13. Sound burst deals 1d8 sonic damage and has Fortitude DC 15 against its 1-round stun.
builds.tactics: Dorr leads the group through a covered passage and uses ghost sound to draw attention away from the crossing. If forced to travel above ground, he tracks time spent in sunlight and seeks a covered route.

builds.title: Derro gallery archivist, Sorcerer 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 4. ECL 5 (3 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +1 under Underdark).
traits: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +3, size +1, and natural armor +2. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. BAB +3, grapple −2. Fortitude +3, Reflex +6, Will +9. Spell resistance 15.

Madness (Ex) gives −6 Wisdom and +6 Charisma, uses Charisma in place of Wisdom on Will saves, and grants immunity to confusion and insanity effects. Miracle or wish can restore sanity, reversing those ability adjustments and ending the trait.
Vulnerability to Sunlight (Ex). Take 1 Constitution damage per hour in sunlight. Constitution 0 is fatal. Recover 1 point per 24 hours spent underground or otherwise sheltered from sunlight.
+4 racial bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks.
Racial Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to eligible hits under the Rogue rules. Poison Use (Ex) protects the derro from accidentally poisoning itself while handling poison.
Racial spell-like abilities, CL 3. At will, darkness and ghost sound. Once per day each, daze and sound burst. Save DCs use Charisma.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Combat Casting adds +4 to Concentration when casting defensively or while grappled or pinned. No familiar is present.
actions: Small light crossbow +7 ranged for 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft.

Sorcerer spells known, CL 1. Detect magic, mage hand, message, and prestidigitation share five cantrip slots. Mage armor and color spray share four 1st-level slots. Mage armor raises AC to 20 for 1 hour, touch 14 and flat-footed 17. Color spray has Will DC 15.

Racial spell-like abilities keep CL 3. Ghost sound is Will DC 14 to disbelieve if interacted with. Daze is Will DC 14. Sound burst deals 1d8 sonic damage and has Fortitude DC 16 against its 1-round stun.
builds.tactics: Mira has mage armor active when she checks the gallery. She uses sound burst to stall pursuers at the entrance and then takes the covered route to the next chamber.

builds.title: Wemic gully guide, racial Hit Dice only
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 8 (5 racial HD, LA +3).
traits: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +2, size −1, and natural armor +4. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +5, grapple +15. Fortitude +6, Reflex +6, Will +5.
Large size imposes −1 on attacks and AC, −4 to Hide, and grants +4 on grapple checks. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. The player entry specifies twice Medium lifting and carrying limits.
+8 racial bonus on Jump. A 40-ft. land speed adds another +4 under the core Jump rule. Jumping is part of movement. A running jump needs 20 ft. of run-up, or the DC doubles.

Immune to magical sleep. +2 racial bonus on saves against enchantment spells and effects. Low-light vision. +2 racial Listen and Search. Passing within 5 ft. of a secret or concealed door grants a Search check as if actively looking.

Fly 50 ft. (average) when carrying a Medium load or less, wearing no heavy armor, and neither fatigued nor exhausted. The wings must have room to extend fully. A Run in flight must follow a straight line.
Average maneuverability requires at least 25 ft. of forward movement each round to stay aloft and provides no hover. Upward flight is at half speed, with a maximum ascent angle of 60 degrees.
Weapon Finesse applies Dexterity to the rapier attack roll. Flyby Attack lets Sael take one standard action during a flying move.
actions: Rapier +5 melee, 1d6+2 piercing, critical 18–20/×2.
On a clear dive-charge line that descends at least 30 ft., rapier +7 melee, 2d6+4 piercing on a hit or 3d6+6 on a confirmed critical. AC 15 until Sael’s next turn.
Flyby Attack. Split one flying move around a standard rapier attack at +5. Use the ordinary attack damage.
builds.tactics: Sael patrols the exposed ridge. He makes a flyby pass when he has room to keep moving. He saves the dive for an open line with enough height.

Bless (+1 morale on attacks and saves against fear for 2 minutes), cure light wounds (1d8+2 healing), shield of faith (+2 deflection AC for 2 minutes), and domain longstrider (+10 ft. to own land speed for 2 hours). builds.tactics: Iri starts with bless when there is time. She flies to a clear landing near the injured and treats them on the ground.

builds.title: Mind Flayer sealed-archive warden, racial Hit Dice only

Psionics (Sp), CL 8. At will, charm monster, detect thoughts, levitate, plane shift, and suggestion. Save DCs use Charisma.

Improved Grab (Ex). A tentacle hit on a Small, Medium, or Large creature allows a free grapple attempt without provoking. On success the tentacle attaches to the head. It can grab a Huge or larger creature if it can reach the head.

If one or more tentacles are attached at the start of the mind flayer’s turn, one grapple check can attach the rest. The target can escape all with one successful opposed grapple or Escape Artist check. The mind flayer gets a +2 circumstance bonus on the opposed check per tentacle attached at the start of the opponent’s turn.

Extract (Ex). Start the turn with all four tentacles attached and win a grapple check to extract the brain. This is normally fatal. The printed rule exempts constructs, elementals, oozes, plants, and undead, and extraction does not instantly kill a creature with multiple heads.
Telepathy (Su) communicates with a creature within 100 ft. that has a language. The two creatures can use different languages.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity for tentacle attacks. Weapon Focus (tentacle) adds +1 on those attacks.
actions: One tentacle +10 melee for 1d4+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2. A full attack uses four tentacles at +10 each.
Mind Blast Will DC 18. Charm monster Will DC 18, detect thoughts Will DC 16, and suggestion Will DC 17.
Starting with one attached tentacle, roll grapple +7 to attach the rest. If all four are attached at the start of a later turn, a successful grapple check then permits Extract.
builds.tactics: Ilyth contacts intruders telepathically from the archive entrance and tries to get them to leave. If a fight starts, Ilyth lines up Mind Blast clear of allies and leaves through the inner door if the archive cannot be held.

Soulless. Cannot use positive energy or divine magic or take levels in Cleric, Druid, or Paladin. Ranger levels grant no spellcasting. A Bard can learn inflict spells in place of cure spells. Return from death requires wish or miracle.
Weapon Focus adds +1 to claws. Flyby Attack lets Varek use one standard action during a flying move.
actions: Claw +9 melee, 1d4+4 piercing and slashing, critical ×2. Full attack with two claws at +9 each.

Touch +8 or claw +9 against normal AC, with Fortitude DC 13. Negative Energy Touch (Su), 3/day. Make a melee touch attack or deliver it with a claw that hits normal AC. Deals 2d6 damage and 1 point of Strength damage. Fortitude DC 12 + Charisma modifier negates the Strength damage only. The Kir-Lanan regains HP equal to the hit point damage dealt by the negative energy, up to its maximum HP. Ignore claw damage and Strength damage when calculating healing.

Ray of Enfeeblement, ranged touch +7. Ray of Enfeeblement (Sp), 3/day at caster level 4. Ranged touch within 35 ft. The target takes a 1d6+2 Strength penalty for 4 minutes, to a minimum score of 1. No save. Spell resistance applies.
Rebuke or command undead 3/day as Cleric 4. Turning check 1d20+1, turning damage 2d6+5.
builds.tactics: Varek uses the ledge as cover to read the room before showing himself. If cornered, he keeps an open flight path and saves the touch for when he is injured.

Fortitude becomes −1 against drow sleep poison and spiderkind venom before any bright-light penalty.
builds.tactics: Skriv climbs the ledge before signaling the party. If blocked, Skriv uses Skinshift against the damage type the defenders are dealing and aims the Shriek cone away from allies.

builds.title: Vril bridge sentinel, Fighter 4
builds.difficulty: CR 4. ECL 4 (4 class HD, LA +0).
traits: Neutral. Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +2, and size +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 17. Armor check penalty −4. BAB +4, grapple +3. Fortitude +8, Reflex +3, Will +2. Sonic resistance 5.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or daylight, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attacks, saves, and checks while in bright light.
Vulnerability to Poison (Ex). Take −4 on Fortitude saves against drow sleep poison and spiderkind venom.

Skinshift (Ex). As a move action, choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing and gain damage reduction 5 against that damage type for 3 + Constitution modifier rounds. One use per day, plus one more at 4th level and every four levels thereafter.

Shriek (Ex). Once per day as a standard action, emit a 15-ft.-radius burst centered on the vril or a 30-ft. cone. Creatures in the area take sonic damage. Reflex halves at DC 10 + half character level (round down) + Constitution modifier. Vril barbarians can use Shriek while raging.

Improved Initiative adds +4. Combat Reflexes permits up to three attacks of opportunity per round, including while flat-footed. Weapon Focus (short sword) adds +1 to attacks. Weapon Specialization (short sword) adds +2 damage. Dazing Shriek.
actions: Small short sword +9 melee for 1d4+5 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. Small javelin +7 ranged for 1d4+3 piercing, critical ×2, range increment 30 ft.

Skinshift twice per day lasts 7 rounds per use. Shriek once per day deals 2d6 sonic damage, Reflex DC 16 half. Dazing Shriek makes any creature that takes that damage roll a separate Fortitude DC 16 save or be dazed for 1 round.
Fortitude becomes +4 against drow sleep poison and spiderkind venom before any bright-light penalty.
builds.tactics: Brak shelters the crew behind the bridge return and uses the cone when attackers cross the open span. Brak chooses Skinshift against the damage type already seen and saves the second use for the retreat.

builds.title: Doppelganger courier liaison, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 skirmisher, 100 XP.
skills: Bluff +10 (+30 when impersonating a seen individual with Change Shape)
traits: Unaligned. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +3. Fortitude 11, Reflex 16, Will 15. Bloodied 9. One healing surge, worth 4 HP.

First Strike grants combat advantage against creatures that have not acted yet when the encounter starts. Sneak Attack adds 2d6 to one eligible hit per round with the dagger against a target granting combat advantage.
Rogue Weapon Talent adds +1 to dagger attack rolls. The printed NPC class grants trained Thievery and Bluff is the second trained skill.

Change Shape is an at-will Polymorph minor action. Assume the appearance of a Medium humanoid, including an individual you have seen. Your statistics and equipment stay the same. The form lasts until you change it or die. Someone challenging your impersonation of an individual rolls Insight against your Bluff with a +20 bonus to your roll.
actions: Dagger basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1 +5 vs. AC for 1d4+1, or ranged 5/10 +8 vs. AC for 1d4+4.
Sly Flourish (at-will, standard). Dagger melee or ranged 5/10, +8 vs. AC for 1d4+7.
Dazing Strike (encounter, standard). Dagger melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d4+4 and dazed until the end of Vessa’s next turn.

Easy Target (daily, standard). Dagger melee or ranged 5/10, +8 vs. AC for 2d4+4. The target is slowed and grants Vessa combat advantage, with one save ending both. On a miss, half damage and grants Vessa combat advantage until the end of Vessa’s next turn.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend the one healing surge to regain 4 HP. All defenses gain +2 until the start of Vessa’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Vessa borrows a familiar face to carry a reply through the gallery. If recognized, they use Dazing Strike to open a route to the stairs.

builds.title: Githyanki crossing scout, Warlord 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 soldier (leader), 100 XP.
traits: Unaligned. Chainmail +6 with −1 speed and −1 armor check penalty. Fortitude 15, Reflex 14, Will 14. Bloodied 11. One healing surge, worth 5 HP.
Gain +2 on saves against charm effects. Danger Sense +2 and Combat Leader +2 are included in initiative. Allies within 10 squares who see and hear Kareth gain +2 power bonus to initiative.
actions: Longsword basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. Wielded in one hand.
Wolf Pack Tactics (at-will, standard). Before attacking, one ally adjacent to Kareth or the target can shift 1 square as a free action. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4.

Guarding Attack (encounter, standard). Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 2d8+4. One ally adjacent to Kareth or the target gains +2 power bonus to AC against the target’s attacks until the end of Kareth’s next turn.
