Bastion of Defense (daily, standard). Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 3d8+4 on a hit. On a hit, allies within 5 squares gain +1 power bonus to all defenses for the encounter. Hit or miss, allies within 5 squares gain 6 temporary HP.
Inspiring Word (minor, close burst 5). Self or one ally can spend a healing surge and regain an additional 1d6 HP. Twice per encounter and once per round.
Telekinetic Leap is an encounter move action at range 10. You or one ally can fly up to 5 squares. If you choose an ally, they must stay in your line of sight throughout the flight.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend the one healing surge to regain 5 HP. All defenses gain +2 until the start of Kareth’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Kareth uses the leap on an ally who can see the far bank, then keeps that ally in sight throughout the crossing.

builds.title: Gnoll outrider, Ranger 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 skirmisher, 100 XP.
traits: Unaligned. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +4. Fortitude 14, Reflex 16, Will 12. Bloodied 11. One healing surge, worth 5 HP.

Archer Fighting Style gives Defensive Mobility, granting +2 AC against opportunity attacks. Hunter’s Quarry designates the nearest visible foe as a minor action. Once per round a hit against that foe can deal 1d6 extra damage.
Blood Fury adds 2 to damage rolls while you are bloodied, or 4 at level 21.
actions: Handaxe basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +5 vs. AC for 1d6+3. Longbow basic attack at range 20/40 is +7 vs. AC for 1d10+5.
Nimble Strike (at-will, standard). Shift 1 square before or after a longbow attack at range 20/40. +7 vs. AC for 1d10+5.
Two-Fanged Strike (encounter, standard). Two longbow attacks against one creature at range 20/40. Each is +7 vs. AC for 1d10+5. If both hit, deal 1 additional damage.

Hunter’s Bear Trap (daily, standard). Range 20/40, +7 vs. AC for 2d10+5, and the target is slowed and takes ongoing 5 damage (one save ends both). On a miss, half damage and slowed until the end of Rasha’s next turn.
Ferocious Charge (encounter, standard). With the handaxe ready, charge up to speed under the normal charge rules. +6 vs. AC for 1d6+5. If bloodied, damage is 1d6+7 before Hunter’s Quarry.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend the one healing surge to regain 5 HP. All defenses gain +2 until the start of Rasha’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Rasha starts at bow range. When a foe closes and leaves a charge lane, Rasha puts the bow aside and presses through that gap with the handaxe.

builds.title: Kobold switchback guide, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 skirmisher, 100 XP.
traits: Unaligned. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +4. Fortitude 14, Reflex 17, Will 12. Bloodied 12. One healing surge, worth 6 HP.
Trap Sense raises AC to 19, Fortitude to 16, Reflex to 19, and Will to 14 against traps.

First Strike grants combat advantage against creatures that have not acted yet when the encounter starts. Sneak Attack adds 2d6 to one eligible hit per round with the dagger against a target granting combat advantage.
Rogue Weapon Talent adds +1 to dagger attack rolls.
actions: Dagger basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1 +5 vs. AC for 1d4+1, or ranged 5/10 +9 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
Deft Strike (at-will, standard). May move 2 squares before a dagger attack. Melee or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
King’s Castle (encounter, standard). Melee or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. Reflex for 2d4+5 on a hit. Hit or miss, switch places with a willing adjacent ally.

Trick Strike (daily, standard). Melee or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 3d4+5 and slide the target 1 square on a hit. The target can also be slid 1 square each time Nik hits it for the rest of the encounter.
Shifty is an at-will personal minor action that lets you shift 1 square.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend the one healing surge to regain 6 HP. All defenses gain +2 until the start of Nik’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Nik points out the exposed shortcut, then uses Shifty to clear the doorway and make room for the party.

builds.title: Warforged doorholder, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 soldier, 100 XP.
traits: Unaligned. Scale +7 and heavy shield +2, with −1 speed and combined −2 armor check penalty. Fortitude 17, Reflex 14, Will 12. Bloodied 12. One healing surge, worth 6 HP.

Combat Challenge marks any creature Brasswake attacks until the end of Brasswake’s next turn. A marked creature takes −2 to attacks that exclude Brasswake. When an adjacent enemy marked by Brasswake shifts or attacks without including them, Brasswake can make a melee basic attack as an immediate interrupt.

Living Construct gives +2 on saves against ongoing damage. You can rest for 4 hours for an extended rest. You do not need to eat, drink, or breathe. On a death saving throw, you can take 10 if it is better than your roll.
actions: Longsword basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5. Wielded in one hand.
Tide of Iron (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5. With the shield equipped, on a hit push a target of Large size or smaller 1 square and optionally shift into its old square.
Passing Attack (encounter, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5. On a hit, may shift 1 square and make a secondary attack at +10 vs. AC for 1d8+5 against a different target.

Villain’s Menace (daily, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 2d8+5 and gain +2 to attacks and +4 to damage against that target for the encounter. A miss grants +1 to attacks and +2 to damage against that target.
Warforged Resolve (encounter, minor). While bloodied, gain 3 temporary HP.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend the one healing surge to regain 6 HP. All defenses gain +2 until the start of Brasswake’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Brasswake holds the narrower door. When pressed, they push the nearest foe away with Tide of Iron and use Warforged Resolve while bloodied.

builds.title: Deva archive negotiator, Invoker 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 Invoker NPC. Uses 4e character math.
traits: Unaligned, follows Ioun. Hide armor +3 and Intelligence +3. Fortitude 12, Reflex 14, Will 15. Bloodied 11. Seven healing surges at 5 HP. Improved Initiative adds +4. She uses a mundane quarterstaff as an implement.
Astral Majesty grants +1 to all defenses against a bloodied attacker. Resist 5 radiant and 5 necrotic. Immortal origin.
Covenant of Preservation. When she uses a divine encounter or daily attack on her turn, Selian can slide one ally within 10 squares 1 square. She uses one Channel Divinity power per encounter.
actions: Quarterstaff, melee basic. +2 vs. AC for 1d8 damage.
Sun Strike, at-will standard, ranged 10. +4 vs. Reflex, 1d8+4 radiant and slide the target 1 square. This also works as her ranged basic attack.
Divine Bolts, at-will standard, ranged 10. Choose one or two creatures. +4 vs. Reflex against each, 1d6+4 lightning on a hit.

Blades of Astral Fire, encounter standard, area burst 1 within 10. +4 vs. Reflex against enemies in the burst, 1d6+4 radiant. Allies in that burst gain +4 AC until the end of Selian’s next turn through Covenant of Preservation.
Binding Invocation of Chains, daily standard, close burst 10. +4 vs. Reflex against each enemy. Hit slows (save ends). Miss slows through the end of Selian’s next turn.
Preserver’s Rebuke, Channel Divinity encounter reaction. After an enemy within 10 squares hits an ally, add +3 to Selian’s next attack against that enemy before her next turn ends.
Rebuke Undead, Channel Divinity encounter standard, close blast 5 against undead. +4 vs. Will, 1d10+4 radiant, push 2 squares, and daze through the end of Selian’s next turn. Half damage on a miss.
Memory of a Thousand Lifetimes, encounter, no action. Add 1d6 after seeing an attack roll, saving throw, skill check, or ability check.
builds.tactics: Selian opens with Blades of Astral Fire to shield the archive staff, then uses Sun Strike to pull an attacker away from the reading desk. She saves Memory for a narrow miss.

builds.title: Githzerai threshold escort, Monk 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 Monk NPC. Uses 4e character math.
traits: Cloth, Dexterity +4 and Unarmored Defense +2. Fortitude 13, Reflex 15, Will 14. Bloodied 12. Eight healing surges at 6 HP. Initiative includes +2 Danger Sense and +4 Improved Initiative.

Centered Breath adds +1 Fortitude through Mental Equilibrium. A mundane ki focus provides no enhancement. Choose one Full Discipline per turn unless an action point permits switching. Its movement and attack techniques use their listed actions.
Defended Mind grants +2 on saving throws against daze, domination, and stun. On second wind, Reth can also shift 3 as a free action.
actions: Monk unarmed strike, melee basic. +4 vs. AC, 1d8+1 damage while at least one hand is free.
Five Storms, at-will Full Discipline. Standard attack, close burst 1, +4 vs. Reflex against visible enemies for 1d8+4. Movement technique shifts 2 squares as a move action.
Dragon’s Tail, at-will Full Discipline. Standard melee touch, +4 vs. Fortitude for 1d6+4 and prone. Its move technique swaps places with an adjacent ally or prone enemy.

Drunken Monkey, encounter Full Discipline. Standard melee touch, +4 vs. Will against an enemy for 1d8+4 and slide 1. The target then makes a free melee basic attack with +3 to hit against an enemy that Reth chooses. Its move technique moves up to 7 squares ignoring difficult terrain, with +3 to defenses against opportunity attacks.
Masterful Spiral, daily standard, close burst 1 against enemies. +4 vs. Reflex, 3d8+4 force and half damage on a miss. The stance increases melee touch reach by 1 until it ends.

Centered Flurry of Blows, free once per round after a hit on Reth’s turn. An adjacent creature takes 5 damage. Slide it to an adjacent square, or 1 square in any direction if the triggering attack did not target it.
Iron Mind, encounter immediate interrupt when hit. Increase all defenses by 2 until the end of Reth’s next turn and check the triggering attack against the boosted defense.
builds.tactics: Reth uses Iron Mind to hold the doorway, and Dragon’s Tail to trade places with an ally. Second wind and Shifting Fortunes move him back into the next choke point.

builds.title: Minotaur tunnel sentinel, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 Fighter NPC. Uses 4e character math.
traits: Scale +7 and heavy shield +2. Fortitude 16, Reflex 13, Will 11. Bloodied 18. Thirteen healing surges at 9 HP including Vitality. Toughness adds 5 HP. The heavy shield gives −2 on physical skill checks.

One-handed Fighter Weapon Talent adds +1 to warhammer attacks. Combat Challenge can mark an attacked enemy through the end of Brann’s next turn. The mark gives −2 to attacks that exclude Brann. If a creature he marked is adjacent and shifts or makes an attack excluding him, he can make a melee basic attack as an immediate interrupt.

Combat Superiority adds +1 to opportunity attack rolls. When one hits a creature whose movement provoked it, that movement stops. Heedless Charge adds 2 AC against opportunity attacks during a charge.
actions: Warhammer, melee basic, +7 vs. AC for 1d10+4 damage. Opportunity attack is +8 vs. AC.
Sure Strike, at-will standard. +9 vs. AC, 1d10 damage.
Tide of Iron, at-will standard with shield. +7 vs. AC for 1d10+4. Push an eligible enemy 1 square, then optionally shift into its vacated square. At Medium size Brann can push targets up to Large.
Covering Attack, encounter standard. +7 vs. AC, 2d10+4 and an ally adjacent to the target can shift 2 squares.
Comeback Strike, daily standard, reliable. +7 vs. AC, 2d10+4 and Brann can spend a healing surge.
Goring Charge, encounter standard. Charge up to speed 5 under the normal charge rules and use the horn attack instead of the basic. +9 vs. AC with the charge bonus included, 1d6+4 and prone on a hit.
Ferocity, immediate interrupt when reduced to 0 HP or fewer. Make a melee basic attack if an immediate action is available.
builds.tactics: Brann uses Goring Charge to put a blocker on the ground, then positions his shield to keep the route open. He uses Covering Attack when somebody needs to withdraw.

builds.title: Shardmind gate surveyor, Wizard 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 Wizard NPC. Uses 4e character math.
traits: Cloth, Intelligence +4 and Staff of Defense +1. Fortitude 12, Reflex 14, Will 14. Bloodied 12. Eight healing surges at 6 HP. Improved Initiative adds +4.

Immortal living construct. Resist 5 psychic and telepathy 5 squares with creatures that have a language. The extra shardmind skill bonus applies to Religion. Staff of Defense once per encounter adds 2 to the defense targeted by one attack as an immediate interrupt.
Ritual Caster and four wizard cantrips. Daily prepared spell is Sleep. Flaming Sphere is the alternate spell in Nura’s book.
actions: Quarterstaff, melee basic. +2 vs. AC for 1d8 damage.
Ray of Frost, at-will standard, ranged 10. +4 vs. Fortitude, 1d6+4 cold and slowed until the end of Nura’s next turn.
Thunderwave, at-will standard, close blast 3 against creatures. +4 vs. Fortitude, 1d6+4 thunder and push 2 squares.

Icy Terrain, encounter standard, area burst 1 within 10 against creatures. +4 vs. Reflex, 1d6+4 cold and prone. The burst creates difficult terrain until the end of Nura’s next turn. Nura can end it as a minor action.
Sleep, daily standard, area burst 2 within 20 against creatures. +4 vs. Will, slowed (save ends) on hit or miss. A hit target that fails its first save becomes unconscious (save ends).
Shard Swarm, encounter move, close burst 1. Enemies in the burst grant combat advantage to Nura until the end of Nura’s next turn. Then teleport 3 squares.
builds.tactics: Nura lays Icy Terrain across a lane and uses Shard Swarm to escape enemies that close the distance. If they crowd together, Nura uses the exposed angles to land Thunderwave.

builds.title: Wilden crossing guardian, Warden 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 Warden NPC. Uses 4e character math.
traits: Hide +3, Earthstrength uses Constitution +3 for AC, and heavy shield +2. Fortitude 14, Reflex 12, Will 14 after Hardy Form adds +1 Will. Bloodied 19. Twelve healing surges at 9 HP. Toughness adds 5 HP. Armor and shield give −3 on physical skill checks.
Fey origin. Aspect of the Hunter is active, chosen after the last extended rest. Font of Life gives one extra save at the start of Briar’s turn against a save-ends effect.

Nature’s Wrath once on each of Briar’s turns marks each adjacent enemy as a free action until the end of Briar’s next turn. A marked foe takes −2 on an attack roll if the attack excludes Briar. Earthstrength adds +3 AC to the usual +2 defenses during second wind, until Briar’s next turn ends.
actions: Longsword, melee basic, +6 vs. AC for 1d8+3 damage.
Earth Shield Strike, at-will standard, melee. +6 vs. AC, 1d8+3 and Briar gains +1 power AC until the end of their next turn.
Weight of Earth, at-will standard, melee. +6 vs. AC, 1d8+3 and slowed until the end of Briar’s next turn.
Hungry Earth, encounter standard, close burst 1 against enemies. +6 vs. Fortitude, 1d8+3. Its area is difficult terrain for enemies through the end of Briar’s next turn.

Form of the Willow Sentinel, daily minor. Until the encounter ends, Briar can negate a pull, push, or slide against them and adjacent allies gain +2 power Fortitude. Once in this form, when an adjacent enemy attacks an ally, interrupt with +6 vs. AC. Hit deals 1d8+3 and −4 to the triggering roll. Miss deals half damage and −2 to that roll.

Warden’s Fury, at-will immediate interrupt against a marked enemy in weapon reach that makes an attack excluding Briar. +6 vs. Fortitude, 1d8+3 and the target grants combat advantage to Briar and allies through the end of Briar’s next turn.
Warden’s Grasp, at-will immediate reaction when a marked enemy within 5 makes an attack excluding Briar. Slide it 1 square, slow it and stop it shifting through the end of its current turn.

Pursuit of the Hunter, encounter immediate reaction when an enemy within 2 squares moves on its turn. Shift 3. Through the end of Briar’s next turn, hits against that enemy deal +1d6 damage and ignore its normal −2 cover or concealment penalty.
builds.tactics: Briar marks enemies near the footbridge, then uses Weight of Earth to slow the one nearest the trail. When another foe runs, Briar follows with Pursuit of the Hunter.

builds.difficulty: 4e level 1, PC-style
builds.title: Firesoul Genasi forge ward, Swordmage 1
traits: Fortitude 12, Reflex 15, Will 12. Bloodied 14. Ten healing surges, worth 7 each.
Leather armor and a longsword in one hand. Swordmage Warding gives +3 AC with the other hand free, +1 with a blade and no free hand. The ward applies while conscious and wielding a blade.
Firesoul grants fire resistance 5 and contributes +1 Reflex. Firepulse uses Strength.
Retributive Shield grants +2 to the next attack against the foe whose attack triggered Aegis of Shielding, through the end of Avarra’s next turn.
actions: Longsword basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +5 vs. AC, 1d8+2 damage.
Greenflame Blade, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC, 1d8+4 fire. On a hit each enemy adjacent to the target takes 2 fire.
Sword Burst, at-will standard. Close burst 1, each enemy, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4 force.
Flame Cyclone, encounter standard. Close blast 3, each creature, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d8+6 fire.
Frost Backlash, daily immediate interrupt when an adjacent creature hits Avarra. Melee 1, +7 vs. Reflex for 3d8+4 cold, half on a miss.

Aegis of Shielding, at-will minor, close burst 2, marks a creature until another Aegis target or a superseding mark. Attacks that omit Avarra take −2. When such an attack hits and that foe is within 10 squares, immediate interrupt to reduce its damage to one creature by 7.
Firepulse, encounter immediate reaction after an enemy within 1 square hits Avarra with a melee attack. +4 vs. Reflex for 1d6+2 fire.
builds.tactics: Marks the creature blocking the exit, using her immediate action to shield a worker or answer a melee hit. Keeps the blast pointed away from the crew.

builds.difficulty: 4e level 1, PC-style
builds.title: Kalashtar dream mediator, Cleric 1
builds.senses: Normal vision, passive Insight 21 and Perception 14
traits: Fortitude 11, Reflex 11, Will 16. Bloodied 14. Seven healing surges, worth 7 each. Chainmail, holy symbol, and Toughness.
Uses Diplomacy for the flexible +2 racial skill bonus. Makes Dual Soul saves at turn start, with no turn-end retry for a failed early save.
Healer’s Lore adds +4 to healing granted by a cleric power that makes the target spend a surge. Follows the Path of Light. Ritual Casting grants Gentle Repose and Comprehend Language.
actions: Mace basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +3 vs. AC for 1d8+1 damage.
Lance of Faith, at-will standard. Ranged 5, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d8+4 radiant and one ally Sena sees gets +2 power bonus on its next attack against the target.
Sacred Flame, at-will standard. Ranged 5, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4 radiant. One visible ally can save or gain 3 temporary HP.
Divine Glow, encounter standard. Close blast 3, each enemy, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d8+4 radiant. Allies in the blast get +2 power bonus to attacks until the end of Sena’s next turn.

Beacon of Hope, daily standard. Close burst 3, each enemy, +4 vs. Will to weaken it through the end of its next turn. Sena and allies in the burst regain 5 HP, and her healing powers heal 5 more through the encounter.
Healing Word, encounter minor, twice per encounter and once per round. In close burst 5, Sena or an ally spends a surge and regains 1d6+4 more HP.

Channel Divinity, choose either power once per encounter. Divine Fortune is free and gives +1 to the next attack or save through the end of Sena’s next turn. Turn Undead is standard, close burst 2, +4 vs. Will against each undead for 1d10+4 radiant, pushing 6 and immobilizing through the end of Sena’s next turn. Miss for half damage only.

Bastion of Mental Clarity, encounter immediate interrupt when an enemy hits or misses Sena against Will. Sena and allies in close burst 5 gain +4 power bonus to Will through the end of Sena’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Keeps allies in reach of her telepathy and defends their Will against a shared threat. Opens with Divine Glow when the group can stay close.

builds.difficulty: 4e level 1, PC-style
builds.title: Mul caravan shield, Fighter 1
traits: Fortitude 16, Reflex 13, Will 11. Bloodied 15. Thirteen healing surges, worth 7 each, including Mul Vitality.
Scale armor, heavy shield, and longsword. One-Handed Fighter Weapon Talent adds +1 to attacks. Weapon Focus adds +1 damage with heavy blades.
Born of Two Races choice is dwarf. Tireless requires 6 hours of sleep per 72 hours for an extended rest.

Combat Challenge can mark each target Daro attacks through the end of his next turn. A mark penalizes attacks omitting him by −2. If his adjacent marked foe shifts or attacks without targeting him, immediate interrupt for a melee basic attack.
Combat Superiority gives +1 to opportunity attacks. A hit stops the movement that provoked it.
actions: Longsword basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC, 1d8+5 damage. As an opportunity attack, +9.
Cleave, at-will standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5 and 4 damage to another enemy adjacent to Daro on a hit.
Tide of Iron, at-will standard using a shield. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5. Push the target 1 if Large or smaller, then Daro can shift into its former square.
Covering Attack, encounter standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 2d8+5 and lets an ally adjacent to the target shift 2.

Villain’s Menace, daily standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 2d8+5, with +2 power bonus to attacks and +4 to damage versus that foe through the encounter. Miss gains +1 to attacks and +2 to damage against it instead.
Incredible Toughness, encounter, no action at turn start. End ongoing damage or a dazed, slowed, stunned, or weakened condition.
builds.tactics: Uses Tide of Iron to regain the choke point. Saves Incredible Toughness for a turn when a condition would keep him from covering the caravan.

builds.difficulty: 4e level 1, PC-style
builds.title: Thri-kreen clutch scout, Ranger 1
traits: Fortitude 13, Reflex 15, Will 11. Bloodied 13. Eight healing surges, worth 6 each.
Leather armor and longbow. A walking spear is backup. Archery style grants Defensive Mobility, for AC 18 against opportunity attacks.
Weapon Focus adds +1 damage with bows. Prime Shot adds +1 to a ranged attack if none of K’tcha’s allies is closer to the target.
Hunter’s Quarry, minor, designates the nearest visible enemy and adds 1d6 once per round on a hit against it.
Multiple Arms changes one minor item interaction to free each turn. Natural Jumper counts every jump as a running start. Four-hour aware torpor suffices for rest.
actions: Longbow basic attack, standard. Range 20/40, +6 vs. AC, 1d10+5 damage.
Spear basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +4 vs. AC for 1d8+2.
Twin Strike, at-will standard. Longbow, +6 vs. AC twice against one or two creatures, 1d10+1 per hit.
Nimble Strike, at-will standard. Longbow, shift 1 before or after the attack, +6 vs. AC for 1d10+5.
Evasive Strike, encounter standard. Longbow, shift up to 2 before or after the attack, +6 vs. AC for 2d10+5.
Split the Tree, daily standard. Longbow against two creatures within 3 squares of each other. Make two +6 attacks and compare the higher roll to both ACs. Deal 2d10+5 to each hit.
Thri-Kreen Claws, encounter minor. Melee 1 against one to three enemies, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4 plus the number targeted, even if not all attacks hit.
builds.tactics: Shoots from the edge of a gap. Uses the rapid draw to keep moving, then spends the minor claw power if cornered by several enemies.

builds.difficulty: 4e level 1, PC-style
builds.title: Bladeling gate sentinel, Rogue 1
builds.senses: Normal vision, passive Insight 16 and Perception 16
traits: Fortitude 12, Reflex 16, Will 11. Bloodied 15. Seven healing surges, worth 7 each.
Leather armor, dagger, and Toughness. Artful Dodger gives AC 17 against opportunity attacks. Extra +1 weapon talent attack with a dagger.
Resist acid 5 at level 1. Razor Storm uses Dexterity to attack.

First Strike grants combat advantage against creatures yet to act in round one. Once per turn under the rules update, an eligible dagger hit against a target granting combat advantage adds 2d6 Sneak Attack damage.
actions: Dagger basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +6 vs. AC for 1d4+2 damage.
Sly Flourish, at-will standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
Piercing Strike, at-will standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. Reflex for 1d4+4.
Dazing Strike, encounter standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d4+4 and dazes the target through the end of Varik’s next turn.
Trick Strike, daily standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 3d4+4 and slides the target 1. On a hit against that target later this encounter, slide it 1.
Razor Storm, encounter minor. Close burst 1 against each creature, +6 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4.
builds.tactics: Feints to separate an intruder from the porters. Uses Razor Storm only after allies clear his immediate reach.

builds.title: Karsite shieldwright, Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: CR 3 by the Karsite PC-class formula. ECL 4 (2 class HD, LA +2).
traits: Neutral. Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16, armor check penalty −4. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +6, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Damage reduction 5/magic. Spell resistance 12. A spell blocked by spell resistance heals Ilyra 2 HP per spell level. Cannot cast arcane or divine spells.
Ability Focus (Magic-Draining Attacks) raises the suppression save DC by 2. Iron Will, Weapon Focus (longsword), and Power Attack.
actions: Longsword +6 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, 19–20/×2. Power Attack can trade up to 2 attack bonus for equal additional damage with the one-handed sword.

After each hit, the target makes a DC 14 Will save or one magical weapon, armor, or shield is suppressed for 1 round. If Ilyra can see a known magical item of the right kind, she chooses it. Otherwise, determine the item randomly.
builds.tactics: Ilyra stands between intruders and the apprentices. She uses the sword to suppress equipment when fighting a heavily armored rival.

builds.title: Lumi oath witness, racial Hit Dice only
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2, following the published racial benchmark. ECL 4 (2 racial HD, LA +2).
traits: Lawful neutral. Chain shirt +4. Touch 10, flat-footed 14, armor check penalty −2. BAB +2, grapple +4. Fortitude +7, Reflex +3, Will +6. Weapon Focus (morningstar) and racial bonus Improved Initiative.
Sheds white light to 5 ft. Immune to negative energy, energy drain, magical death effects, blinding, dazzling, and direct light attacks. Concealment still applies.
Floating Head prevents suffocation, strangulation, and vorpal decapitation. Foes gain no flanking bonus.
actions: Morningstar +5 melee, 1d8+2 bludgeoning and piercing, ×2.
Spell-like abilities, caster level 3. Light and disrupt undead at will. Disrupt undead is a +2 ranged touch attack for 1d6 damage to undead, no save.
Cure light wounds 3/day, 1d8+3 healing. Glitterdust 3/day, DC 13 Will negates blindness only. Both revealed dust and blindness last up to 3 rounds.
builds.tactics: Aurin stands where the witnesses can see both exits. If a concealed intruder interferes, he uses glitterdust and turns back to escort the witnesses.

builds.title: Maug ramp engineer, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 4. ECL 6 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3).
traits: Lawful neutral. No Constitution score. Large −1, natural armor +7, Dexterity +3. Touch 12, flat-footed 16. BAB +2, grapple +11, space and reach 10 ft. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +0.
Spell resistance 15. Construct traits, Rapid Repair 1 HP/hour at 1 HP or more. An assistant with a DC 15 Craft (stonemasonry) check can raise it to 2 HP/hour. No grafts fitted.
Power Attack, Fighter bonus Improved Sunder, and racial bonus Alertness.
actions: Large warhammer held in two hands +6 melee, 2d6+7 bludgeoning, ×3. One slam +6 melee, 1d8+7 bludgeoning, ×2.

Pulverize 3/day, standard action, melee touch +6 against attended objects, no attack of opportunity. On contact remove hardness for 1d4 rounds, Fortitude DC 18 negates. Up to a 10-ft. cube of material. Unattended nonmagical objects get no save.

With the warhammer, Improved Sunder prevents provoking and grants +4 on opposed attack rolls. Two-handed use grants a further +4 in that contest. Apply the separate size bonus when Basalt is larger than the defender.
builds.tactics: Basalt tests the broken loading ramp before putting weight on it. If the gate jams, he pulverizes its seized fittings and breaks them with the hammer.

builds.title: Varoot Nerra threshold guide, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 5 (2 class HD, LA +3).
traits: Neutral. Natural armor +3, Dexterity +4. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +2, Reflex +7, Will +2. Trapfinding, evasion, and Improved Initiative.
Reflective spell resistance 14. Reflects targeted spells it successfully resists, and reflects gaze attacks. Cold, electricity, and fire resistance 5. Takes half again as much sonic damage.
Racial bonus Exotic Weapon Proficiency (shard dagger and shard longsword). Uses revised wounding on the shard dagger.
actions: +2 wounding shard dagger +4 melee or +7 ranged, 1d4+3 piercing or slashing as a dagger, 19–20/×2, 10-ft. range increment. When wounding applies, the hit also deals 1 Constitution damage. Sneak attack +1d6 when eligible (within 30 ft. at range).

Disguise self 3/day and mirror image 1/day, caster level 12. Disguise self lasts 120 minutes and adds +10 to the Disguise check, Will DC 15 to disbelieve when interacted with. Mirror image creates 1d4+4 images for up to 12 minutes.
Mirror Jump at will, standard action. Vanish through a mirror to another mirror at most 1 mile away. A usable reflective non-mirror is a 30% entry chance and never an exit.
builds.tactics: Sive offers a way out through the mirror if the party can bring the missing apprentice. When cornered, Sive makes mirror images and stays close to the exit.

builds.title: Centaur trail envoy, 4 racial HD
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 6.
traits: Neutral good. BAB +4, grapple +13. Fort +4, Ref +7, Will +6. Touch 12, flat-footed 12.

Natural armor +3, Dexterity +3, Large size −1 to AC and attacks. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft., or 10 ft. with the lance against distant targets. Feats are Martial Weapon Proficiency (lance) and Weapon Focus (longbow), which also covers composite longbows.
Racial ranks, Listen 4, Move Silently 3, Spot 4, Survival 3.
actions: Large composite longbow (+5 Str rating) +7 ranged, 2d6+5 piercing, critical ×3, 110-ft. range increment.
Large lance +8 melee, 2d6+7 piercing wielded two-handed, critical ×3. A legal charge raises the attack to +10, deals 4d6+14 on an ordinary hit, and costs 2 AC until the next turn.
In a full attack, add two secondary hooves at +3 for 1d6+2 bludgeoning each against targets in natural reach.
builds.tactics: Myrine uses the bow while the families open a clear path. She lowers her lance only if there is room for a straight charge.

builds.title: Hound Archon road warden, 6 racial HD
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 4. ECL 11.
traits: Lawful good. BAB +6, grapple +10. Fort +7, Ref +6, Will +7, all +4 against poison. Touch 11, flat-footed 19. Unarmored with natural armor +9 and Dexterity +1.
DR 10/evil, SR 16, immune to electricity and petrification. His constant CL 6 magic circle against evil gives its situational protection, outside the listed base AC and saves.

Aura of menace activates in a fight or when angry. Hostiles within 20 ft. save at Will DC 17 or take −2 to attacks, AC, and saves for 24 hours or until they hit him. A successful save or a hit that ends it prevents repeat exposure for 24 hours.
Nine racial ranks in each listed skill. Improved Initiative, Power Attack, and Track. Creatures with a language can speak with him through tongues.
actions: Bite +10 melee, 1d8+4 piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning. In a full attack add a secondary slam +5 for 1d4+2 bludgeoning. Greatsword +10/+5 on a full attack, 2d6+6 slashing, critical 19–20/×2.
Use a canine form to follow a trail. Hide and Survival each gain +4 circumstance in canine form, before adjusting for the form's other statistics. The form supplies its own bite.
At will CL 6 aid, continual flame, detect evil, and message. Aid grants +1 morale to attacks and fear saves plus 1d8+6 temporary HP for 6 minutes.
Greater teleport at will, CL 14, carrying only himself and up to 50 lb. of objects.
builds.tactics: Brindle takes canine form to pick up a trail, then speaks to the group before closing. He opens with aid on the ally who has to hold the ford.

builds.title: Janni elemental surveyor, 6 racial HD
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 4. ECL 11.
traits: Neutral. BAB +6, grapple +10. Fort +7, Ref +8, Will +8. Touch 13, flat-footed 11. Unarmored with natural armor +1 and Dexterity +3.
Fire resistance 10. She can stay on an Elemental Plane for 48 hours before taking 1 damage per additional hour. She checks the elapsed time before offering another crossing.
Nine racial ranks in each listed skill. Dodge, Mobility, Weapon Focus (scimitar), and racial Improved Initiative.
actions: Scimitar +11 melee, 1d6+4 slashing, critical 18–20/×2. Iterative attack at +6 on a full attack.
Change size 2/day, Fort DC 14 if resisted, as enlarge person or reduce person and can affect Nura despite her type.
Invisibility (self only) and speak with animals 3/day each, CL 12. Ethereal jaunt 1/day for 1 hour, CL 12. Create food and water 1/day, CL 7.
Plane shift at CL 13 to the Material, Astral, or Elemental Planes. Nura can bring up to eight other creatures who link hands with her.
builds.tactics: Nura changes size to clear a tight route or uses invisibility to approach a stranded crew. She saves plane shift for the return when everyone can link hands.

builds.title: Lizardfolk channel warden, 2 racial HD
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 3.
traits: Neutral. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fort +3, Ref +4, Will +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. Dexterity +1 and natural armor +5, with no shield.
Racial ranks are Balance 4, Jump 3, Swim 3. Each check has the +4 racial bonus. Hold breath up to 64 rounds before drowning checks. Weapon Focus (claw).
actions: Claw +5 melee, 1d4+3 piercing and slashing. A full attack adds a second claw at the same bonus and a secondary bite at −1 for 1d4+1 piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning.
Use Swim +10 to reach and release the ferry line. On a successful full-round Swim check, Vesh can go up to 15 ft.
builds.tactics: Vesh keeps both hands available for the rope and enters the water before the ferry pulls taut.

builds.title: Pixie screen courier, Sorcerer 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 5. ECL 5.
traits: Neutral good. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fort +1, Ref +4, Will +4. Touch 15, flat-footed 12. Natural armor +1, Dexterity +4, Small size +1. Dodge gives +1 AC against a designated foe.
DR 10/cold iron and SR 16. Constant greater invisibility, including while attacking. Suppress or resume it as a free action.

Improved Initiative, racial Dodge and Weapon Finesse. Ranks are 4 each in Bluff, Concentration, Knowledge (arcana), and Spellcraft, with 2 cross-class ranks in Hide. No familiar is present in this encounter.
actions: Small longbow +5 ranged with ordinary arrows, 1d6−1 piercing (minimum 1), critical ×3, 100-ft. range increment.

Racial SLAs at CL 8, each 1/day. Lesser confusion DC 15, dancing lights, all four alignment detects, detect thoughts DC 16, dispel magic, entangle DC 15, and permanent image DC 20 for visual and auditory effects only.

Sorcerer CL 1, five cantrip and four 1st-level castings per day. Known cantrips are detect magic, ghost sound (DC 14), mage hand, and prestidigitation. First-level spells known are mage armor (+4 armor AC for 1 hour) and obscuring mist (1 minute).
builds.tactics: Bren waits above the path, uses an image or sound to draw attention, and crosses while the patrol is watching the decoy.

builds.title: Shadowborn Bearfolk waystone warden, Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Constitution save +4. AC 17 from 13 + Dexterity + shield.
Powerful Build. Halla counts as Large when determining carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting capacity.
Cloak of Night. In dim light or darkness, Halla has advantage on Stealth checks and can Hide as a bonus action when able to hide.
Protection fighting style. With shield in hand, use a reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack from someone Halla can see against another target within 5 ft. of her.
Action Surge once per short or long rest gives one extra action on her turn.
actions: Handaxe. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 slashing.
Bite. Melee unarmed attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 piercing.
Second Wind. Bonus action, recover 1d10 + 2 HP once per short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Halla positions her shield beside the first traveler to reach the stones. She uses the dark verge for cover when the waystone needs to be inspected.

builds.title: Bearfolk-heritage Darakhul ferryman, Barbarian 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Constitution save +4. Unarmored AC 10 + Dexterity + Constitution.
Imperfect Undeath. Humanoid vulnerable to effects that target undead. Rell can receive ordinary healing.
Resist necrotic and poison. Immune to disease. Advantage on saves against charm and poison. Sunlight Sensitivity applies to attacks and sight-based Perception.
Undead Vitality. Rell does not breathe. The encounter assumes Rell has fed within the past 24 hours.
Undead Fortitude. Once per long rest, drop to 1 HP instead of 0 when the hit does not kill Rell outright.
Reckless Attack. On the first attack of his turn, Rell can claim advantage on Strength-based melee weapon attacks that turn. Attacks against him then have advantage until his next turn.
Danger Sense gives advantage on Dexterity saves against visible effects while Rell can see, hear and act.
actions: Bite. Melee unarmed attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 piercing.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 bludgeoning, or 1d8 + 3 with two hands.

Rage. Bonus action, twice per long rest. Up to 1 minute, advantage on Strength checks and saves, +2 damage to Strength-based melee weapon attacks, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. Ends early on unconsciousness, or at the end of a turn if he has neither attacked a hostile creature since the last turn nor taken damage since then.
builds.tactics: Rell holds the landing long enough for passengers to clear it. If pushed into the river, he uses the fact that he does not breathe to reach the rope below the waterline.

builds.title: Quickstep dueling courier, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +3. Leather armor 11 + Dexterity.
Fey Ancestry. Advantage on saves against charm. Magic cannot put Copperflash to sleep.
Startling Speed, two rounds per day. After moving at least 10 ft. on his turn, attacks against him have disadvantage until the start of his next turn. Incapacitation or restraint prevents its use.
Sneak Attack once per turn adds 1d6 damage to a hit with a finesse or ranged weapon if he has advantage, or an active ally is within 5 ft. of the target and he has no disadvantage.
Expertise in Persuasion and Stealth.
actions: Rapier. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d8 + 3 piercing.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 piercing.
Cunning Action. Bonus action to Dash, Disengage or Hide.
builds.tactics: Copperflash spends his speed protection crossing open floor. If someone closes in, he Disengages before running toward the next exit.

builds.title: Tradvakt Ratatosk tree guard, Ranger 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
builds.languages: Understands, reads and writes Celestial and Common. Knows Umber Hulk through Favored Enemy. Speaks through telepathy 20 ft.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +3 and Dexterity save +5. Studded leather AC 12 + Dexterity + shield + 1 from the Defense fighting style.
Grounded Celestial. Humanoid, susceptible to effects that target celestials.
Telepathic speech to a creature Minnet can see within 20 ft. if it understands a language.
Favored Enemy, monstrosities. Advantage on Survival to track them and on Intelligence checks to recall information about them.
Natural Explorer, forest. Double proficiency for proficient Intelligence or Wisdom checks related to forest terrain. See class travel rules for journeys of at least one hour.
actions: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d6 + 1 piercing.
Dart. Ranged weapon attack +5, range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 piercing.
Tusks. Melee unarmed attack +3, reach 5 ft. Hit 1 piercing plus 1d4 psychic.

War Chatter. Bonus action once per short or long rest. One non-Ratatosk creature within 30 ft. that can hear Minnet makes a DC 12 Charisma save. Failure gives disadvantage on attack rolls until Minnet’s next turn.

Two 1st-level spell slots. Hunter’s Mark is a bonus action and requires concentration. It adds 1d6 on weapon hits against the mark. Cure Wounds is an action that heals 1d8 + 1 on touch. Minnet frees the spear hand for the somatic component.
builds.tactics: Minnet issues directions silently while closing on the route marker. She uses War Chatter to give the least armored traveler a turn to get behind her.

builds.title: Shadow Goblin road mediator, Bard 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Charisma save +5. Leather AC 11 + Dexterity.
Jack of All Trades adds +1 to checks without proficiency, including initiative. Song of Rest adds 1d6 to healing for allies who spend Hit Dice on a short rest and can hear Merrin.
Shadow Camouflage gives advantage on Stealth checks to hide in dim light or darkness. Sunlight Sensitivity hampers attacks and sight-based Perception in direct sunlight.
Unseelie Blessing gives advantage on saves against charm and prevents magical sleep.
actions: Rapier. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d8 + 3 piercing.
Stink Eye. Action, visible target within 30 ft. who can see and hear Merrin, Charisma DC 13. On failure, disadvantage on its next ability check, attack roll or saving throw before Merrin’s next turn.

Bardic Inspiration. Bonus action, a creature other than Merrin within 60 ft. that can hear him gets 1d6 to add once to an ability check, attack roll or save within 10 minutes. Three uses per long rest.

Spellcasting, Charisma DC 13 and spell attack +5. Three 1st-level slots. Cantrips Mage Hand and Vicious Mockery. Known spells Charm Person, Disguise Self, Dissonant Whispers, Faerie Fire, and Healing Word.
Vicious Mockery. Action, visible creature within 60 ft. that can hear Merrin, Wisdom DC 13. Failure deals 1d4 psychic and imposes disadvantage on its next attack roll before its next turn ends.
Healing Word. Bonus action, visible creature within 60 ft. regains 1d4 + 3 HP. This spell has no effect on Undead or Constructs.

Dissonant Whispers. Action, target within 60 ft., Wisdom DC 13. Failure deals 3d6 psychic and requires the target to spend its reaction if available to move away as far as its speed allows without entering obviously dangerous ground. Success halves damage and prevents that movement. A deafened creature succeeds automatically.
builds.tactics: Merrin uses Stink Eye to break the aggressor’s focus and offers an exit before anyone draws steel. He saves Healing Word for an ally already down.

builds.title: Disembodied missing-person investigator, Divination Wizard 3
builds.difficulty: Wizard 3. Proficiency bonus +2. Control and planar escape.
traits: Intelligence save +5 and Wisdom save +3. AC 15 with mage armor active. Shield can add +5 AC as a reaction after a hit or when targeted by magic missile.

Portent. After a long rest, roll two d20s and record them. Before a visible creature or Elian makes an attack roll, save, or ability check, replace the roll with one recording. Each can be used once and only one can be used per turn.

Fade Away, once per long rest. Use an action to enter the Ethereal Plane for up to 1 minute, cut off from interactions with the Material Plane. Return as a bonus action or when it ends, at the closest free space to the departure point.
Planar Outcast. Self-only feather fall and blur each once per day through the species. Blur requires concentration for up to 1 minute.
Arcane Recovery. Once per day after a short rest, recover expended wizard spell slots totaling up to two levels.
actions: Dagger. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., 1d4+2 piercing.
Fire bolt. +5 ranged spell attack, range 120 ft., 1d10 fire. Other cantrips are mage hand and prestidigitation.

Wizard spells, DC 13 and +5 spell attack. Four 1st-level slots and two 2nd-level slots. Prepared 1st level spells are mage armor, magic missile, and shield. Prepared 2nd level spells are detect thoughts, invisibility, and misty step.
builds.tactics: Elian prefers to preserve a witness and escape with a statement. He uses invisibility to withdraw, or Fade Away to wait out danger near his departure point.

builds.title: Dreamer expedition archivist, Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: Fighter 2. Proficiency bonus +2. Exploration and defense.
builds.languages: Common, Dreamspeak, Dwarvish, Elvish, and Giant.
skills: Cartographer’s tools +4 with Intelligence through Dreamwalking
traits: Strength and Constitution saves +4. Chain shirt, shield, and Defense fighting style give AC 18.

Dreamwalking. While asleep Vela can touch the dreams of others within 1 mile. Today’s choice of cartographer’s tools adds her +2 proficiency bonus to applicable rolls. Sleep does not penalize her nonvisual Perception checks.
Power Nap. Sleep for 1 hour during a short rest to remove one level of exhaustion and regain one spent Hit Die on top of the regular rest benefits.
Action Surge. Take one extra action on your turn, once per short or long rest.
Second Wind. As a bonus action, regain 1d10+2 HP, once per short or long rest.
actions: Rapier. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8+2 piercing.
Javelin. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., 1d6+2 piercing.
builds.tactics: Vela blocks the passage with her shield while expedition members retreat. A safe hour lets her recover a spent die and scout for nearby dreams.

builds.title: Laneshi warrior shore escort, Ranger 2
builds.difficulty: Ranger 2. Proficiency bonus +2. Amphibious skirmisher.
traits: Strength save +5 and Dexterity save +4. Studded leather, shield, and Defense fighting style give AC 17.
Amphibious. Breathes air and water. Laneshi warrior training supplies Animal Handling and proficiency with spears, tridents, javelins, and light armor.
Skirmish Tactics. After hitting a hostile creature with a weapon attack, take Disengage as a bonus action before the end of the turn.
Beast Whisperers. Speak with animals once per long rest through the species.
Favored Enemy: beasts. Advantage to track beasts with Survival and to recall information on them with Intelligence checks. Natural Explorer: coast.
actions: Trident. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., 1d6+3 piercing with the shield equipped.

Ranger spells, DC 11 and +3 spell attack, two 1st-level slots. Hunter’s mark adds 1d6 on weapon hits against the marked target while concentration holds. Cure wounds restores 1d8+1 HP to a creature Teral touches.
builds.tactics: Teral stays within swimming distance. When he neither casts nor moves hunter’s mark with his bonus action, he can use Skirmish Tactics to leave melee after a hit.

builds.title: Ogresh informal negotiator, Bard 2
builds.difficulty: Bard 2. Proficiency bonus +2. Social encounter and support.
traits: Dexterity save +4 and Charisma save +5. Leather armor. Advantage on saves against being charmed and Powerful Build for moving loads.
Gift of Gab grants Insight and Persuasion. Jack of All Trades adds +1 to ability checks without proficiency, including initiative.

A Friendly Ear, DC 13 Wisdom. After at least 1 minute of conversation with a nonhostile creature, a failed save charms it for 1 hour and reveals one fact it knows about the topic, chosen by the DM. Target unaware either way. Recharges on a short rest.

Bardic Inspiration. As a bonus action, give an ally who can hear Marel within 60 ft. a d6. Within 10 minutes it can add the die to one check, attack, or save after rolling but before the result. Three uses per long rest.
Song of Rest. Allies who hear Marel and spend one or more Hit Dice during the short rest regain an extra 1d6 HP.
actions: Rapier. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8+2 piercing.

Bard spells, DC 13 and +5 spell attack. Cantrips are minor illusion and vicious mockery. Vicious mockery targets a creature who can hear Marel within 60 ft. and deals 1d4 psychic and imposes disadvantage on the target’s next attack before the end of its next turn on a failed Wisdom save.
Three 1st-level slots. Known spells are comprehend languages, dissonant whispers, faerie fire, healing word, and hideous laughter.

Healing word restores 1d4+3 HP to a visible creature within 60 ft. as a bonus action. Faerie fire outlines creatures that fail a Dexterity save in a 20-ft. cube within 60 ft. Attackers who can see an outlined creature have advantage. Concentration up to 1 minute.
builds.tactics: Marel invites the visitor to sit and talk first. In a fight, Marel marks enemies with faerie fire and uses healing word to recover an ally who has fallen.

builds.title: Wechselkind infirmary runner, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Rogue 2. Proficiency bonus +2. Infiltration and evacuation.
builds.languages: Common and Sylvan from Wechselkind. Dwarvish from the 2014 Noble background.
traits: Dexterity save +4 and Intelligence save +3. Studded leather armor. Expertise in Acrobatics and Stealth.
Artificial Form. Humanoid. Advantage against being poisoned, poison resistance, disease immunity, and no need for food, drink, sleep, or air. Magical aging has no effect.
Childish Agility. Can move through the space of larger creatures. Cunning Action allows Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

Sneak Attack, once per turn. Add 1d6 when a finesse or ranged weapon attack hits with advantage, or when a non-incapacitated enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and Pip does not have disadvantage.
actions: Rapier. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8+2 piercing.
Shortbow. +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., 1d6+2 piercing.
Faerie Glamour, once per long rest. Cast disguise self (DC 12 to discern by inspection) to resemble the one child Pip was created to replace.
builds.tactics: Pip slips through the crowd to reach the blocked infirmary exit and uses Cunning Action to cover ground before the next patient arrives.

builds.title: Dusk Corvum appraiser, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2.
traits: Neutral. Leather armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Saving throws Dex +5 and Int +4.
Dusk Skulker gives advantage on Stealth in dim light or darkness. Expertise with Stealth and thieves’ tools. Elusive in a crowd.

Cunning Action lets Miren Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action. Appraising Eye examines one object as an action to learn its magical properties, how to activate them, and an estimated market price. Recharge after a short or long rest.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Talons. Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 piercing. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.
actions: Rapier +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, 1d8+3 piercing.
Shortbow +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., 1d6+3 piercing.
Talons +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, 1d4+3 piercing. Use Dexterity under the appendix’s NPC rules.
Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once on a turn when a finesse or ranged attack has advantage or an eligible ally is next to the target. Attacks with disadvantage cannot use the ally condition.
builds.tactics: Miren offers to inspect an object before naming a price. If the deal turns ugly, she uses cover and Cunning Action to withdraw through the stacks.

builds.title: Huden Gallus orchard keeper, Druid 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/4.
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Saving throws Int +2 and Wis +5.
Seedspeech exchanges simple ideas with living plants through speech and touch. Communal gives History +4 for local community and cultural history.
Spellcasting uses Wisdom. Spell save DC 13 and spell attack +5. Cantrips guidance and shillelagh. Two 1st-level slots, with animal friendship, entangle, goodberry, and healing word prepared.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Wing Flap. As a bonus action, rise up to half your movement speed. You can combine this with a jump, and use it only outside a glide.
actions: Quarterstaff +2 to hit, 5-ft. reach, 1d6 bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 two-handed.
Shillelagh (bonus action). For 1 minute, the staff is magical and attacks at +5 for 1d8+3 bludgeoning.
Entangle. Creatures in the 20-ft. square make a DC 13 Strength save or become restrained. A restrained creature can spend an action to try a DC 13 Strength check. Concentration up to 1 minute.
Healing word (bonus action). A creature within 60 ft. regains 1d4+3 HP.
builds.tactics: Edda asks the roots what was dragged across the orchard path. If a pursuer arrives, she uses entangle to cover the party’s retreat.

builds.title: Sera Luma songkeeper, Bard 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2.
traits: Chaotic good. Leather armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Saving throws Dex +4 and Cha +5. Jack of All Trades adds +1 to otherwise untrained ability checks, including initiative.
Fated rerolls one attack, ability check, or save after seeing the roll and before learning the outcome. Recharge after a long rest.

Spellcasting uses Charisma. Spell save DC 13 and spell attack +5. Cantrips mage hand and vicious mockery, plus light from Touched. Three 1st-level slots. Known spells are detect magic, dissonant whispers, healing word, heroism, and thunderwave.

Bardic Inspiration (bonus action, 3/long rest). An ally within 60 ft. who can hear Tavi gains a d6 for one check, attack, or save within 10 minutes. Song of Rest adds 1d6 healing for allies spending Hit Dice during a short rest.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Wing Flap. As a bonus action, rise up to half your movement speed. You can combine this with a jump, and use it only outside a glide.
actions: Dagger +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or range 20/60 ft., 1d4+2 piercing.
Songbird. While performing, cast charm person (Wisdom DC 13) without somatic components once per long rest.
Vicious mockery. One target within 60 ft. that can hear Tavi makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

Dissonant whispers. One creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On failure it takes 3d6 psychic damage and uses its reaction, if available, to move away. Success halves the damage and prevents that movement.
builds.tactics: Tavi uses a tune to settle a dispute at the shelter door. If someone threatens the guests, they force that creature back with dissonant whispers.

builds.title: Mistral Raptor canopy lookout, Ranger 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2.
traits: Neutral. Leather armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Saving throws Str +2 and Dex +5.
Archery adds +2 to ranged weapon attacks. Woodland Hunter treats half cover as no cover and three-quarters cover as half cover. The longbow does not count as heavy for Senn.
Aerial Defense imposes disadvantage on attacks against Senn while falling, gliding, or jumping. Favored Enemy beasts and Natural Explorer forest.
Spellcasting uses Wisdom. Spell save DC 12 and spell attack +4. Two 1st-level slots. Known spells are cure wounds and hunter’s mark.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Talons. Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 piercing. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.
actions: Longbow +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., 1d8+3 piercing.
Talons +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, 1d4+3 piercing. Use Dexterity under the appendix’s NPC rules.
Hunter’s mark (bonus action). Mark a visible creature within 90 ft. Weapon hits on it add 1d6 damage. Concentration up to 1 hour. Cure wounds heals a touched creature for 1d8+2 HP.
builds.tactics: Senn watches the trail through the canopy and warns strangers away from a broken bridge. In a fight, they look for angles through cover and glide to a lower branch when pressed.

builds.title: Stout Strig bridge keeper, Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1/2.
traits: Neutral good. Chain shirt and Defense fighting style. Proficiency bonus +2. Saving throws Str +5 and Con +5.
Patterned Feathers gives advantage on Stealth checks to hide in a forest. Imposing grants Intimidation proficiency.
Second Wind (bonus action) restores 1d10+2 HP. Action Surge provides one extra action on Orla’s turn. Both recharge after short or long rests.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Talons. Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 piercing. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.
actions: Light hammer +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach or range 20/60 ft., 1d4+3 bludgeoning.
Talons +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, 1d4+3 piercing. Use Strength under the appendix’s NPC rules.
Brawler (bonus action after a talon hit). With a free hand, grapple that target using Athletics +5 against its choice of Athletics or Acrobatics. The target can be at most one size larger.
builds.tactics: Orla lets evacuees pass first. She tries to restrain someone rushing the bridge so the people behind her have time to cross.

builds.title: Flood-route surveyor, Ranger 2, Grove
builds.difficulty: Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter.
traits: Studded leather; passive Perception 14. Proficiency +2. Strength save +3, Dexterity save +5. Archery fighting style.
Grove Cervan. Long jump 30 ft. and high jump 15 ft. with or without a running start, spending movement normally. Opportunity attacks against Bracken have disadvantage.
Surge of Vigor once per long rest. An attack dealing more than half current HP immediately triggers healing of 1d12+2, including a hit that drops Bracken to 0 HP.
Favored Enemy beasts and Natural Explorer forest. Speaks Birdfolk and spoken Cervan.
actions: Longbow +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., 1d8+3 piercing. Shortsword +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+3 piercing.

Spellcasting. Two 1st-level slots per long rest. Cure wounds restores 1d8+2 HP to a touched creature. Hunter’s mark requires concentration and adds 1d6 damage to weapon hits against the marked target.
builds.tactics: Bracken leaps across a gap to secure the line. She leaves melee through the clearest route and uses her bow from across the washout.

builds.title: Bridge barricade guard, Fighter 2, Pronghorn
builds.difficulty: Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter.
traits: Scale mail, shield, Defense fighting style. Proficiency +2. Strength and Constitution saves +5. Disadvantage on Stealth.
Pronghorn Cervan. Carry up to 480 lb. Push, drag, or lift up to 960 lb.
Surge of Vigor once per long rest. An attack dealing more than half current HP immediately triggers healing of 1d12+3, including a hit that drops Hollis to 0 HP.
actions: Longsword +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 slashing with shield equipped. Antlers +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+3 piercing.

Charge. After moving at least 20 ft. in a straight line toward the opponent, spend a bonus action for an extra 1d6 piercing on the gore. Large or smaller targets must make a DC 13 Strength save or be pushed 10 ft. away into a space Hollis chooses.
Action Surge grants one extra action. Second Wind restores 1d10+2 HP as a bonus action. Each recharges on a short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Hollis leaves a clear rush lane, starts behind the barricade, and uses the antlers to drive a foe away from the rigging crew.

builds.title: Burrow mediator, Bard 2
builds.difficulty: Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter.
builds.speed: 25 ft. walk, 15 ft. burrow through soil
traits: Quill AC 14 + Dexterity modifier. Dexterity save +4, Charisma save +5. Jack of All Trades gives +1 to initiative and other ability checks that do not already include proficiency.
Speak With Bugs conveys simple ideas to Beast insects, spiders, worms, and similar creatures. Song of Rest lets a friendly creature spending Hit Dice in a short rest regain an extra 1d6 HP.
actions: Rapier +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8+2 piercing. Bard spell save DC 13, spell attack +5, three 1st-level slots. Cantrips mage hand and vicious mockery. Known spells cure wounds, faerie fire, healing word, speak with animals, and thunderwave.

Bardic Inspiration. Three times per long rest, bonus action to grant a d6 to another creature within 60 ft. that can hear Rowan. Healing word restores 1d4+3 HP at range 60 ft. as a bonus action using a spell slot.
Forest Magic grants druidcraft and one 2nd-level casting of animal messenger per short or long rest.

Curl Up as an action. AC 19, no Dexterity bonus. Rowan cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components. Each creature missing him with a melee attack takes 2d4 piercing. A hit knocks him prone at the end of the turn. Rowan may uncurl on his turn.
builds.tactics: Rowan sends word before taking sides. If pinned down on soil, he burrows out of reach or curls up to hold the passage.

builds.title: Ropeway courier, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter.
traits: Leather armor, proficiency +2, passive Perception 13. Dexterity save +5, Intelligence save +2. Expertise in Stealth and thieves’ tools.
Standing Leap. Long jump 30 ft. or high jump 15 ft., with or without a running start, spending movement normally. Can move through a larger creature’s space.
Take Heart. Advantage on Strength saves and saves against being frightened with an ally within 5 ft. who is visible, audible, neither frightened nor incapacitated.
actions: Shortbow +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., 1d6+3 piercing. Dagger +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., 1d4+3 piercing.

Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once per turn on a qualifying finesse or ranged weapon hit. Use the bonus action for Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Help. For combat Help, Tansy must be within 5 ft. of the target when she aids the ally.
builds.tactics: Tansy jumps across, keeps an ally close when facing fear, and uses bonus-action Help to line up the ally’s next strike when in range.

builds.title: Pulley repairer, Life Cleric 2
builds.difficulty: Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter.
traits: Chain shirt and shield, proficiency +2, Wisdom save +5, Charisma save +2.
Resilience. Advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage. Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in dim light and darkness.

Scroungecraft produces a temporary tool or adventuring item up to 30 gp in 10 minutes with suitable materials. Temporary tools are single-use. Other items generally last an hour. A repair with suitable materials holds as long as the GM decides.
Disciple of Life adds 2 + spell level to HP restored by spells of 1st level or higher.
actions: Mace +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+1 bludgeoning. Sacred flame DC 13 Dexterity save or 1d8 radiant.

Cleric spell save DC 13, spell attack +5, three 1st-level slots. Cantrips guidance, mending, and sacred flame. Prepared spells detect poison and disease, guiding bolt, healing word, sanctuary, and shield of faith. Domain spells bless and cure wounds are also prepared.
At 1st level, cure wounds restores 1d8+6 HP and healing word restores 1d4+6 HP with Disciple of Life.

Channel Divinity once per short or long rest. Preserve Life can allocate 10 HP among creatures within 30 ft., limited to half each target’s max HP and excluding undead and constructs. Turn Undead forces undead within 30 ft. that can see or hear Kestrel to save against DC 13 Wisdom or be turned for 1 minute or until damaged.
builds.tactics: Kestrel climbs to the winch, improvises a tool when materials allow, and keeps healing word in reserve for anyone pinned below.

builds.title: Disputed-toll negotiator, Illusion Wizard 5
builds.difficulty: Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter.
traits: AC 15 with mage armor already cast, otherwise AC 12. Proficiency +3. Intelligence save +6, Wisdom save +3. Evasive gives Dexterity save +5 including Intelligence modifier.
Improved Minor Illusion allows both image and sound with one casting of minor illusion. Arcane Recovery can recover up to 3 combined spell-slot levels after one short rest per day.
actions: Bite +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+2 piercing. Fire bolt +6 to hit, range 120 ft., 2d10 fire.

Wizard spell save DC 14, spell attack +6. Slots 4/3/2 by spell level, with one 1st-level slot spent if mage armor is active. Cantrips fire bolt, mage hand, message, minor illusion, and prestidigitation.
Prepared spells. 1st level detect magic, mage armor, shield. 2nd level mirror image, misty step, web. 3rd level counterspell, hypnotic pattern.

Bewitching Guile supplies charm person, 2nd-level ambush prey, and fear independently once each per long rest at DC 14 where applicable. Ambush prey grants invisibility for up to 1 hour and ends if Lark moves at least 5 ft. from the casting point or makes the first attack against an unaware target, which adds 1d6 damage.
builds.tactics: Lark opens with negotiation. Under threat, she uses ambush prey only when she can hold position, or drops web between herself and her pursuers before using misty step on a later turn.

builds.title: Void Dragonborn gate guard, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 character build, PB +2.
traits: STR and CON saves +5 and +4. Scale mail gives AC 15 and disadvantage on Stealth checks. Void ancestry grants necrotic resistance.

Diaspora heritage with maul proficiency and History. Timeless Resolve gives Varesh and his allies within 5 ft. of him advantage on saves against becoming frightened. Soldier background grants Medicine and Survival. Combat Conditioning adds 2 HP and raises healing hit die results below 2 to 2.

Last Stand. Once this build’s single hit die is spent it cannot use this reaction again until it recovers a die. When incoming damage would bring Varesh below half his maximum HP (below 7 HP), he can spend the die and heal 1d10+2 HP, applying Combat Conditioning.

Martial Action Wind Up. Bonus action with the spear in both hands. Pick a visible target within 10 ft. and add 2 damage on the first melee weapon hit against it this turn. Breath Weapon uses the same bonus action.
actions: Spear +5, 5-ft. reach or range 20/60 ft. One-handed or thrown hit deals 1d6+3 piercing. Two-handed melee hit deals 1d8+3 piercing.
Void Breath, 2 uses per long rest. Bonus action, choose a 30-by-5-ft. line or a 15-ft. cone. Each creature makes a DC 12 DEX save, taking 1d10 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
builds.tactics: Varesh cases the short approach with keensense. He holds the gate with his spear and saves the breath for a group that has bunched beyond the threshold.

builds.languages: Common, Dwarvish, Machine Speech, Thieves’ Cant, Gnomish
builds.title: Gearforged lockwright, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 character build, PB +2.
traits: DEX and INT saves +5 and +3. Wears leather armor. Human-shaped Medium chassis. Disease immunity, poison damage resistance, and advantage on saves against paralysis, petrification, and poison.
Six hours dormant replace sleep. Disadvantage on Perception while dormant. No need for air, food, or drink.
Always Armed. Brasswell’s integrated shortsword retracts into the arm. It counts as held while drawn and is automatically concealed while folded away. Deliberate removal takes an action.

Stone heritage grants construction tool expertise and longsword proficiency. Eye for Quality adds PB when examining stone or metal objects or structures for origin or purpose, or doubles PB already granted by a relevant proficiency.

Criminal background with Investigation and Deception. Touch of Luck grants 2 Luck instead of 1 when gaining Luck for a failed attack or save, and resets 5 Luck to 1d4+1 when the next point would be gained. Rogue expertise applies to Stealth and thieves’ tools.
actions: Integrated shortsword +5, reach 5 ft., 1d6+3 piercing. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once on Brasswell’s turn with advantage, or if another enemy of the target is within 5 ft., that enemy can act, and Brasswell lacks disadvantage.
builds.tactics: Brasswell closes the service hatch before confronting the intruders. A routine search leaves the retracted blade undiscovered.

builds.title: Satyr ambush courier, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 character build, PB +2.
traits: STR and CON saves +5 and +4. Wears leather armor. Fey Resilience gives advantage on saves against magic and on checks and saves to avoid or end charm and unconsciousness.

Cottage heritage with Animal Handling. At the end of a long rest, Comforts of Home can give four temporary HP to as many as two participants. Soldier background grants Athletics and Survival, and Combat Conditioning grants 2 maximum HP.

Last Stand. If incoming damage would bring Tam below half his maximum HP (below 7 HP), he can spend his one hit die as a reaction and heal 1d10+2 HP, with a minimum roll of 2 from Combat Conditioning. This competes with Bounding Leap for the reaction.
Martial Action Aim. Use a bonus action to pick a creature Tam can see. The first ranged weapon attack against that target this turn adds PB again.
actions: Horn strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 bludgeoning, using STR. Shortsword +5, reach 5 ft., 1d6+3 piercing, using STR. Sling +4, range 30/120 ft., 1d4+2 bludgeoning, or +6 to hit after Aim.
Bounding Leap, 2 uses per long rest. After a melee weapon or unarmed hit, use the reaction to move up to 15 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks.
builds.tactics: Tam runs his message around the blockade. If boxed in, he catches one opponent with a horn strike and uses Bounding Leap to slip out of reach.

builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., magical darkness vision 30 ft.
builds.languages: Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, Elvish, Sylvan, Gnomish, Orcish, Primordial, Halfling
builds.title: Spellborn Syderean compartment guide, Wizard 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 character build, PB +2.
traits: INT and WIS saves +5 and +3. AC 15 with Mage Armor, AC 20 with Mage Armor and Shield. Necrotic resistance. Doubled survival time without air, food, water, or sleep.

Cosmopolitan heritage grants History and Street Smarts. In a city, Mira has advantage on checks to avoid getting lost or to find public destinations and cannot be surprised while conscious and able to act. Scholar background grants Arcana and Religion. Scholar and Polyglot provide extra languages.

INT spellcasting at +5 to hit, save DC 13. Two 1st-circle slots per long rest. Once daily after a short rest Arcane Recovery restores one spent slot. Prepared spells are Mage Armor, Shield, Magic Missile, and Longstrider. The spellbook also holds Burning Hands and Grease. Cantrips are Fire Bolt, Light, and Mage Hand. Detect Magic is the known ritual.
actions: Fire Bolt +5 ranged spell attack at 120 ft., 1d10 fire on hit. Quarterstaff +1, reach 5 ft., 1d6−1 bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8−1 two-handed.

Magic Missile creates three darts, 1d4+1 force each, distributed among visible creatures within 120 ft. Mage Armor gives AC 15 for eight hours. Shield reacts to a hit or Magic Missile, adds 5 AC until next turn, and negates Magic Missile damage.

Energy Form, once per long rest. Bonus action, last up to one minute. Mira usually picks lightning. Her form resists physical damage from nonmagical attacks, is immune to restrained, and can convert one attack or spell’s damage to lightning on each of her turns.
builds.tactics: Mira reads the corridor from the darkness and enters Energy Form when a crowd tries to pin her down. She converts a Fire Bolt if her opponent expects fire.

builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft. in full color. Advantage on visual Perception to locate creatures and moving targets.
builds.title: Toadfolk Sapopova ferry lookout, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 character build, PB +2.
traits: DEX and INT saves +5 and +2. Wears leather armor. Tavi can breathe in air and water. Toadfolk cheeks hold up to three Tiny objects while allowing normal speech.

Wildlands heritage with Animal Handling. Beasts or Animal-tagged creatures of CR 2 or lower must first contest their WIS check against Tavi’s Animal Handling to attack Tavi. On Tavi’s win they choose another target or lose their attack.

Criminal background grants Investigation and Deception. Touch of Luck grants 2 instead of 1 Luck when gaining Luck for a missed attack or failed save, and replaces the sixth point gained with a reset to 1d4+1. Rogue expertise applies to Perception and Stealth.
actions: Launch Tiny object +5 at 20/60 ft., 1d6+3 damage. The object determines bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. Tavi carries three smooth clay pellets for bludgeoning damage.
Shortbow +5 at 80/320 ft., 1d6+3 piercing. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once on Tavi’s turn with advantage, or if an active enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and Tavi lacks disadvantage.
builds.tactics: Tavi checks both sides of the ferry in darkness and drops under the waterline if threatened. The pellets are a fallback when there is no time to draw a bow.

builds.title: Daelkyr Half-Blood seam scout, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3 with throwing scarab attached. ECL 2 (2 class HD, LA +0).
traits: Lawful evil. Studded leather +3, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13, armor check penalty −1. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +1.
Trapfinding and evasion in light armor. Tumble synergy is included in Balance.

Throwing scarab starts attached. AC 21, touch 21, flat-footed 18, 4 HP when targeted directly. It can be attacked in place of the host if visible, provoking from the host. While attached it makes no attacks of its own.
Scarab attachment or removal deals 1d3 Wisdom damage. The listed Wisdom assumes recovery from an earlier attachment. Deep-blue carapace, telepathy with the host, Ego 2.
Symbiont Mastery is a racial bonus feat. Gain +4 on Will saves in symbiont personality conflicts and +2 HP per attached symbiont. The extra HP vanish immediately when it detaches.
Symbiont Dependence (Ex). Take 1 Constitution damage after each 24 hours without contact with any symbiont. That damage cannot be restored until contact resumes.
Unbalanced Mind (Ex). A creature trying to read or study the half-blood’s mind must make a Will save at DC 10 + half the half-blood’s level + their Charisma modifier or be dazed for 1 round.
Unbalanced Mind Will DC 12. Will +5 if the scarab enters a personality conflict against its Ego DC 2.
actions: Rapier +2 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 18–20/×2.

Throwing scarab shard +4 ranged, 1d6 slashing and 1d6 acid, 20-ft. range increment. Critical 19–20/×2 on the slashing damage. Point Blank Shot adds +1 to attack and damage within 30 ft., before range penalties.

Grasp one available shard as a free action and throw it as a normal ranged attack. A new shard becomes available at the beginning of Lysa’s next action, one shot per round. The shard counts as magic for damage reduction and dissolves within a round of removal.
Sneak attack adds 1d6 if the target is denied Dexterity to AC, or when flanking in melee. Ranged sneak attack requires a target within 30 ft.
builds.tactics: Lysa tries to get the map case past the party first. If the route closes, she uses the scarab shard from cover and moves before the next shot.

builds.title: Daelkyr Half-Blood hatch guard, Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3 with crawling gauntlet attached. ECL 2 (2 class HD, LA +0).
traits: Lawful evil. Chain shirt +4, heavy steel shield +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16, armor check penalty −4. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +1.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus adds +1 to the claw. Power Attack can trade up to 2 attack for the same damage bonus on the claw.
Crawling gauntlet starts attached. AC 14, touch 13, flat-footed 13, 4 HP when targeted directly. Attacking the visible gauntlet in place of Deren provokes from Deren.

Attaching or removing the gauntlet deals 1d3 Constitution damage. The listed Constitution assumes recovery from an earlier attachment. The gauntlet communicates telepathically with its host and has Ego 3.
Symbiont Mastery is a racial bonus feat. Gain +4 on Will saves in symbiont personality conflicts and +2 HP per attached symbiont. The extra HP vanish immediately when it detaches.
Symbiont Dependence (Ex). Take 1 Constitution damage after each 24 hours without contact with any symbiont. That damage cannot be restored until contact resumes.
Unbalanced Mind (Ex). A creature trying to read or study the half-blood’s mind must make a Will save at DC 10 + half the half-blood’s level + their Charisma modifier or be dazed for 1 round.
Unbalanced Mind Will DC 10. Will +5 if the gauntlet enters a personality conflict against its Ego DC 3.
actions: Gauntlet claw +6 melee, 1d4+4 piercing and slashing, critical ×2. It is Deren’s sole natural weapon and adds one and a half times his Strength bonus. The shield is on his other arm.
With full Power Attack, claw +4 melee, 1d4+6. The attached gauntlet grants the claw to Deren, who uses his own attack and damage modifiers.
builds.tactics: Deren checks who has clearance while holding the hatch behind his shield. He offers to let the party pass if they can identify the person who sent them.

builds.title: Drow passage scout, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: 4e level 1, built as a player character.
traits: Unaligned. Leather, short sword, and light shield. Shield Proficiency (Light) adds the shield’s +1 to AC and Reflex. Fortitude 11, Reflex 17, Will 13. Bloodied 11. Six healing surges at 5 HP.
