Artful Dodger raises AC to 20 against opportunity attacks. First Strike grants combat advantage against enemies that have yet to act in the first round. Sneak Attack adds 2d6 to an eligible short-sword hit when Sera has combat advantage, once per turn.
Trance grants an extended rest in 4 hours while Sera stays alert. Darkfire uses Charisma. Sera may use either Lolthtouched power once per encounter.
actions: Short sword basic attack, at-will standard. Melee 1, +4 vs. AC for 1d6+1.
Deft Strike, at-will standard. May move 2 squares before a melee 1 attack at +7 vs. AC for 1d6+4.
Piercing Strike, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4.
Positioning Strike, encounter standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. Will for 1d6+4 and slide the target up to 3 squares.
Trick Strike, daily standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC. On a hit, deal 3d6+4 and slide the target 1 square. For the rest of the encounter, slide that target 1 square whenever Sera hits it.

Cloud of Darkness, Lolthtouched encounter minor, close burst 1. Stays in place through the end of Sera’s next turn. Blocks line of sight for other creatures and blinds them if they are entirely inside.

Darkfire, Lolthtouched encounter minor, ranged 10. +5 vs. Reflex. On a hit, the target grants combat advantage to attackers and gains no benefit from invisibility or concealment until the end of Sera’s next turn.
Second wind, encounter standard. Spend a healing surge and gain +2 to defenses until the start of Sera’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Screens the passage with Cloud of Darkness while people move behind it. Shifts a blocker out of the crossing with Positioning Strike.

builds.title: Bugbear ferry lookout, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: 4e level 1, built as a player character.
traits: Unaligned. Leather, Medium mace in one hand. One-Handed Fighter Weapon Talent adds +1 to weapon attacks. Improved Initiative adds +4. Fortitude 16, Reflex 13, Will 11. Bloodied 14. Ten healing surges at 7 HP.

Oversized permits a weapon one size larger. Combat Challenge may mark each enemy Rusk attacks through the end of his next turn. The mark gives −2 to attacks that omit him. If a marked adjacent enemy shifts or makes an attack that omits Rusk, he can make a melee basic attack as an immediate interrupt.
Combat Superiority adds +1 to opportunity attack rolls. A hit stops movement that provoked it.
actions: Mace basic attack, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. Opportunity attack +8 vs. AC.
Cleave, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. On a hit one other enemy adjacent to Rusk takes 4 damage.
Reaping Strike, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. On a miss, deal 2 damage.
Spinning Sweep, encounter standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4 and knock the target prone.
Comeback Strike, daily standard, reliable. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 2d8+4 and Rusk can spend a healing surge on a hit.
Predatory Eye, encounter minor, personal. Adds 1d6 damage to the next attack against a target granting Rusk combat advantage. Use it by the end of Rusk’s next turn.
Second wind, encounter standard. Spend a healing surge and gain +2 to defenses until the start of Rusk’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Waits out of sight beside the winch until an ally can flank. Uses Predatory Eye before Spinning Sweep when the opening appears.

builds.title: Hobgoblin shield officer, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: 4e level 1, built as a player character.
traits: Unaligned. Scale, heavy shield, and longsword. The shield gives −2 to Strength-, Constitution-, and Dexterity-based skill checks. Fortitude 15, Reflex 13, Will 11. Bloodied 15. Twelve healing surges at 7 HP.
One-Handed Fighter Weapon Talent adds +1 to weapon attacks. Weapon Focus (heavy blade) adds +1 to damage rolls. Battle Ready adds +2 to initiative.

Combat Challenge may mark each enemy Varek attacks through the end of his next turn. The mark gives −2 to attacks that omit him. If a marked adjacent enemy shifts or makes an attack that omits Varek, he can make a melee basic attack as an immediate interrupt.
Combat Superiority adds +1 to opportunity attack rolls. A hit stops movement that provoked it.
actions: Longsword basic attack, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. Opportunity attack +8 vs. AC.
Cleave, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. On a hit one other enemy adjacent to Varek takes 3 damage.
Tide of Iron, at-will standard using a shield. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. Push a target of Large size or smaller 1 square on a hit, then optionally shift into the square it left.
Covering Attack, encounter standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 2d8+4. One ally adjacent to the target can shift 2 squares on a hit.

Villain’s Menace, daily standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 2d8+4. A hit also grants +2 to attack and +4 to damage rolls against the target for the encounter. A miss grants +1 to attack and +2 to damage rolls against it for the encounter.
Hobgoblin Resilience, encounter immediate reaction, personal. When Varek suffers an effect that a saving throw can end, he makes that save immediately.
Second wind, encounter standard. Spend a healing surge and gain +2 to defenses until the start of Varek’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Uses Tide of Iron to take the bridgehead back and Covering Attack to give a worker room to escape. Saves Resilience for an effect threatening his ability to hold the crossing.

builds.title: Gnome decoy guide, Wizard 1
builds.difficulty: 4e level 1, built as a player character.
traits: Unaligned. Cloth, wand, dagger, and a walking stick. Fortitude 12, Reflex 14, Will 13. Bloodied 12. Eight healing surges at 6 HP. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Wand of Accuracy, encounter free action. While wielding the wand, add +1 to one attack roll.

Check Stealth on the initiative roll when in cover or concealment. Gain +5 to saving throws against illusions. Tovin also knows Light, Mage Hand, and Prestidigitation. His spellbook has Comprehend Language, Make Whole, and Tenser’s Floating Disk, plus Flaming Sphere as his alternate daily spell.
actions: Dagger basic attack, at-will standard. Melee 1 at +3 vs. AC for 1d4 or ranged 5/10 at +4 vs. AC for 1d4+1.
Ray of Frost, at-will standard. Ranged 10, +4 vs. Fortitude for 1d6+4 cold and slowed through the end of Tovin’s next turn.
Thunderwave, at-will standard. Close blast 3 against creatures, +4 vs. Fortitude for 1d6+4 thunder and push 1 square.

Icy Terrain, encounter standard. Area burst 1 within 10 against creatures, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4 cold and knock prone. The ground in the burst is difficult terrain through the end of Tovin’s next turn or until he ends it as a minor action.

Sleep, prepared daily standard. Area burst 2 within 20 against creatures, +4 vs. Will. Slowed (save ends) on a hit or miss. A creature hit that fails its first save instead becomes unconscious (save ends).
Ghost Sound, at-will standard or, through Master Trickster, encounter minor. Ranged 10. Make an illusory sound of up to the volume of a shouting creature at an object or unoccupied square.
Fade Away, encounter immediate reaction after taking damage. Tovin becomes invisible until he attacks or his next turn ends.
Second wind, encounter standard. Spend a healing surge and gain +2 to defenses until the start of Tovin’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Places Ghost Sound away from the crew to draw attention, then blocks pursuit with Icy Terrain. Uses Fade Away after a hit to take cover without giving away the way out.

builds.title: Shade lantern-room infiltrator, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 skirmisher, 100 XP.
traits: Unaligned. Leather armor. Fortitude 11, Reflex 17, Will 14. Bloodied 9. No healing surges after Fragile Mortality.

First Strike grants combat advantage against enemies that have yet to act at the start of an encounter. Once per round, Sneak Attack adds 2d6 to a qualifying dagger hit against a target granting combat advantage. Rogue Weapon Talent adds +1 to dagger attacks.
actions: Dagger basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +5 vs. AC for 1d4+1, or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
Sly Flourish (at-will, standard). Dagger melee 1 or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 1d4+8.
Dazing Strike (encounter, standard). Dagger melee 1, +9 vs. AC for 1d4+5. On a hit, daze until the end of Marren’s next turn.

Easy Target (daily, standard). Dagger melee 1 or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 2d4+5. On a hit, the target is slowed and grants Marren combat advantage (save ends both). On a miss, half damage and it grants Marren combat advantage through the end of Marren’s next turn.
One with Shadow (at-will, standard). Through the end of Marren’s next turn, he can attempt to hide with any cover or concealment and can use cover from allies to hide or remain hidden.
builds.tactics: Marren asks an ally to stand between him and the guard while he reaches the shutter. If cornered, he dazes the nearest guard and heads for the stairs.

builds.title: Vryloka gallery escort, Warlord 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 soldier (leader), 100 XP.
traits: Unaligned. Leather armor. Fortitude 16, Reflex 12, Will 15. Bloodied 10. One healing surge worth 5 HP, or 3 while bloodied.
Orla counts as living and undead and chooses the result if a power treats the two differently. Resist 5 necrotic.
Combat Leader adds +2 to Orla’s initiative and grants a +2 power bonus to initiative to allies within 10 squares who can see and hear her.
actions: Longsword basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5.
Wolf Pack Tactics (at-will, standard). Before attacking, let one ally adjacent to Orla or her target shift 1 square. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5.

Guarding Attack (encounter, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 2d8+5. On a hit, one ally adjacent to Orla or the target gains +2 power bonus to AC against that target through the end of Orla’s next turn.

Bastion of Defense (daily, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 3d8+5. On a hit, allies within 5 squares gain a +1 power bonus to defenses through the encounter. Hit or miss, allies within 5 squares gain 8 temporary HP.
Inspiring Word (encounter, minor, twice per encounter and once per round). Orla or one ally in close burst 5 can spend a healing surge to regain its value plus 1d6 HP.
Lifeblood (encounter, free) triggers when Orla bloodies or kills an enemy. Choose a shift up to 7 squares, 5 temporary HP, or a +2 power bonus to attacks through the end of Orla’s next turn.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend one surge to heal 5 HP, or 3 if bloodied, and gain +2 to all defenses until the start of Orla’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Orla makes space for the witness with Wolf Pack Tactics. If a wound triggers Lifeblood, she shifts to the witness’s side or takes temporary HP if she is already in place.

builds.title: Revenant last-stand courier, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 soldier, 100 XP.
traits: Unaligned. Hide armor and a light shield. Fortitude 16, Reflex 14, Will 12. Bloodied 12. One healing surge worth 6 HP.

Iser counts as living and undead. Past Life is human for prerequisites. Use death saves for Iser. If dying at 0 HP or lower, Iser can stay dazed instead of falling unconscious. A failed death save makes Iser unconscious.

Combat Challenge marks each target Iser attacks through the end of Iser’s next turn, hit or miss. The marked target takes −2 to attacks that omit Iser. When a target Iser marked shifts or makes an attack that omits Iser while adjacent to Iser, Iser can make a melee basic attack against it as an immediate interrupt.
actions: Longsword basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4.
Tide of Iron (at-will, standard). Longsword and shield, melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. On a hit, Iser can push a Large or smaller target 1 square and shift into its former space.
Steel Serpent Strike (encounter, standard). Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 2d8+4. On a hit, slow the target and prevent it from shifting through the end of Iser’s next turn.
Comeback Strike (daily, standard, reliable). Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 2d8+4. On a hit, Iser can spend a healing surge.
Dark Reaping (encounter, free) triggers when a creature within 5 squares drops to 0 HP. One creature Iser hits through the end of Iser’s next turn takes an additional 1d8+3 necrotic damage.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend one surge to heal 6 HP and gain +2 to all defenses until the start of Iser’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Iser blocks the doorway long enough for another courier to take the dispatch. Dark Reaping goes on a hit against whoever tries to follow.

builds.title: Hamadryad grove negotiator, Wizard 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 artillery, 100 XP.
skills: Endurance +1 (+6 against starvation, thirst, or suffocation)
traits: Unaligned. Cloth armor and a quarterstaff. AC includes +1 for wielding the staff. Fortitude 12, Reflex 15, Will 16. Bloodied 9. One healing surge worth 4 HP.

Tavia ignores forest-growth difficult terrain. Tree Mind adds +2 on saves against daze, domination, or stun. She can wait twice as long before making Endurance checks against starvation, thirst, or suffocation. Four hours of conscious meditation with water, light, or earth give an extended rest.
Ritual Caster. Her book contains Comprehend Language, Make Whole and Tenser’s Floating Disk. Sleep is prepared. Freezing Cloud is her other spellbook daily.
actions: Quarterstaff basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +3 vs. AC for 1d8+1.
Ray of Frost (at-will, standard). Range 10, +5 vs. Fortitude for 1d6+5 cold. On a hit, slow the target through the end of Tavia’s next turn.

Icy Terrain (encounter, standard). Area burst 1 within 10, +5 vs. Reflex against each creature for 1d6+5 cold and prone on a hit. The area is difficult terrain until the end of Tavia’s next turn, or until she ends it with a minor action.

Sleep (daily, standard). Area burst 2 within 20, +5 vs. Will against each creature. A hit slows the target (save ends). If its first save fails, it becomes unconscious (save ends). A miss slows the target (save ends).
Staff of Defense (encounter, immediate interrupt). While wielding the staff, gain +1 to the targeted defense against one attack.
Hamadryad Aspects (encounter, minor). Until the end of Tavia’s next turn either enemies who see her grant her combat advantage or she gains resist 5 to all damage.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend one surge to heal 4 HP and gain +2 to all defenses until the start of Tavia’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Tavia offers a way through on foot. If the parley breaks, she uses Icy Terrain to slow pursuers and takes Wooden Form if they get close.

builds.title: Shadar-kai passage scout, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 skirmisher, 100 XP.
traits: Unaligned. Leather armor. Fortitude 12, Reflex 17, Will 12. Bloodied 9. One healing surge worth 4 HP. Winterkin adds +2 on death saves and saves against unconsciousness.

First Strike grants combat advantage against enemies that have yet to act at the start of an encounter. Once per round, Sneak Attack adds 2d6 to a qualifying dagger hit against a target granting combat advantage. Rogue Weapon Talent adds +1 to dagger attacks.
actions: Dagger basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +5 vs. AC for 1d4+1, or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
Deft Strike (at-will, standard). Before the attack, Nesha can move 2 squares. Dagger melee 1 or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
Positioning Strike (encounter, standard). Dagger melee 1, +9 vs. Will for 1d4+5. On a hit, slide the target 1 square.

Easy Target (daily, standard). Dagger melee 1 or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 2d4+5. On a hit, the target is slowed and grants Nesha combat advantage (save ends both). On a miss, half damage and it grants Nesha combat advantage through the end of Nesha’s next turn.
Shadow Jaunt (encounter, move). Teleport 3 squares, then remain insubstantial until the start of Nesha’s next turn.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend one surge to heal 4 HP and gain +2 to all defenses until the start of Nesha’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Nesha jaunts past the jammed gate if she can see a clear square. If anyone follows her, she slides the first foe away from the release lever.

builds.title: Cayma culvert scout, Thief 1 (Scout)
builds.difficulty: Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.
traits: Neutral good. HP 4 on 1d6. Wears cloth, with a −3 Dexterity adjustment from AC 10.

Unarmored thief scores are Pick Pockets 15%, Open Locks 30%, Find/Remove Traps 10%, Move Silently 60%, Hide in Shadows 50%, Detect Noise 25%, Climb Walls 70% and Read Languages 0%. In wilderness add 10 points each to Move Silently and Hide in Shadows. In towns subtract 5 points from all thief skills. Opponents take −1 to surprise rolls.
Saving throws are 13 paralysis/poison/death magic, 14 rod/staff/wand, 12 petrification/polymorph, 16 breath weapon and 15 spell.
actions: Sling with stone, effective THAC0 18 at short range and 1d4 damage. Range bands 40/80/160 yards outdoors or feet indoors. Apply −2 attack at medium range and −5 at long range.
Dagger, melee THAC0 20, 1d4 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d3 vs. Large targets. Backstab from behind against an unaware target with discernible anatomy, +4 to hit and double weapon damage.
builds.tactics: Tess scouts ahead through the culvert and uses the sling only when a noise will draw the watch away from the exit.

builds.title: Ee’aar ridge messenger, Fighter 1 (Wilderness Warrior)
builds.difficulty: Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.
builds.senses: Infravision 60 ft. Resolves daytime detail over a mile away.
traits: Neutral good. HP 8 on 1d10. No armor or shield and −3 Dexterity to AC. Wings are AC 6 and use the species profile’s hit rules.

At 90 lb., flight is class B through 45 lb. of carried gear and C through 90 lb. Make a Constitution check each hour, target 13 before the profile’s load, wind and altitude adjustments. At 4 HP remaining, glide only. At 2 HP remaining, lose gliding.
Resists sleep and charm spells 30% of the time. Her wings and daily Wisdom checks for confinement follow the player profile.
Saving throws are 14 paralysis/poison/death magic, 16 rod/staff/wand, 15 petrification/polymorph, 17 breath weapon and 17 spell.
actions: Shortsword, effective THAC0 19 from the species bonus. Deals 1d6 vs. Small or Medium targets and 1d8 vs. Large targets.
Signal with chest light. Turn the light on, off or pulse it at will. Use a rehearsed pulse to identify the next safe landing.
builds.tactics: Ilyra lands in the open to relay the dispatch and blinks a warning before flying on.

builds.title: Enduk short-haul escort, Fighter 1 (Defender)
builds.difficulty: Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.
builds.senses: Distinguishes daytime detail up to half a mile away.
traits: Lawful good Defender of Idu. HP 8 on 1d10 + 2 Constitution. Height 6 ft. 8 in. and weight 243 lb. Leather improves natural AC 6 to AC 5. Proficient with the footman’s mace.

Can fly in class C with up to 243 lb. of load or D up to 486 lb. Apply the campaign’s normal encumbrance rules as well. Check Constitution 16 each turn after the third. At 5 HP remaining only gliding is possible. At 2 HP remaining both flight and gliding are lost. Apply the sourcebook’s wing-fire rule.
Recognized by Idu’s order. Reaction rolls are 3 better with its faithful and 3 worse with those hostile to the faith. Displays Idu’s symbol, obeys senior clergy and tithes one tenth.
Saving throws are 14 paralysis/poison/death magic, 16 rod/staff/wand, 15 petrification/polymorph, 17 breath weapon and 17 spell.
actions: Footman’s mace, effective THAC0 19, 1d6+2 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d6+1 vs. Large targets.
Horns, effective THAC0 19, 1d4+2 including Strength.
Detect evil intent. Concentrate for one round to detect evil intent up to 60 feet in the chosen direction, per the Defender kit and the core paladin procedure.
builds.tactics: Sarruk carries supplies across the gap, lands before the fourth turn and holds the ledge until the rest of the party crosses.

builds.title: Gurrash channel guard, Fighter 1 (Savage Warrior)
builds.difficulty: Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.
builds.senses: Normal vision. Once-daily alarm within 10 ft.
traits: Neutral. HP 8 on 1d10 + 3 Constitution. Carries two stone-tipped spears. The harness leaves natural AC 5 intact. The Savage Warrior penalties apply to unfamiliar clothing and armor.

If frustrated, confused or hit for at least 8 damage at once, make a Wisdom check at −2, target 10. Failure grants +1 attack, +3 damage and +5 temporary HP and prevents using a shield or checking morale. It lasts up to five rounds. Magic can end either form. Removing the frustration can end a frustration rage. Killing the attacker can end rage from a wound.
Saving throws are 14 paralysis/poison/death magic, 16 rod/staff/wand, 15 petrification/polymorph, 17 breath weapon and 17 spell.
actions: Stone-tipped spear, effective THAC0 21 in melee, 1d6 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d8 vs. Large targets. Rage changes those numbers to THAC0 20 and 1d6+3 or 1d8+3. On each hit, the tip breaks on a separate roll of 1 on 1d20.

Throw stone-tipped spear, effective THAC0 20 at short range and 1d6 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d8 vs. Large targets. Range bands are 10/20/30 yards outdoors or feet indoors, with −2 and −5 attack past short range. In rage, use THAC0 19 at short range and 1d6+3 or 1d8+3. Check for a broken tip on a hit.

Intrusion alarm once per day. Automatically detects a creature at least the size of a rat within 10 feet, including an invisible or incorporeal intruder, with astral and ethereal creatures excepted. The alarm can wake Vorr. To activate it while awake, concentrate without interruption for a round.
builds.tactics: Vorr posts at the shallow crossing and braces against the first creature to charge through the reeds.

builds.title: Um-Shedu threshold guard, Fighter 1 (Defender)
builds.difficulty: Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.
builds.senses: Infravision 60 ft. Range taken from the setting’s companion appendix.
traits: Lawful good Defender of Idu. HP 8 on 1d10 + 2 Constitution. Wears a cloth sash, with natural AC 7. Effective Charisma is 9 with other humanoids and 6 with demihumans or humans.
The Um-Shedu profile is free of the sunlight curse. Immune to manscorpion venom and +2 on saves against all other poison, giving a poison save of 12.
Recognized by Idu’s order. Reaction rolls are 3 better with the faithful and 3 worse with those hostile to the faith. Displays Idu’s symbol, obeys senior clergy and tithes one tenth.
Saving throws are 14 paralysis/poison/death magic, 16 rod/staff/wand, 15 petrification/polymorph, 17 breath weapon and 17 spell.
actions: Spear, effective THAC0 20 in melee, 1d6+1 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d8+1 vs. Large targets.

Tail sting, effective THAC0 20, reach 10 ft. and 1d4+1 piercing damage as an encounter ruling. Choose this or the spear for the round. A failed unmodified save vs. poison causes one woozy round followed by 2d8 rounds of sleep. Neutralize poison ends the sleep early.
Detect evil intent. Concentrate for one round to detect evil intent up to 60 feet in the chosen direction.
builds.tactics: Tamar keeps enough space behind the gate to raise the tail, then leaves the spears lowered if the intruder surrenders.

builds.title: Phanaton canopy lookout, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: 1st-level character, descending Armor Class.
builds.speed: 9. Glide 50 feet each round, subject to starting height and load.
skills: Mountaineering and Rope Use as learned proficiencies.
traits: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Chaotic good. AC 4 from natural AC 9, the racial 2-point bonus, and Dexterity improving AC by 3. No armor or shield.
After the racial bonus, saves are 12/14/13/15/15 for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell.
Charisma is 11 or 10 with the peoples affected by his racial penalty and 3 with araneas.
Raised beyond the Red Curse and encountered there, with no initial Legacy.
actions: Wooden club, THAC0 20. One melee attack for 1d6 bludgeoning against small or medium targets or 1d3 against large targets. Speed factor 4.
Glide up to three times the starting height at 50 feet per round. Subtract 20 feet of range per 100 coin-weight carried. Makurí cannot attack while gliding.
builds.tactics: Makurí leads from above. He lands to fight and uses his staff as a club if someone reaches the lookout.

builds.title: Shazak waterline scout, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: 1st-level character, descending Armor Class.
builds.speed: 9 on land. Use Swimming proficiency in water.
skills: Swimming as a bonus proficiency. Fishing and Direction Sense as learned proficiencies.
traits: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Neutral good. Natural AC 5 from scales. No armor or shield. Strength 16 adds 1 damage and gives no attack bonus.
Saves, in order for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell, are 14/16/15/17/17.
Raised beyond the Red Curse and encountered there, with no initial Legacy.
actions: Steel-tipped spear, THAC0 20. One melee attack for 1d6+1 piercing against small or medium targets or 1d8+1 against large targets. Speed factor 6.
builds.tactics: Zesk waits in the shallows, then retreats with the ferry crew if the water rises.

builds.title: Wallara outback guide, Fighter 1 with the Wilderness Warrior kit
builds.difficulty: 1st-level character, descending Armor Class.
skills: Tracking 11 before terrain adjustments. Ancient History and Local History as racial bonus proficiencies.
Outback Survival 18 and Endurance from the Wilderness Warrior kit. A roll of 20 still fails Survival.
Club as a tribal weapon proficiency.
traits: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Neutral good. Natural AC 9 improved by 2 from Dexterity. Unarmored to preserve vanish.
Saves, in order for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell, are 14/16/15/17/17.
Charisma 10 with most other humanoids and 9 with humans and demihumans. Always finds the way back when within 10 miles of home or camp.
At 1st level, Werrami can vanish. Blending becomes available at 3rd level. His home in Wallara grants no initial Legacy.
actions: Wooden club, THAC0 20. One melee attack for 1d6 bludgeoning against small or medium targets or 1d3 against large targets. Speed factor 4.
Vanish as his full action on an Intelligence check of 13 or less on d20. Jump up to 120 feet without materializing in a solid object. He may try each round.
builds.tactics: When cornered, Werrami vanishes behind cover. He returns once he can approach unseen.

builds.title: Lupin scent-led courier, Ranger 1
builds.difficulty: 1st-level character, descending Armor Class.
builds.senses: Infravision 60 feet, keen hearing and smell.
skills: Tracking 20 before situational modifiers (Wisdom 14 + 6). Detect Noise 35%. Bonus Blind-fighting.
Short sword as a weapon proficiency.
traits: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Neutral good. Coat is ordinary clothing. Base AC 10 improved by 1 from Dexterity.
Saves, in order for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell, are 14/16/15/17/17.
Lightly equipped ranger. Hide in Shadows 10% and Move Silently 15% in natural surroundings. Halve these chances in unfamiliar enclosed or urban conditions.

Against his chosen species enemy, gnolls, attack at +4 and take −4 on reactions. Célan can befriend a calm animal. A wild or attack-trained animal must fail a save against rods at −1 for him to shift its reaction by one category.
Recognizes werewolves in any form 99% of the time or another lupin in an unusual form 15% of the time. An invisible or ethereal creature within 10 feet triggers a +4 detection save each round.

Recognizes familiar peoples by scent and makes an Intelligence check to identify a known individual by scent. Strong odors impose −1 to −4. Take −2 on saving throws against sound or odor. Swallowed wolfsbane kills on a failed poison save or costs 20 HP on a success. Injected wolfsbane halves ability scores for 1d3 days on a failed poison save.
Raised beyond the Red Curse and encountered there, with no initial Legacy.
actions: Short sword, THAC0 20. One melee attack for 1d6 piercing against small or medium targets or 1d8 against large targets. Speed factor 3.
builds.tactics: Célan tracks from the edge of the road, relays the route quietly, and draws his sword only if the trail leads into a fight.

builds.title: Rakasta skirmisher, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: 1st-level character, descending Armor Class.
skills: Front claws as a natural weapon proficiency, which also covers war claws.
traits: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Chaotic good. Unarmored. Base AC 10 improved by 3 from Dexterity.
Saves, in order for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell, are 14/16/15/17/17.
Half falling damage. Saves against sound suffer −1. An invisible or ethereal creature within 10 feet triggers a +4 detection save each round.
Raised beyond the Red Curse and encountered there, with no initial Legacy.
actions: Paired war claws, THAC0 20 for each attack, speed factor 1. Roll two separate attacks per round without a two-weapon penalty. Each hit deals 1d4+1 slashing against small or medium targets or 1d3+1 against large targets.
Without the fittings, roll the two natural front-claw attacks separately using THAC0 20 for 1d2+1 slashing each. Speed factor 1.
builds.tactics: Sava crosses ledges the patrol avoids. She turns to drive back the first pursuer if the cart needs time.

builds.title: Alseid woodland guide, Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +3 and Constitution save +4. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity.
Quadruped. Trapdoors and manholes may require squeezing, and ladders and stairs count as difficult terrain.
Woodfriend. In forests Vael leaves no tracks and can always find true north.
Archery adds +2 to ranged weapon attack rolls. Action Surge grants one extra action on her turn once per short or long rest.
actions: Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack +7, range 80/320 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 piercing.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d6 + 1 piercing, or 1d8 + 1 with two hands in melee.
Second Wind. Bonus action, regain 1d10 + 2 HP once per short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Vael marks a way out before checking the undergrowth. If threatened, she uses her speed to keep an open line for her shortbow.

builds.title: Erina defensive courier, Rogue 2
builds.speed: 25 ft., burrow 20 ft. in earth or sand
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +4. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity.
Expertise in Perception and Stealth. Thieves’ tools +5 on Dexterity checks. Knows Thieves’ Cant.
Hardy. Resist poison damage and roll saves against poison with advantage.
Spines. A creature grappling Oolay, or grappled by him, takes 1d4 piercing at the start of his turn.
Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once per turn to a finesse or ranged hit with advantage, or when a non-incapacitated enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and Oolay has no disadvantage.
actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 piercing.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Oolay uses Acrobatics to break a grapple and Disengages before leaving reach. He burrows into firm earth or sand to put a barrier between himself and an attacker.

builds.title: Piney forest pathfinder, Ranger 1
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +2 and Dexterity save +4. Unarmored AC 10 + Dexterity.
Margreve Within. Poison resistance, advantage on saves against poison and 30 minutes of direct sunlight can meet daily food needs. Margreve Without gives Hushush barklike skin.
Favored Enemy (beasts). Advantage on Survival checks to track beasts and Intelligence checks to recall information about them.

Natural Explorer (forest). Double proficiency for proficient Intelligence or Wisdom checks related to forest terrain. After at least an hour of travel, difficult terrain does not slow the group and only magic can get it lost. Hushush remains alert while busy, can travel stealthily at normal pace alone, finds twice the food when foraging, and learns exact count, sizes and elapsed time when tracking.
actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +2, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 bludgeoning, or 1d8 with two hands.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 2 piercing.
builds.tactics: Hushush leads travelers along routes where they can still turn back. They use their staff to check footing and defend themselves if cornered.

builds.title: Sublime Ravenfolk checkpoint scout, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +3. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity.
Expertise in Investigation and Stealth. Thieves’ tools +5 on Dexterity checks. Knows Thieves’ Cant.
Constant Tune. Advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened. Cosmic Musician gives proficiency with the whistle and Performance.
Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once per turn to a finesse or ranged hit with advantage, or when a non-incapacitated enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and Lampnote has no disadvantage.
actions: Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 piercing.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

Sublime Chord. One action per long rest. Creatures within 30 ft. that can hear Lampnote make a DC 13 Charisma save. On failure they are charmed by Lampnote for 10 minutes and regard them as a casual friend. Targets in combat with Lampnote or an ally have advantage on the save.
builds.tactics: Lampnote uses the chord before anyone draws steel, and leaves room for a quick exit if persuasion fails.

builds.title: Stonehide Trollkin watch guard, Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength and Constitution saves +5. Unarmored AC 10 + Dexterity + 1 from Thick Hide.
Dueling adds +2 damage when Split-Tusk uses a one-handed melee weapon and holds no other weapon.
Action Surge grants one extra action on his turn once per short or long rest.
actions: Handaxe. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 5 slashing when Dueling applies, or 1d6 + 3 otherwise.
Claws or fangs. Unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 slashing for claws or piercing for fangs.
Second Wind. Bonus action, regain 1d10 + 2 HP once per short or long rest.
Inhuman Vigor. Bonus action, spend one available Hit Die to regain 1d10 + 3 HP once per long rest. Acid or fire damage blocks this until he finishes a short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Split-Tusk has both recovery options available at the start of the watch. He tries Second Wind first so he can save a Hit Die for a later rest.

builds.title: Sivi Amberwing, Hiveless Tosculi Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +2. Natural Armor sets AC to at least 11 + Dexterity modifier.
Gliding Wings. Sivi cannot hover and takes no fall damage. Finish the round at least one-quarter of the distance flown below the start or fall. A 40 ft. glide requires a drop of at least 10 ft.
Stalker supplies Perception and Stealth. Expertise doubles the proficiency bonus for both. Sivi is proficient with thieves’ tools.

Sneak Attack deals an extra 1d6 once per turn on a hit with a finesse or ranged weapon. Sivi needs advantage or an active enemy of the target within 5 ft. of it, provided she has no disadvantage on the attack.
actions: Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack +5, range 80/320 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 piercing.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 piercing.
Claw. Melee attack +1, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d4 − 1 slashing.
Cunning Action. Take Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Sivi scouts from ledge to ledge, keeping enough height to clear each gap. She calls down the route from cover before moving again.

builds.title: Narel Claywind, Earth Shaper Jinnborn Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength and Constitution saves +5. AC 14 from chain shirt and Dexterity.
Earth siraati. Narel has acid resistance. Once on his turn on a melee hit he can add 1d6 acid damage. Three uses per long rest.
Desert Dependent. Each month spent out of the desert, make a DC 15 Charisma save (−1) or gain indefinite madness as determined with the DM.
Dueling. The listed melee damage includes +2 when wielding the framing mallet in one hand with no other weapon.
actions: Framing mallet (club). Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d4 + 5 bludgeoning.
Second Wind. Bonus action to regain 1d10 + 1 HP. One use per short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Narel talks first. If pressed into a fight beside the kiln, he tries to draw the intruder away from the dry clay racks and spends his elemental strike on an opening hit.

builds.title: Vey Tern, Ramag checkpoint Wizard 1
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Intelligence save +5 and Wisdom save +3. Arcana proficiency comes from Mystical Understanding.
Spell Damping gives advantage on Strength (−1) and Dexterity (+2) saves against spells. Arcane Heritage waives class prerequisites to attune to a magic item.

Spellcasting. Intelligence DC 13, spell attack +5. Two 1st-level slots per long rest. Arcane Recovery restores one expended 1st-level slot after a short rest, once per day. The spellbook also contains detect magic and comprehend languages, available as rituals without preparing them.
actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +1, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 − 1 bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 − 1 with two hands.
Ray of frost (cantrip). Ranged spell attack +5, range 60 ft. Hit 1d8 cold and reduce target speed by 10 ft. through the start of Vey’s next turn.
Light or mage hand (cantrips). Light a touched object for 1 hour, or manipulate a light object in reach of a spectral hand within 30 ft. for up to 1 minute.
Mage armor (1st level). Touch a willing unarmored creature. Its base AC is 13 + Dexterity modifier for 8 hours (Vey’s AC rises to 15).
Fog cloud (1st level). A 20 ft. radius sphere within 120 ft. is heavily obscured for up to 1 hour with concentration. Wind of at least 10 mph disperses it.

Grease (1st level). Cover a 10 ft. square within 60 ft. with difficult terrain for 1 minute. Creatures in it when cast, entering it, or ending a turn there must pass a Dexterity save (DC 13) or fall prone.

Feather fall (1st level, reaction). When Vey or a creature within 60 ft. falls, choose up to five falling creatures within 60 ft. They descend at 60 ft. per round for up to 1 minute and land on their feet without fall damage if they land before the spell ends.
builds.tactics: Vey saves a spell slot for feather fall. When the upper passage closes, she guides travelers to the maintenance shaft and lowers them to the landing beneath it.

builds.title: Kesh Reedroot, Kijani trail sentinel Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Constitution save +4. Unarmored AC is 10 + Dexterity modifier.
Plantborn. Kesh is a Plant and is immune to effects that put a creature to sleep. Kesh rests in dormancy.
Contained Fury. At 9 HP or fewer, add 1d4 damage to one weapon hit per turn. While at 9 HP or fewer, use a reaction after an attack from a visible attacker hits to raise AC to 13 for that attack.
Dueling. The listed one-handed damage includes +2 while Kesh wields the staff with no other weapon.
actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 5 bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 + 3 with two hands. Contained Fury adds 1d4 bludgeoning when eligible.
Action Surge. Take one additional action this turn. One use per short or long rest.
Second Wind. Bonus action to regain 1d10 + 2 HP. One use per short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Kesh holds the narrow crossing from the near side. Once wounded, he decides whether to hold the line with Contained Fury or heal with Second Wind and carry a warning to the next sentry.

builds.title: Unbound Satarre threshold scout, Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +3 and Constitution save +5. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity modifier. The Archery fighting style adds +2 to sling attack rolls.
Keeper of Secrets grants advantage on Arcana checks about planes and planar travel. Vesk chose Insight proficiency.

Portal Sense reveals the direction and distance to the nearest nonmagical entrance or exit while Vesk is in a confined area. Vesk has advantage on Investigation or Perception checks to find hidden or invisible doors and magical portals.
Action Surge grants an extra action on Vesk’s turn once per short or long rest.
Vesk’s background grants Investigation, Stealth, Common, and cartographer’s tools.
actions: Sling. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 30/120 ft. Hit 1d4 + 2 bludgeoning.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 1 bludgeoning, or 1d8 + 1 with two hands.

Unraveling Touch. Action, once per long rest. A creature Vesk can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure it must spend its action each turn to repeat the save. A success ends the effect.
Second Wind. Bonus action once per short or long rest. Regain 1d10 + 2 HP.
builds.tactics: In a closed room, Vesk calls out the nearest ordinary exit. If someone blocks that route, he uses Unraveling Touch to buy time for others to get past.

builds.title: Serpentine Lamia river scout, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +4 and Intelligence save +2. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity modifier.
Serpent Strike gives Tara advantage on attacks against a creature she has surprised or that she or an ally has charmed.
Snake Body gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid being knocked prone. Tara gains no benefit from effects or gear that require legs or feet.

Once per turn, Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to a ranged or finesse weapon hit when Tara has advantage or another enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and isn’t incapacitated. Disadvantage blocks the extra damage unless it is canceled.
Expertise in Deception and Stealth. Proficient with thieves’ tools. Tara’s background grants Sleight of Hand, Survival, navigator’s tools, and water vehicles.
actions: Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 2 piercing.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 2 piercing.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Tara swims to the pilings, climbs onto the quay, and waits out the patrol. If spotted, she Disengages and drops back into the river.

builds.title: Morel Mushroomfolk tunnel guide, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +2. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity modifier.
Fungoid Form. Nerin has advantage on saves against poison, resistance to poison damage, and immunity to disease.
Adaptable Camouflage. At least a minute spent adjusting coloration in an area rich in naturally occurring plants or fungi gives Nerin advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks there for 24 hours.

Once per turn, Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to a ranged or finesse weapon hit when Nerin has advantage or another enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and isn’t incapacitated. Disadvantage blocks the extra damage unless it is canceled.
Expertise in Stealth and Survival. Proficient with thieves’ tools. Nerin’s background grants Medicine, Nature, Common, and an herbalism kit.
actions: Sling. Ranged weapon attack +5, range 30/120 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 bludgeoning.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +1, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 − 1 bludgeoning, or 1d8 − 1 with two hands.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Nerin adjusts their coloring in a fungus bed before scouting the next tunnel. If a creature follows, they use its route to lead it away from the group.

builds.title: Aranea seam scout, monster class 5
builds.difficulty: CR 3, ECL 5 (3 class HD).
builds.speed: 40 ft., climb 25 ft. in spider form
traits: Neutral. Natural armor +1 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 11. BAB +3, grapple +4. Fortitude +6, Reflex +6, Will +2.
Alertness and Improved Initiative. May take 10 on Climb while threatened.
actions: Bite +4 melee, 1d6+1 piercing. Fortitude DC 14 negates 1d6 temporary Strength damage on contact and again 1 minute later.

Web 3/day as a standard action in spider or hybrid form. Ranged touch +6, range increment 10 ft., maximum 50 ft., targets up to Large. A hit anchors the target. It cannot move, takes −2 to attacks and −4 Dexterity, and must make a DC 15 Concentration check to cast. Escape Artist DC 20 or Strength DC 26 escapes. The web has 6 HP and takes double damage from fire.

Alternate form as a standard action. Switch to the spider-humanoid hybrid at will or to one fixed human form 3/day for 1 hour per use. The human form retains spellcasting and loses the spider's web and poison. Tess carries a dagger (+4 melee, 1d4+1 piercing, 19–20/×2) when traveling in human form.

Sorcerer casting at CL 2, save DC 14 + spell level, 6 cantrips and 5 first-level spells per day. Knows detect magic, ghost sound, light, mage hand, and resistance, plus mage armor and silent image. Mage armor raises AC to 18 for 2 hours. Silent image fills up to six 10-ft. cubes, lasts while concentrating, and allows DC 15 Will disbelief on interaction.
builds.tactics: Cast mage armor before investigating. Thin out pursuers with a false barricade, web the first to cross, and withdraw along the underside of the bridge.

builds.title: Annis Hag chainkeeper, monster class 11
builds.difficulty: CR 4, ECL 11 (6 class HD).
traits: Neutral evil. Large −1, natural armor +10, Dexterity +2. Touch 11, flat-footed 19. BAB +6/+1, grapple +19, reach 10 ft. Fortitude +6, Reflex +7, Will +7.
Spell resistance 18. Steely Skin subtracts 1 damage from slashing or piercing weapon hits and adds 1 to bludgeoning weapon hits, including morningstars. Alertness, Multiattack, Improved Initiative.
actions: Claw +14 melee, 1d6+9 slashing. On a full attack use both claws and bite +12 melee, 1d6+4 piercing. Two claws hitting the same target add rend damage of 2d6+18.

Improved grab after a claw hit against a Large or smaller foe. Start a grapple at +19 as a free action, without an attack of opportunity. Take a −20 penalty to grapple with just the claw while avoiding the grappled condition.

Change self 3/day for 60 minutes. Gain +10 on Disguise for visual changes, with DC 11 Will disbelief on interaction. Fog cloud 1/day at up to 160 ft., 30-ft. radius and 20-ft. height, lasts 60 minutes, no save or spell resistance. Both at CL 6.
builds.tactics: Break up ranged support with fog cloud. Use reach to intercept the first creature to leave the fog and attack an adjacent foe with both claws when possible.

builds.title: Barghest patrol hunter, monster class 2
builds.difficulty: CR 2, ECL 2 (2 class HD).
traits: Lawful evil. Natural armor +2 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +6, Reflex +5, Will +3.
Improved Initiative. Scent gives direction as a move action and pinpoints within 5 ft. of the source.
actions: Bite +5 melee, 1d6+3 piercing. On a full attack add two claws +0 melee, 1d4+1 slashing each. Bite and claws are available in both forms.
Alternate form as a standard action. Wolf form moves at 60 ft., gains +4 circumstance to Hide and can use pass without trace as a free action so ordinary tracking finds no trail.

Feed on a slain humanoid after making the kill. As a full-round action, destroys the body for +2 enhancement Constitution for one day (HP 17 and Fortitude +7). Revivals requiring the body fail. Wish, miracle or true resurrection succeeds only 50% of the time.
builds.tactics: Listen from hiding in wolf form. Follow a lone courier and use speed to disengage if their escort returns.

builds.title: Djinni crosswind guide, monster class 4
builds.difficulty: CR 2, ECL 4 (2 class HD).
traits: Chaotic good. Dexterity +3 and natural armor +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 11. BAB +2, grapple +4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +6, Will +5.

Acid resistance 5. Air Mastery imposes a −1 circumstance penalty on attack and damage rolls by airborne creatures against Safa. Alertness, Dodge, and Improved Initiative. Dodge adds +1 AC against a designated foe.
actions: Slam +4 melee, 1d4+3 bludgeoning. At-will invisibility affects Safa only and ends if Safa attacks.

Whirlwind 1/day for up to 7 rounds. Travels at fly speed and is 5 ft. wide at the base, up to 30 ft. wide at the top and 10–50 ft. high. On contact a Medium or smaller creature rolls Reflex DC 20 or takes 3d6 damage. A separate DC 20 Reflex save prevents suspension, which deals 1d8 damage each round. Flyers can save at the same DC to escape after taking that round's damage. Safa can release captured creatures at will.

If the whirlwind touches the ground, debris clouds an area whose diameter is half its height. At 5 ft. there is one-half concealment. Beyond 5 ft. there is total concealment, even against darkvision. Casting within the debris requires a DC 20 Concentration check.
builds.tactics: Mark the quiet side of the landing by telepathy. Fly overhead unseen and use whirlwind to pull pursuers away once the porters have cleared the ledge.

builds.title: Drider gallery sentry, monster class 6 (Sorcerer)
builds.difficulty: CR 3, ECL 6 (4 class HD).
traits: Neutral. Natural armor +4 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple +5. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +6. Spell resistance 10.
Alertness, Combat Casting and Improved Initiative. May take 10 on Climb while threatened.
actions: Bite +5 melee, 1d4+1 piercing. Fortitude DC 15 negates 1d4 temporary Strength damage on contact and again 1 minute later.

Sorcerer casting at CL 4, save DC 13 + spell level. Daily slots 6/7/4. Knows dancing lights, detect magic, light, mage hand, message, ray of frost, mage armor, magic missile, shield, and web. Mage armor raises AC to 21 for 4 hours. Magic missile sends two 1d4+1 force missiles. Shield lasts 4 minutes, prevents magic missile, and grants directional cover (+7 AC and +3 on Reflex against area effects from that half). Ray of frost +6 ranged touch for 1d3 cold.

Web at up to 140 ft., 20-ft.-radius spread, duration 40 minutes with opposing supports. Reflex DC 15 or stuck. A stuck creature can spend a round to break free (DC 20 Strength or DC 25 Escape Artist). A creature that saves or breaks free can spend a round moving 5 ft. per full 5 points by which a new Strength or Escape Artist check exceeds 10. Spell resistance applies. Fire burns away affected web sections and deals 2d4 fire damage to creatures in the burning webs.

Each spell-like ability 1/day at CL 4, DC 13 + spell level. Clairaudience/clairvoyance, dancing lights, darkness, detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, detect law, detect magic, discern lies, dispel magic, faerie fire, levitate, and suggestion.
builds.tactics: Check the approach from cover using clairvoyance. Cast web between the gallery supports after workers pass, then remain above reach and use magic missile against a looter who gets through.

builds.title: Efreeti quartermaster, Efreeti 3
builds.difficulty: CR 2, ECL 3 from Table A–14.
traits: Lawful evil. Natural armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +2, grapple +6. Fortitude +6, Reflex +4, Will +4. Improved Initiative.
Fire immunity. Under the 3.0 fire subtype, −10 on saves against cold attacks. Take double damage when the cold attack offers no save.
actions: Slam +6 melee, 1d4+6 bludgeoning plus 1 fire. Heat also deals 1 fire on a successful grapple and each round Kesh maintains the hold.

Spell-like abilities at caster level 10. Detect magic and enlarge 1/day each. Enlarge increases a creature’s dimensions by up to 50% for 10 minutes, granting up to +2 Strength. Fortitude DC 13 negates for an unwilling target.

Produce flame and pyrotechnics at will. Produce flame is a +6 melee or +3 ranged touch attack, up to 120 ft., dealing 1d4+5 fire. It lasts 10 rounds. Pyrotechnics can blind creatures that see the source within 120 ft. for 1d4+1 rounds, Will DC 14 negates. Its smoke option blocks sight in a 20-ft. spread for 10 rounds. Fortitude DC 14 negates the smoke’s −4 Strength and Dexterity penalties.
builds.tactics: Kesh gives telepathic orders and uses smoke to keep intruders away from the fuel. He uses produce flame if an assailant can see through the smoke.

builds.title: Flamebrother patrol guard, Flamebrother 4
builds.difficulty: CR 2, ECL 4 from Table A–18.
traits: Lawful neutral. Small +1, natural armor +5, Dexterity +3. Touch 14, flat-footed 16. BAB +2, grapple +1, Fortitude +5, Reflex +6, Will +5. Weapon Focus (salamander halfspear).
Fire immunity. −10 on saves against cold attacks. Take double damage from cold attacks that offer no save.
actions: Salamander halfspear held in two hands +7 melee, 1d8+4 piercing plus 1d4 fire, ×3.
Tail slap +6 melee, 1d4+1 bludgeoning plus 1d4 fire. In a full attack with the halfspear, add the tail at +1.
Constrict on a successful grapple check against a creature up to Medium size. Deal 1d4+1 bludgeoning plus 1d4 fire.
builds.tactics: Sava holds the bridge with the halfspear. If the runner closes, he tries to grab and constrict them before they can circle him.

builds.title: Athach quarry guard, Athach 3
builds.difficulty: CR 2, ECL 3 from Table A–5.
traits: Neutral. Natural armor +1, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 11. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +5. Multidexterity and Multiweapon Fighting.
actions: Single club attack +5 melee, 1d6+3 bludgeoning, ×2.
Three-arm full attack with club +3 melee (1d6+3 bludgeoning) and two daggers +3 melee each (1d4+1 piercing, 19–20/×2). Add a secondary bite +0 melee (1d4+1 plus poison).
Bite poison, Fortitude DC 14. Initial and secondary damage are each 1d4 Strength, with the second save after 1 minute.
builds.tactics: Tov leads with his club and keeps the daggers tucked away when a warning will do. When surrounded, he draws both daggers and uses all three weapon arms.

builds.title: Grig fiddler, Grig 4
builds.difficulty: CR 1, ECL 4 from Table A–25.
traits: Neutral good. Tiny +2, Dexterity +6, natural armor +2. Touch 18, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple −10, Fortitude +1, Reflex +8, Will +4. Spell resistance 17. Improved Initiative and bonus Dodge (+1 AC against one designated opponent).
A 2½-ft. face and 0-ft. reach. Entering an enemy’s square to make a melee attack provokes an attack of opportunity.
actions: Attuned fiddle. While Fenn plays, a nonsprite within 30 ft. must make a DC 15 Will save or suffer the effects of Otto’s irresistible dance. It can only dance, takes −4 AC, loses the use of its shield, and can succeed on a Reflex save only by rolling a natural 20. The effect ends when Fenn stops playing.

Change self, entangle, invisibility (self only), pyrotechnics, and ventriloquism each 3/day at caster level 9. Entangle needs plants and hampers movement even if the target succeeds on the DC 14 Reflex save. Pyrotechnics uses DC 15 Will for fireworks or DC 15 Fortitude for the smoke penalties.
builds.tactics: Fenn entangles pursuers where the brush is thick and escapes invisibly. He uses the fiddle only when nearby travelers can afford to stop moving.

builds.title: Harpy lookout, Harpy 4
builds.difficulty: CR 2, ECL 4 from Table A–27.
traits: Neutral. Natural armor +1, Dexterity +5. Touch 15, flat-footed 11. BAB +4, grapple +6. Fortitude +3, Reflex +9, Will +5. Alertness and Weapon Focus (claw).
actions: Two claws +7 melee each on a full attack, 1d3+1 slashing each. A single claw is available with a standard attack.

Captivating Song, 10-ft. radius, DC 15 Will. Nonharpies that fail follow the most direct route toward Ryn and can only defend themselves. They stop within 5 ft. and offer no resistance to her attacks. A dangerous route or a bard’s countersong grants another save. A successful save gives one day of immunity to her song. This is a sonic mind-affecting charm. It lasts while she sings and 4 rounds afterward.
builds.tactics: Ryn descends close enough to catch pursuers with her song, then keeps them away from the scout’s rope by singing from a clear stretch of trail.

builds.title: Kyton chain guard, Kyton 4
builds.difficulty: CR 1 by Table A–31. Kyton monster class level 4, 3 HD.
traits: Lawful evil. AC includes +2 natural armor and +2 Dexterity. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +3, grapple +6. Fortitude +5, Reflex +5, Will +3.
Cold immunity. Improved Initiative and Weapon Focus (chain rake). The weapon focus also applies to a spiked chain.
actions: Chain rake +7 melee, 1d6+3 slashing, 10-ft. reach including adjacent squares. Full attack makes two rakes at +7 each.
Unnerving Gaze (Su). Enemies within 5 ft. make a DC 12 Will save or take a −1 morale penalty on attack rolls for 1d3 rounds. Each enemy can be subject to Veyl’s gaze once per day.

Dancing Chains (Su). As a standard action, control one unattended chain within 20 ft. Veyl can add up to 15 ft. of length and grow barbs. The chain makes one attack per round at +7 for 1d6+3. Veyl climbs a controlled chain at his land speed without a check.
builds.tactics: Veyl animates the tollgate’s hanging chain while he bargains. He uses his body chains to cover both the gap beside him and the stairs behind it.

builds.title: Lillend gatekeeper, Lillend 6
builds.difficulty: CR 4 by Table A–32. Lillend monster class level 6, 5 HD.
traits: Chaotic good. AC includes +2 natural armor and +1 Dexterity. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +5, grapple +10. Fortitude +5, Reflex +5, Will +6.
Poison immunity and fire resistance 5. Improved Initiative and Weapon Focus (longsword). Her lyre is an ordinary instrument.

Bard spells at caster level 3. Three 0-level slots per day shared by detect magic, ghost sound, light, mage hand, mending, and read magic (save DC 15 where relevant). Two 1st-level slots per day shared by cure light wounds, feather fall, and grease (save DC 16).
actions: Longsword +11 melee, 1d8+5 slashing, 19–20/×2. Tail slap +10 melee, 1d8+2 bludgeoning. When using both in a full attack, the tail is secondary at +5.

Improved Grab and Constrict (Ex). A tail hit against a Medium or smaller creature lets Sereva start a grapple at +10 without an attack of opportunity. On a hold she adds 1d8+5 constrict damage. She cannot take move actions while constricting and may still attack with a held weapon.

Bardic music 3/day. Each use can inspire courage, countersong, fascinate, or inspire competence. Inspire courage gives allies who hear her for a full round +2 morale on saves against charm and fear and +1 morale on attack and weapon damage. It lasts while they hear her and for 5 rounds afterward. Countersong lets listeners within 30 ft. substitute her Perform result for a lower save roll against a sonic or language-dependent magical effect. Fascinate affects one listening, attentive creature within 90 ft. outside combat, with Will DC set by her Perform check, and lasts up to 3 rounds. Inspire competence gives one ally within 30 ft. +2 on one skill for up to 2 minutes while the ally hears her. The ally and Sereva must be able to see each other.

World and talk powers (Sp), each 1/day at caster level 7. Darkness, hallucinatory terrain (Will DC 19 where relevant), knock, light, charm person (Will DC 16), speak with animals, and speak with plants.

Cure light wounds restores 1d8+3 HP by touch. Grease coats a 10-ft. square within 30 ft. for 3 rounds (Reflex DC 16 to avoid falling). As a free action, feather fall slows falling targets in a 10-ft. radius within 30 ft. until they land or 3 rounds pass. The targets may weigh up to 900 lb. in total.
builds.tactics: Sereva takes the high walkway and asks for the old crossing song. If someone runs toward the gate, she lands beside the latch and grabs with her tail.

builds.title: Medusa quarry keeper, Medusa 6
builds.difficulty: CR 3 by Table A–34. Medusa monster class level 6, 4 HD.
traits: Lawful neutral. AC includes +2 natural armor and +3 Dexterity. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +4, grapple +5. Fortitude +4, Reflex +7, Will +4.
Alertness, Point Blank Shot, and Precise Shot. She can fire into melee without the usual −4 penalty.
actions: Snake hair +5 melee, 1d4 piercing and poison. Fortitude DC 15 on the hit against 1d4 Strength damage, and again a minute later against 2d4 Strength damage.
Shortbow +7 ranged, 1d6 piercing, ×3, 60-ft. range increment. At 30 ft. or less use +8 and 1d6+1.

Petrifying Gaze (Su), 1/day. As an active gaze attack, choose one creature within 10 ft. It must make a Fortitude DC 16 save or turn to stone. Apply ordinary gaze avoidance rules when the target averts or covers its eyes.
builds.tactics: Mereth calls for parley from behind a pillar. If a foe rushes past it, she uses her gaze on that one foe and signals the quarryhands to leave.

builds.title: Nixie ford negotiator, Nixie 2
builds.difficulty: CR 1 by Table A–37. Nixie monster class level 2, 1 HD.
traits: Neutral. AC includes +1 size and +4 Dexterity. Touch 15, flat-footed 11. BAB +0, grapple −6. Fortitude +1, Reflex +6, Will +3.
Improved Initiative. Amphibious. Tivin can take 10 on Swim checks and run in a straight line while swimming.
actions: Sling +5 ranged, 1d4−2 bludgeoning (minimum 1), ×2, 50-ft. range increment. Loading the sling is a move-equivalent action.

Charm Person (Sp), 1/day at caster level 2. One Medium or smaller humanoid within 30 ft. becomes friendly for 2 hours on a failed DC 15 Will save. Give the target +5 on the save if Tivin or his allies are threatening or attacking it. Requests outside the target’s normal behavior require an opposed Charisma check. The target refuses suicidal orders. Threatening it afterward breaks the charm.
Water Breathing (Sp), 1/day at caster level 4. Divide 8 hours of underwater breathing evenly among the living creatures touched.
builds.tactics: Tivin offers to help the first traveler who puts their weapon down. If talks stall without violence, Tivin uses charm person to get one traveler to hear them out and then offers water breathing for the crossing.

builds.title: Sea hag shore ambusher, Sea Hag 2
builds.difficulty: CR 1 by Table A–43. Sea Hag monster class level 2, 1 HD.
traits: Chaotic evil. AC includes +1 natural armor and +1 Dexterity. Touch 11, flat-footed 11. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +3.
Alertness. Breathes air and water. Alda can take 10 on Swim checks and run in a straight line while swimming.
actions: Claw +4 melee, 1d4+3 slashing. Full attack makes two claws at +4 each.
Horrific Appearance (Su). A creature looking at Alda makes a DC 11 Fortitude save or takes 1 point of Strength damage. Success grants immunity to her Horrific Appearance for 24 hours.
builds.tactics: Alda crouches just below the waterline. She shows her face when a scavenger leans over the stones, claws if cornered, and dives when her escape opens.

builds.title: Umber Hulk barricade keeper, monster class 9
builds.difficulty: CR 4 from Table A–51. ECL 9 with 6 class Hit Dice.
traits: Neutral. Natural armor +7, Dexterity +1, Large size −1. Touch 10, flat-footed 16. BAB +4, grapple +14. Fortitude +7, Reflex +3, Will +7. Reach 10 ft.
Alertness, Iron Will, and Ability Focus (Confusing Gaze).
actions: Two claws +9 melee, 1d6+6 each, and a secondary bite +4 melee, 1d8+3, when making a full attack.

Confusing Gaze (Su), 10-ft. range. Will DC 16 negates. On a failure, use confusion for 8 rounds. Resolve passive gaze at the start of each opponent’s turn and one active gaze as an attack action. An opponent averting their eyes has a 50% chance to avoid the save. Covering their eyes avoids the save and gives Rusk total concealment.

Confusion behavior each turn (1d10). On 1 wander away for up to 1 minute without rerolling. On 2–6 do nothing. On 7–9 attack the nearest creature. On 10 act normally. A confused creature that is attacked retaliates on its next turn if it can.
builds.tactics: Rusk listens for footfalls through the rock and burrows to the tunnel mouth. He warns anyone close enough to meet his gaze, then holds the passage with his claws.

builds.title: Air Elemental beacon tender, monster class 5
builds.difficulty: CR 2 from Table A–1. ECL 5 with 4 class Hit Dice.
traits: Neutral. Natural armor +3 and Dexterity +5. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +3, grapple +6. Fortitude +5, Reflex +9, Will +2.
Alertness and Dodge. Dodged opponent faces AC 19 while Skirl can use his Dexterity bonus. Bonus Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, and Weapon Finesse (slam).
Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, and critical hits. Air Mastery imposes −1 on airborne opponents’ attack and damage rolls against Skirl.
actions: Slam +8 melee, 1d6+4 bludgeoning. Flyby Attack allows a partial action, such as the slam, during movement.

Whirlwind (Su), once every 10 minutes for up to 2 rounds. Fly at normal speed in a 5-ft.-wide base and 10- to 30-ft.-high funnel. A Small or smaller creature touching or entering it makes two DC 16 Reflex saves, one to avoid 1d6 damage and one to avoid being lifted. A lifted creature takes 1d6 damage each round and a flyer gets another DC 16 Reflex save each round to escape. Skirl may eject a carried creature at any time. While the base touches the ground, the debris cloud spans half the funnel’s height. It gives concealment at 5 ft., total concealment farther away, and requires a DC 16 Concentration check to cast spells inside.
builds.tactics: Skirl swoops low over the beacon to get attention. If a Small creature rushes the ledge anyway, he uses the whirlwind to pick it up and carry it inland.

builds.title: Imp eavesdropper, monster class 4
builds.difficulty: CR 2 from Table A–29. ECL 4 with 3 class Hit Dice.
traits: Lawful evil. Natural armor +2, Dexterity +4, Tiny size +2. Touch 16, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple −5, reach 0 ft. Fortitude +5, Reflex +7, Will +5.
Poison immunity, fire resistance 5, and damage reduction 5/silver or holy. Alertness, Improved Initiative, and bonus Weapon Finesse (sting).
actions: Sting +9 melee, 1d4 damage. Fortitude DC 15 or take 1d4 Dexterity damage, then a second save one minute later or take another 1d4 Dexterity damage.
Detect good, detect magic, and invisibility at will, caster level 6. Invisibility affects Tack alone, lasts up to 60 minutes or until Tack attacks, and is usable in either form.

Polymorph (Su) at will as a standard action, caster level 12. Tack picked a raven as his only alternate form. He can stay in that form for up to 12 hours under the updated 3.0 polymorph self rules. In that form he has a raven’s 10-ft. land speed and 40-ft. fly speed (average) and loses access to his sting.
builds.tactics: Tack follows a suspect as a raven. As soon as someone bars the shutters, he turns invisible and waits at the door for the next visitor.

builds.title: Rakshasa claims agent, monster class 8
builds.difficulty: CR 6 from Table A–41. ECL 8 with 4 class Hit Dice.
traits: Lawful evil. Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 10. BAB +4, grapple +7. Fortitude +7, Reflex +7, Will +5.

Damage reduction 10/+2. Spell immunity covers 1st- through 3rd-level effects and can be suppressed, as for spell resistance, to receive spells. A hit from a blessed crossbow bolt kills Varek. Alertness and Combat Casting.
actions: Two claws +7 melee, 1d4+3 each, and a secondary bite +2 melee, 1d6+1, when making a full attack in natural form.

Alternate Form (Su) at will as a standard action, caster level 18. Use the original alter self rules and choose a humanoid form. Varek can remain disguised indefinitely. His usual disguise is a human clerk.

Detect thoughts (Sp) 3/day, caster level 12, Will DC 15 to hide surface thoughts. Concentrate for up to 12 minutes. The first round detects minds, the second gives their number and Intelligence scores, and the third permits reading surface thoughts.

Sorcerer casting, caster level 4. Daily slots 6/7/4. DC 13 + spell level. Known 0-level spells are detect magic, light, mage hand, message, prestidigitation, and read magic. Known 1st-level spells are charm person, command (cleric spell cast as arcane), and silent image. Known 2nd-level spell is invisibility.

Silent image creates a purely visual illusion for as long as Varek concentrates. Will DC 14 disbelieves on interaction. Invisibility lasts 40 minutes or until the target attacks. Varek must suppress his own immunity to accept it.
builds.tactics: Varek uses detect thoughts to see who recognizes his story. He shows a false cargo hold with silent image. If confronted, he suppresses immunity before turning invisible or sends an associate away under the spell.

builds.title: Quay champion
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1 (200 XP)
actions: Multiattack. Make two Boat hook attacks.

Boat hook. Melee attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Once per turn on a hit, a Medium or smaller target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or move 5 ft. toward the champion.
Thrown belaying pin. Ranged attack +5, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
builds.tactics: Pulls opponents away from the object or person under guard. Stops fighting once the opponent leaves the guarded area.

concepts.name: Tesk Reedmark
concepts.motive: Keep the refuge supplied after travelers stop trusting the road markers.
concepts.hook: Tesk saw who moved the flood markers and will take the party to the washed-out trail if someone stays to warn incoming travelers.

concepts.name: Nemi
concepts.motive: Get a repair crew across the ravine before another support gives way.
concepts.hook: Nemi can lead the party up an old canopy route if they carry a coil of rope and check the upper anchor.

concepts.name: Vasha Kilnline
concepts.motive: Keep the night dock open after a fatal accident threatens its license.
concepts.hook: Vasha will name the boat that struck the pier if someone gets the workers a public hearing.

concepts.name: Bruni Telltale
concepts.motive: Close the bridge long enough to replace a failing support.
concepts.hook: Bruni offers a drawing that reveals who has been removing approved reinforcement from shipments.

concepts.name: Bramble
concepts.role: Mountain-pass rescuer who can hold an evacuation route
concepts.motive: Get a stranded repair crew off the pass before dark.
concepts.hook: Bramble has a safety rope on the safe side but needs someone to reach the crew from the other bank.

concepts.name: Ilen
concepts.role: River lineage ferry healer who can guide an underwater rescue
concepts.motive: Recover a missing ferry passenger before the current takes them past the landing.
concepts.hook: Ilen can ask fish which side of the old pier the passenger surfaced on, then dress their wounds once the group gets them ashore.

concepts.name: Maren Eldermere
concepts.role: Seed vault keeper and generalist Wizard.
concepts.motive: Find out who entered the seed vault before a delayed spring shipment is reopened.
concepts.hook: Maren can study the damaged catches if the party keeps the room clear and brings the missing inventory board.

concepts.name: Oswin Fenlock
concepts.motive: Find what keeps tripping the cistern gate before the next water draw.
concepts.hook: Oswin can inspect the dark maintenance stair if the party keeps the main lever still.

concepts.name: Lethir Span
concepts.role: Guide with a conflict of interest
concepts.motive: Keep a disused path out of a survey that would make it a toll road.
concepts.hook: Lethir can get the group to the survey camp by dawn if they carry a truthful message from the people displaced by the work.

concepts.name: Cora Spindle
concepts.motive: Get her apprentice released by proving a seized clock never left the workshop.
concepts.hook: The replacement gear is stamped with who ordered it and can be matched to the seized clock through a service hatch.

concepts.name: Seki
concepts.role: Badger example. Cave surveyor and rescue contact.
concepts.motive: Confirm which shaft can still support the weight of trapped workers.
concepts.hook: Seki will inspect a narrow support passage if the party keeps the main shaft clear.

concepts.name: Aya
concepts.role: Sparrow example. Dispatch runner and lookout.
concepts.motive: Get a warning to the next watch post before a washout cuts off the main road.
concepts.hook: Aya can look ahead by air and needs someone to keep the lower footpath open for travelers.

concepts.name: Skel Downwind
concepts.motive: Recover a lost climbing crew before bad weather strands a second crew.
concepts.hook: Skel trades the best lead for help convincing the rival expedition to lend its rope ladders.

concepts.name: Pell Reedgate
concepts.motive: Keep a lease over a ferry landing where her neighbors work.
concepts.hook: Pell will walk the group to the ferry after closing if they bring a copy of the charter to the next meeting.

concepts.name: Rovan Threadglass
concepts.role: Festival rigging keeper and apprentice Soulknife.
concepts.motive: Bring the festival lanterns down before a jammed counterweight tears free.
concepts.hook: Rovan can reach the far stair if the party clears the square and holds the loose line.

concepts.name: Berren Shalebank
concepts.motive: Identify which shipment carries a counterfeit stamp before the ore lots are mixed.
concepts.hook: Berren can compare the samples in the covered counting room if the party finds the missing merchant seal.

concepts.name: Lysa Chalkmark
concepts.motive: Find a quiet gap in an old stone sentry’s route so repairers can reach a counterweight.
concepts.hook: Lysa can listen for the sentry and guide the party between passes if they leave the narrow ledge clear.

concepts.name: Miren Trackweft
concepts.role: Woodland reserve tracker and wildlife keeper.
concepts.motive: Find a lost wolf before it blunders into someone else’s snare line.
concepts.hook: Miren can identify where the wolf doubled back if the party keeps the last reliable tracks clear.

concepts.name: Ira Stonecup
concepts.motive: Keep two feuding estates from bringing their own guards to the landing.
concepts.hook: Ira needs an independent witness for the passenger list before either estate tries to seize the ferry.

concepts.name: Doma Three Notches
concepts.motive: Find a seasonal crossing both families can use without abandoning either herd.
concepts.hook: Doma can show the party where a public bridge used to stand. The landowner who removed it will be there at dusk.

concepts.name: Mina Letterturn
concepts.motive: Keep a locked archive available to people who are still appealing a decision.
concepts.hook: Mina asks the group to serve as reading witnesses after the usual keeper stops answering messages.

concepts.name: Irimel
concepts.role: Hunter aspect. Fog trail ward and Rogue.
concepts.motive: Guide the last group of travellers around a flooded stretch before the markers go under.
concepts.hook: Irimel can find old warning lines and pinpoint someone calling from the fog if the party keeps the trail open.

concepts.name: Parry Millguard
concepts.motive: Keep the approach clear until the workers finish closing the shutters.
concepts.hook: Parry can hold the mill gate while the party checks the service ladder.

concepts.name: Grip Stonebrace
concepts.motive: Get the last workers up the steps before the broken grate gives out.
concepts.hook: Grip can hold the lower landing while the party guides the workers out.

concepts.name: Mara Fir Vale
concepts.motive: Return an elf-restricted magic clasp before someone redeems it with a copied pawn ticket.
concepts.hook: Mara can demonstrate the clasp for the party once they find the owner listed in her ledger.

concepts.name: Tavin Nek Reed
concepts.motive: Find out who rang the ferry in after it had already docked for the night.
concepts.hook: Tavin can imitate the cracked ferry bell. The party can watch the landing to see who comes for the crossing.

concepts.name: Daranvar
concepts.role: Destroyer aspect. Grove threshold steward and Fighter.
concepts.motive: Keep a stray construct out of a seedling grove while a druid finds its control mark.
concepts.hook: Daranvar can hold the crossing while the party checks the construct for its maker’s mark.

concepts.name: Rusk Ashbank
concepts.motive: Find the woodcutters before rising water cuts off the trail.
concepts.hook: Rusk found the first scent at a bank that has begun to collapse.

concepts.name: Dara Cutbank
concepts.motive: Evacuate trapped workers from the cutbank without losing the open tunnel.
concepts.hook: The badgers can tell Dara which branch is blocked.

concepts.name: Ili Venn
concepts.motive: Clear a fellow witness whose night journey was entered on the wrong route sheet.
concepts.hook: Ili asks the party to compare the night's watch fires with the account they were given.

concepts.name: Sura Reedcord
concepts.role: Ice Caste locksmith and floodgate witness.
concepts.motive: Reopen the jammed floodgate before water backs up into an occupied alley.
concepts.hook: Sura can identify which release pin was replaced if the party keeps the walkway clear.

concepts.name: Nella Sedgefold
concepts.motive: Deliver a ledger slip before the postern closes and find out why its intended recipient missed the lantern signal.
concepts.hook: Nella can approach the postern while the party checks the dark lantern and its keeper.

concepts.name: Mara Sedgehill
concepts.motive: Find the messenger before the ford becomes impassable.
concepts.hook: Mara traced the rider as far as the bend above the ford.

concepts.name: Kel Stoneford
concepts.motive: Get the flock and its handlers over the ford before reopening the road.
concepts.hook: Kel needs someone to guide the last animals while he guards the crossing.

concepts.name: Tovin Larkwell
concepts.motive: Weigh the cracked clapper before the crew recasts it.
concepts.hook: Tovin can surround the repair platform with silence while the party steadies the bell and lowers the clapper.

concepts.name: Mheer Wink
concepts.motive: Get the spare key to the watch before the covered passage closes.
concepts.hook: Mheer can check the dark landing while the party works the shutter from below.

concepts.name: Pohl Nod
concepts.motive: Get the late travellers off the road before undead reach the arches.
concepts.hook: Pohl can watch the approaches while the party moves the travellers from arch to arch.

concepts.name: Anet Copperstep
concepts.role: Desert pass rescuer and Psychic Warrior.
concepts.motive: Get a trapped traveler off a narrow ledge before the scree slips.
concepts.hook: Anet has the line and can reach the ledge if the party holds the upper anchor.

concepts.name: Nadi Flintwell
concepts.role: Glassworks kiln watch and evacuation lead.
concepts.motive: Clear the furnace passage before the glassworking crew loses its exit.
concepts.hook: Nadi can guide workers through the side passage if the party moves the empty racks out of the way.

concepts.name: Pip Reedwhistle
concepts.role: Air mephling bell loft guide and Bard.
concepts.motive: Get the party past a collapsed stair.
