concepts.hook: Pip can fly through the hatch and mark the safe route.

concepts.name: Flint Cutwall
concepts.role: Earth mephling cutwall digger and Druid.
concepts.motive: Find a way to the trapped cellar keeper.
concepts.hook: Flint has found a stretch of loose earth beside the fallen wall.

concepts.name: Cinder Kilnwatch
concepts.role: Fire mephling kiln watch and Sorcerer.
concepts.motive: Keep the kiln hands from being cut off.
concepts.hook: Cinder knows which passage bypasses the damaged flue.

concepts.name: Ripple Lockreach
concepts.role: Water mephling sluice rescuer and Monk.
concepts.motive: Get a rope across the flooded sluice.
concepts.hook: Ripple can reach the far ladder and signal when the line is ready.

concepts.name: Jori Hearththread
concepts.motive: Bring three spooked pack beetles through a blocked tunnel with their loads intact.
concepts.hook: Jori can get the caravan moving if the party finds a clear lane and keeps sudden noises down.

concepts.name: Bram Reedbar
concepts.motive: Close the levee gate before water reaches the roof of the keeper’s hut, with the repair crew still out in the channel.
concepts.hook: Bring the repair crew to higher ground and Bram will lend the key to the old inspection stair.

concepts.name: Teo Spent River
concepts.motive: Get a replacement lamp across the ramp before the night crew arrives.
concepts.hook: Teo can cover the exposed ramp while the party checks the loose rail.

concepts.name: Selka of Tideglass
concepts.motive: Get clean water and an open route to the trapped survivors.
concepts.hook: Selka can reach the cistern’s upper chamber through the flooded stairs.

concepts.name: Kerrin of Shalebank
concepts.motive: Get a line to the far gate and bring the crew through.
concepts.hook: Kerrin knows which passage has a strong current and where the rope can be secured.

concepts.name: Mai the Houseless
concepts.motive: Get the watch a message before the shift changes.
concepts.hook: Mai can cross the ledge with the message while the party checks the marked footholds.

concepts.name: Renn Farwake
concepts.motive: Find the release catch before the broken landing gives way.
concepts.hook: Renn can carry the signal line up to the catwalk.

concepts.name: Daro Brightkeel
concepts.motive: Reach the winch and bring the deck crew to safety.
concepts.hook: Daro can reach the platform from the gantry after the lower stairs collapse.

concepts.name: Oru Breakwater
concepts.motive: Reach the stranded gatherers before the tide closes the cave.
concepts.hook: Oru can listen for movement through the flooded cave mouth.

concepts.name: Tess Siltstep
concepts.motive: Open the lower gate without letting the channel flood the storehouse.
concepts.hook: Tess can reach the back of the lock through the low sluice.

concepts.name: Nerin Reefbrace
concepts.motive: Hold the flooded arch until the crew reaches the sandbar.
concepts.hook: Nerin needs help opening the route while he guards the approach.

concepts.name: Tava Ebbgate
concepts.motive: Guide the rope team safely across the channel.
concepts.hook: Tava has found a rock ledge where the team can get out of the water.

concepts.name: Dessa Tallowbeat
concepts.motive: Find the lookout who missed the final drum call in a whiteout.
concepts.hook: Dessa can call along the route while the party checks the downhill forks for the missing lookout.

concepts.name: Maera Dol-Vel
concepts.motive: Find out why the animals no longer drink from the uphill spring.
concepts.hook: Maera can speak with a badger from the bank while the party checks the spillway for what changed.

concepts.name: Brott Saltbrace
concepts.motive: Free the harbor gate while the lower line is submerged.
concepts.hook: Brott can reach the jammed line through the flooded passage.

concepts.name: Rashen Dustline
concepts.motive: Find the jammed release without letting sand fill the room.
concepts.hook: Rashen can reach the release frame from outside the sandlock.

concepts.name: Neral Glassbank
concepts.motive: Keep the dry exit open while the overflow is stopped.
concepts.hook: Neral can reach the landing from the sand beside the cistern wall.

concepts.name: Vessa Mere
concepts.motive: Find the dry exit before the water reaches the next landing.
concepts.hook: Vessa spotted a recent seam in the wall beside the passage door.

concepts.name: Akari of the Reed Well
concepts.motive: Find drinkable water for the party at the dry channel.
concepts.hook: Akari suspects a seep lies under the bend in the channel.

concepts.name: Taren of High Shelf
concepts.motive: Mark a crossing before the afternoon wind obscures the trail.
concepts.hook: Taren can guide the group along the dune’s shallow shoulder.

concepts.name: Ornek Tarn-Iol
concepts.motive: Identify the old exit an ethereal traveler crossed just before a tunnel was bricked up.
concepts.hook: Ornek can identify an unusual seam in the new stonework if the party brings the old floor plan.

concepts.name: Rimewillow
concepts.motive: Find a trail that the stranded travelers can cross.
concepts.hook: Rimewillow knows where a fox has been using the hollow.

concepts.name: Stillrime
concepts.motive: Hold the shelter entrance until the travelers are inside.
concepts.hook: Stillrime can hear movement beyond the snowbank outside the shelter.

concepts.name: Avilli
concepts.role: Glider and ropeway rigger who carries a light messenger line.
concepts.motive: Reconnect a ropeway before travellers reach the damaged span.
concepts.hook: Avilli can glide a messenger line down from the upper landing if someone holds the near anchor.

concepts.name: Oren Hearthward
concepts.motive: Keep the shelter passage clear until the last travelers arrive.
concepts.hook: Oren is waiting at the entrance while the snow blocks the upper path.

concepts.name: Vela Ridgewatch
concepts.motive: Find the right fork of the trail before the wind covers the tracks.
concepts.hook: Vela can read the cairn marker and guide the party through the cut.

concepts.name: Iona Vale
concepts.motive: Bring the last ferrymen out of the quay passage.
concepts.hook: Iona needs help clearing the quay before the next ferry arrives.

concepts.name: Plip Reedstone
concepts.motive: Reach the submerged release without trapping the party on the wrong side.
concepts.hook: Plip knows where the grate leaves an opening into the release chamber.

concepts.name: Murra Stonewake
concepts.motive: Check whether the seep route opens into a safe vault.
concepts.hook: Murra found a narrow break in the submerged masonry.

concepts.name: Teren Mere
concepts.motive: Guide the stranded travelers to the upper landing.
concepts.hook: Teren has heard footsteps from below the dark stair.

concepts.name: Iskra Sablewing
concepts.motive: Light a safe landing for the party below the broken ladder.
concepts.hook: Iskra knows where the shaft opens wide enough for a clean descent.

concepts.name: Kes Hollowstep
concepts.motive: Find a disused portal before the occupants of the lower hall return.
concepts.hook: Kes can search for the portal while following the gallery wall in darkness.

concepts.name: Tarinel
concepts.role: Beacon sentry and footbow specialist with limited flight.
concepts.motive: Get both cliff beacons back in sight of each other before the pass closes.
concepts.hook: Tarinel can reach the far platform in a short powered bout if the party clears the lower perch.

concepts.name: Nessa Lowbranch
concepts.motive: Keep an herb garden accessible without letting visiting carts crush the old path.
concepts.hook: Nessa knows who first moved the trail markers. She'll name them if the visitors agree to inspect the alternate route.

concepts.name: Sethra Spoke
concepts.motive: Protect her retirement fund by collecting a late payment without putting a family out of its home.
concepts.hook: Sethra holds the witnessed signature on the guarantee but will wait if the players can provide collateral of equal worth.

concepts.name: Neris Vell
concepts.motive: Map the lower vault and bring her notes back intact.
concepts.hook: Neris marks the first doorway with charcoal so the party can find it from either side.

concepts.name: Serran Thale
concepts.motive: Move the refugees through two barricades before the gates close.
concepts.hook: Serran sends the party ahead to hold the inner doors.

concepts.name: Sella Cinderlock
concepts.motive: Reopen the floodgate without springing the trap.
concepts.hook: Sella has a copper marker for the crossing and can check the lock.

concepts.name: Qid Lowweb
concepts.motive: Find a way past the blocked gallery without alerting the guards.
concepts.hook: Qid spots a ledge above the sentries where her four blades can reach them.

concepts.name: Awa Spinner
concepts.motive: Keep the damaged gangway open until everyone reaches the near side.
concepts.hook: Awa can reach the damaged silk stays from the ceiling.

concepts.name: Verren Vale
concepts.motive: Hold the gate long enough for the workers to clear the passage.
concepts.hook: Verren needs someone to lead the last workers to the cross-passage.

concepts.name: Diamond Hand
concepts.motive: Cover the retreat of her hunt-bonded companion.
concepts.hook: Diamond Hand guards the bend that leads to the pack’s water cistern.

concepts.name: Lilli Seachild
concepts.motive: Keep the landing open for the boat coming out of the lower passage.
concepts.hook: Lilli has just recoated her shield and is holding the landing alone.

concepts.name: Rripp Siltwatch
concepts.motive: Find the moving intruder before it reaches the upper gate.
concepts.hook: Rripp gives the party a signal when the unseen swimmer passes the sluice.

concepts.name: Cold Water
concepts.motive: Find a missing climber before the culvert floods.
concepts.hook: Cold Water catches a fresh scent at the foot of the fissure.

concepts.name: Gorvak Ironcleft
concepts.motive: Keep the forge passage clear until the smiths reach shelter.
concepts.hook: Gorvak is holding the landing below a shuttered light shaft.

concepts.name: Maig Forgechant
concepts.motive: Get the workers out before the foundry gates close.
concepts.hook: Maig uses a drum signal to group workers at the side exit.

concepts.name: Tavira of the Sun Reed
concepts.motive: Settle a dispute over a toll before the two trading parties leave.
concepts.hook: Tavira can compare the disputed terms if the party brings the original tally tablet and a witness.

concepts.name: Rusk Chalkback
concepts.motive: Reach the high brace so the party can cross without losing the rope.
concepts.hook: Rusk points out a rough seam that leads past the broken ladder.

concepts.name: Borr Sootmane
concepts.motive: Keep the switchback clear until his companions reach the lower passage.
concepts.hook: Borr waits with his club where the shaft light stops at a bend.

concepts.name: Orrin Redwick
concepts.motive: Salvage the paper lanterns that were left under a leaking roof before the procession assembles.
concepts.hook: Orrin can repair the route lanterns if the party finds him somewhere dry to work.

concepts.name: Khar Ashridge
concepts.motive: Keep the gate clear until a work crew gets inside.
concepts.hook: Khar waits beside the brazier that lights the coal gate.

concepts.name: Varka Coalvein
concepts.motive: Signal the party once the escape route opens.
concepts.hook: Varka agrees to brighten a flame beside the safe passage.

concepts.name: Morrow
concepts.motive: Get the last visitors inside before their pursuer reaches the gate.
concepts.hook: Morrow can point the party toward the sheltered entrance while he watches the open gate.

concepts.name: Sethrik Chalkscale
concepts.motive: Get the group past the cistern before the lower passage fills.
concepts.hook: Sethrik can find the dry route where the stone wall meets the old grate.

concepts.name: Vess Siltcrest
concepts.motive: Keep the grate clear until the crew can latch it from the far side.
concepts.hook: Vess signals the party from the guard ledge above the grate.

concepts.name: Lumen
concepts.motive: Reach an injured surveyor on the cairn road.
concepts.hook: Lumen knows the line of cairns and can heal the surveyor once the party clears the path.

concepts.name: Dorr Palevein
concepts.motive: Bring the group through the covered crossing before the passage closes.
concepts.hook: Dorr knows where the old road reenters the rock below the exposed ridge.

concepts.name: Mira Chalkwick
concepts.motive: Get the records out of the gallery while the lower archives are still accessible.
concepts.hook: Mira is carrying a sealed bundle of passages she copied from old maps.

concepts.name: Pella Reedchime
concepts.motive: Resolve a dispute over damaged cargo before sunset strands both wagons at the bridge.
concepts.hook: Pella can keep the crossing open if the party helps count the damaged goods in front of both drivers.

concepts.name: Ilyth Voss
concepts.motive: Keep visitors away from the sealed record chamber.
concepts.hook: Ilyth offers a safe route out if the party returns the ledger intact.

concepts.name: Sael Nethrix
concepts.motive: Finish reading the seal before the chamber is closed again.
concepts.hook: Sael can translate the outer inscription in exchange for time to study it.

concepts.name: Keshar of the Dry Brook
concepts.motive: Get a village healer safely from the closing market to the overnight camp.
concepts.hook: Keshar will escort the healer if the party can keep the alternate gate open.

concepts.name: Skriv Ashstripe
concepts.motive: Get the party to a ledge above the blocked passage.
concepts.hook: Skriv knows which part of the wall has handholds for the climb.

concepts.name: Brak Greystripe
concepts.motive: Hold the bridge long enough for the last crew to cross.
concepts.hook: Brak signals from the bridge return when the far end is clear.

concepts.name: Glassweir Eshara
concepts.motive: Map the bypass gate before the weighmaster orders the chamber flooded.
concepts.hook: Eshara can open the bypass hatch if the party prevents the inspection winch from moving.

concepts.name: Latchwater Veyric
concepts.motive: Recover a missing rubbing of an inscribed threshold before the crew tries to clear it.
concepts.hook: Veyric can examine the rubbing from the far side of the threshold and tell the party which mark the crew covered.

concepts.name: Vaelis Ashthread
concepts.motive: Find a route across the gap before the checkpoint changes shift.
concepts.hook: Vaelis waits on the far side of the checkpoint in a human disguise.

concepts.name: Nyrel Duskmantle
concepts.motive: Get the message to the far side of the gate before it seals.
concepts.hook: Nyrel can cross the gate once the party confirms a clear landing.

concepts.name: Aven and Iven Threadwell
concepts.motive: Get separated travellers back to the right side of a road closure.
concepts.hook: Aven and Iven can cover both forks while the party checks the road for late travellers.

concepts.name: Mara and Sera Reedbank
concepts.role: Split floodgate wardens and Fighter pair.
concepts.motive: Keep two pin wheels turning until the maintenance crew is out of the channel.
concepts.hook: Mara and Sera can coordinate through the stone while the party watches the crossing.

concepts.name: Tavaro Sunmane
concepts.motive: Secure a rope across the gap before the water rises.
concepts.hook: Tavaro points out a flat approach to the far-side anchor.

concepts.name: Nasha Reedstep
concepts.motive: Keep the approach clear until the crew reaches the other bank.
concepts.hook: Nasha waits on the wider bank where there is room to turn.

concepts.name: Rellan Ropewalk
concepts.motive: Leave town with all the wages the shipowner promised his crew.
concepts.hook: Rellan is holding the manifest until a neutral party can compare it with the shipowner's advances book.

concepts.name: Sael Frostpinion
concepts.motive: Warn the lower outpost before a rockslide cuts off the pass.
concepts.hook: Sael asks the party to watch the narrow trail while he checks the ridge from above.

concepts.name: Iri Windward
concepts.role: Pass medic and Cleric of Shaundakul.
concepts.motive: Reach stranded porters before nightfall.
concepts.hook: Iri can see a place to land beside the porters if someone opens the shuttered terrace.

concepts.name: Miren Slatefold
concepts.motive: Repair the cracked axle before a wagon and its crew have to ford the river.
concepts.hook: Miren can replace the bearing blocks if the party carries them down from the old landing.

concepts.name: Nalin Flintwell
concepts.role: Quarry marker and Stonechild monster class 3.
concepts.motive: Determine why one boundary marker is out of line before the next shift begins.
concepts.hook: Nalin asks the party to follow the quarry line and check the stone that moved overnight.

concepts.name: Sova Hingehand
concepts.motive: Get stranded travelers across the pass before the next council vote ends their permit.
concepts.hook: Sova offers to escort the party as far as the old gate in exchange for making room for two injured riders.

concepts.name: Breka Flintvein
concepts.motive: Find a foothold at the mouth of a promising seam.
concepts.hook: Breka marks the route across the seam before walking into the stone.

concepts.name: Dorrin Slatebrace
concepts.motive: Reach a trapped work crew before its air runs out.
concepts.hook: Dorrin asks the party to hold the approach while he crosses to the broken fitting.

concepts.name: Bekra Gatepin
concepts.motive: Hold the gate open until the last ferry crosses, even though the officials have ordered it closed.
concepts.hook: Bekra can hear the ferry bell through the flood wall. She needs someone in the wheelhouse to tell her when to let go.

concepts.name: Sava of Rethma
concepts.motive: Shift the route away from an ice shelf that has started to break.
concepts.hook: Sava knows where the ridge takes a safe turn. She needs the party’s help moving the old waymarks before travelers follow them onto the shelf.

concepts.name: Gorren of Vekra
concepts.role: River salvage guide and Feral Gargun monster class 2.
concepts.motive: Retrieve a missing toll chest before the river rises over the ledge.
concepts.hook: Gorren can climb down to the chest while the party holds the raft at the pier.

concepts.name: Zareth Flintmere
concepts.motive: Get the cart across before the water covers the loose paving.
concepts.hook: Zareth waves the party toward the cart while he checks the narrow end of the causeway. Vessa can translate if needed.

concepts.name: Vessa Nettle
concepts.motive: Relay warnings without speaking in the passage.
concepts.hook: Vessa can interpret a warning from the keeper across the landing and show the party which stair is open.

concepts.name: Irsa Whitecurl
concepts.motive: Find a path that keeps the rescue party away from the unstable shelf.
concepts.hook: Irsa points to the tracks across the ice and asks the party to wait while she checks the crossing.

concepts.name: Merec Iceknot
concepts.motive: Keep the pass open while the last sled reaches camp.
concepts.hook: Merec asks for a second lookout after a rockfall exposes the flank of his post.

concepts.name: Dovar Sleetstep
concepts.motive: Recover the mule that carries the valley's winter letters before a rival guide is blamed for losing them.
concepts.hook: Dovar will backtrack as far as an avalanche scar. He needs another lookout to watch the slope while he follows the tracks.

concepts.name: Neressa
concepts.motive: Find why the boats can no longer draw safe water from the tidal basin.
concepts.hook: Neressa can test a sample and tend the sick while the party searches the intake.

concepts.name: Emmoran
concepts.motive: Open the jammed tide gate before the returning boats run out of time.
concepts.hook: Emmoran can reach the submerged catch if the party keeps the dry platform clear.

concepts.name: Kethan Linekeeper Varukutai
concepts.motive: Reopen the pass before sleet reaches the exposed shoulder.
concepts.hook: Kethan can rig a crossing if the party checks which downhill anchors survived the rockfall.

concepts.name: Rem
concepts.motive: Reconcile the two docket copies before the afternoon hearing.
concepts.hook: Rem can show the witness both appearances from the registry counter if the party brings the disputed copy.

concepts.name: Varek Ashveil
concepts.motive: Find out who opened the abandoned watchtower before his wing arrives.
concepts.hook: Varek calls down from a shuttered ledge and offers a warning about the stairwell.

concepts.name: Sira Duskmere
concepts.motive: Keep the lower access clear while the rookery evacuates.
concepts.hook: Sira asks for a signal when the last evacuee reaches the open ledge.

concepts.name: Serr
concepts.motive: Cover the opening scene while the crew locates a missing performer.
concepts.hook: Serr can take the missing performer’s place once the party retrieves the costume from the dressing rack.

concepts.name: Rova Stonecaller Athamavi
concepts.motive: Get the quarry crew into shelter before the next fall.
concepts.hook: Rova can lead the party to the shelter if they help account for the crew at the path marker.

concepts.name: Teva Alder
concepts.motive: Recover the names erased from a public register before its replacement is certified.
concepts.hook: Teva can retry a failed reading after a minute of quiet. The party needs to buy that time while the closing bell draws nearer.

concepts.name: Nima Reedbend
concepts.motive: Get the survey party back across the river before it rises.
concepts.hook: Nima asks the party to wait on the bank while she finds a crossing.

concepts.name: Perrin Mossline
concepts.motive: Find which bridge supports failed before the next supply run.
concepts.hook: Perrin shows the party a washed-out trail marker and points to the old crossing.

concepts.name: Seravakri
concepts.motive: Resolve a dispute about a signed warehouse delivery before the crates get moved again.
concepts.hook: Seravakri can speak telepathically with a willing witness while the party checks the warehouse ledger.

concepts.name: Tarenkhad
concepts.motive: Find which berth received the luggage a passenger cannot describe to the dock crew.
concepts.hook: Tarenkhad can link with the passenger if the party holds the berth and asks for their consent.

concepts.name: Orrik Flintnose
concepts.motive: Find out why the lift has stopped before sending anyone down.
concepts.hook: Orrik signals from the high gallery that a rope is missing from the shaft.

concepts.name: Tavra Slatecall
concepts.motive: Keep the lower passage open for the returning crew.
concepts.hook: Tavra waits by the shutter and asks for news from the older branch.

concepts.name: Corren Vale
concepts.role: Night courier escort and signal-lamp keeper.
concepts.motive: Get the courier and sealed testimony across the causeway before the morning hearing.
concepts.hook: Corren will walk the full night if someone can carry the lamp signal across a stretch of road where the old markers are gone.

concepts.name: Iona Fernridge
concepts.motive: Locate a missing pack train before its tracks wash away.
concepts.hook: Iona can follow a familiar scent across bare stone if the party identifies the right bundle of gear.

concepts.name: Isette Mossglass
concepts.motive: Reach two workers who failed to return from a sluice inspection.
concepts.hook: Isette asks the party to hold a line from the dry side while she goes down the steps.

concepts.name: Maura Stonewick
concepts.role: Wayhouse keeper and Cleric of Luthic.
concepts.motive: Keep the shelter open until the night travelers arrive.
concepts.hook: Maura asks for help carrying an injured porter out of the rain.

concepts.name: Keshen Trailmark
concepts.motive: Find a missing pack animal before it reaches the ravine.
concepts.hook: Keshen asks the party to wait while he checks where the trail goes upwind.

concepts.name: Joren Cindervein
concepts.role: Ember road warden and Heart Paladin.
concepts.motive: Get refugees past the dragon’s tribute collectors.
concepts.hook: Joren can scout the next turn if the party keeps the wagon moving.

concepts.name: Orra Slatefall
concepts.role: Ravine rope guard and Wings Fighter.
concepts.motive: Restore the torn rope crossing before the last travellers arrive.
concepts.hook: Orra can bring a light messenger line down from the high ledge while the party carries the heavier rope.

concepts.name: Meren Thistlekey
concepts.motive: Keep the waiting families together until the missing wagons come in.
concepts.hook: Meren knows the last driver to use the road and offers to check the passenger roll with the party.

concepts.name: Dane Millward
concepts.motive: Get the repairers through a warped mill gate before it gives way.
concepts.hook: Dane can keep watch at the opening if the party helps secure the worn latch.

concepts.name: Yekka Reedbank
concepts.motive: Keep a safe crossing open after a merchant starts paying riders to cut the mooring ropes.
concepts.hook: Yekka will mark every crossing the riders use if the party takes the dawn watch.

concepts.name: Swage
concepts.motive: Replace a worn lift hinge and repair the attendant before the next shift.
concepts.hook: Swage can get the lift working if the party retrieves the old hinge from the inspection cage.

concepts.name: Kesra Tarn
concepts.motive: Get two apprentices out before the warehouse is sealed.
concepts.hook: Kesra can check the roof hatch and get the party inside while the loading doors are watched.

concepts.name: Bren Carrow
concepts.motive: Find the shipment loaded under another family’s seal.
concepts.hook: Bren can walk the party through the manifest, then help Kesra check the warehouse.

concepts.name: Lysa Vale
concepts.motive: Keep the ferry at the landing until a missing child comes back.
concepts.hook: Lysa can keep the ramp open while the party checks the path home.

concepts.name: Rena Marr
concepts.motive: Keep the crossing open long enough for the night shift to get away.
concepts.hook: Rena knows when the sluice gate closes and can hold the causeway while the party leads people off it.

concepts.name: Keel
concepts.motive: Hold the flooded drain gate open long enough to get the maintenance crew out.
concepts.hook: Keel can hold the gate below the waterline while the party leads the crew to the landing.

concepts.name: Pell Fenwick
concepts.motive: Retrieve a misdelivered letter before the porter locks up.
concepts.hook: Pell can scout as a cat and get the tack-room door open if the party watches the mews.

concepts.name: Rusk Brindle
concepts.motive: Find out what is moving between the sacks after the shop closes.
concepts.hook: Rusk will check the dark loft while the party keeps watch on the storekeeper.

concepts.name: Edris Tallowmark
concepts.motive: Find who reused an obsolete guild stamp before the apprentice who discovered it is dismissed.
concepts.hook: Edris can match the stamp to one of three old molds once the party gets access to the sealed warehouse.

concepts.name: Iriavel Solthenar
concepts.motive: Carry a line past the snapped ropeway anchor before the next storm.
concepts.hook: Iriavel can cross the broken span and set a guide rope if the party braces the anchor.

concepts.name: Corven Ashstep
concepts.motive: Get the last climbers off a cracked landing.
concepts.hook: Corven asks the party to lead the climbers down while he keeps the stair clear.

concepts.name: Rivet
concepts.motive: Get a new guide chain down to the stranded hoist platform.
concepts.hook: Rivet can descend with a line while the party controls the hoist brake above.

concepts.name: Tongs
concepts.motive: Get the porters across before the gantry is closed.
concepts.hook: Tongs can flash readiness across the gantry and hold the approach while the party moves the last porters.

concepts.name: Sera Flintward
concepts.motive: Keep the lockgate clear until the crew can reach the jammed chain.
concepts.hook: Sera can hold the gate and tell the party how to reach the chain from the bank.

concepts.name: Darevia Thalliar
concepts.motive: Find a delayed family before the forest corridor closes for the night.
concepts.hook: Darevia can lead the party between clearings and hold the corridor long enough for the family to cross.

concepts.name: Vara Flintshore
concepts.motive: Bring a pilot off a tidal shelf before the channel fills.
concepts.hook: Vara can carry a depth line to the pilot if the party secures it on shore.

concepts.name: Toren Glasswake
concepts.role: Drydock shipwright and hull repair lead.
concepts.motive: Lift a grounded vessel enough to inspect the keel without collapsing the bracing.
concepts.hook: Toren can identify the replacement timber and needs someone to hold the brace while it seats.

concepts.name: Nera Softchime
concepts.motive: Prove someone is sending false warnings to reroute trade away from the hill road.
concepts.hook: Nera offers the party the unlit tower room as a lookout. She wants the culprit identified before anyone cuts the bell rope.

concepts.name: Vessa Hallow
concepts.motive: Find out who has been intercepting replies on the gallery route.
concepts.hook: The courier asks you to return a letter using the upstairs exit. Their face looks familiar, but their coat clasp is the wrong color.

concepts.name: Kareth Venn
concepts.motive: Reach the far bank without losing sight of the party.
concepts.hook: Kareth has a route over the gap if someone trusts her to get them to the other side.

concepts.name: Rasha Longstride
concepts.role: Outrider who switches from archery to a charge.
concepts.motive: Check the boundary trail before the pack comes through.
concepts.hook: Rasha finds a broken trail marker and offers to trade what she knows for news of the next ridge.

concepts.name: Nik Coppernotch
concepts.motive: Get the party around a tunnel trip plate and into the open.
concepts.hook: Nik fits a wedge to the edge of the plate and asks the party to watch for movement above.

concepts.name: Brasswake
concepts.motive: Keep the gate open until the last travelers are through.
concepts.hook: Brasswake plants their shield in the doorway and calls for the party to move first.

concepts.name: Selian Dawnledger
concepts.motive: Settle the dispute before the wardens close the archive.
concepts.hook: Selian remembers the seal from a former life and asks to see the original charter.

concepts.name: Reth Quietmere
concepts.motive: Keep both sides of the border from blaming each other for the broken gate.
concepts.hook: Reth asks visitors to cross the threshold one at a time and offers to carry their guide’s lantern.

concepts.name: Brann Lowvault
concepts.motive: Keep the escape stair clear while the last miners get out.
concepts.hook: Brann holds the short ramp until he can see every member of the returning crew.

concepts.name: Nura Glasswake
concepts.motive: Map the unstable gaps before another traveler goes missing.
concepts.hook: Nura offers to test an unstable doorway in exchange for a witness describing exactly what they see.

concepts.name: Briar Reedfoot
concepts.motive: Keep the newly cleared trail open without drawing visitors through a nesting ground.
concepts.hook: Briar moves a snapped bough aside and asks which footprints the party followed.

concepts.name: Avarra Coalwake
concepts.motive: Keep onlookers clear while the forge crew shutters a ruptured flue.
concepts.hook: Avarra draws a longsword and points the crew toward the safer door.

concepts.name: Sena Varan
concepts.motive: Talk an ally out of entering a dangerous shared dream.
concepts.hook: Sena communicates a warning telepathically before she speaks out loud.

concepts.name: Daro Stonehand
concepts.motive: Hold a choke point while the caravan gets its animals clear.
concepts.hook: Daro plants his shield at the narrowest part of the route and asks for an opening signal.

concepts.name: K’tcha
concepts.motive: Guide the clutch across a break in the trail before the wind erases the route.
concepts.hook: K’tcha points out a gap in the rock and demonstrates the jump with a quick bound.

concepts.name: Varik Ashsteel
concepts.motive: Clear the gate mouth so the porters can move their carts through.
concepts.hook: Varik calls the porters behind him and looks for space to clear the opening.

concepts.name: Ilyra Keene
concepts.motive: Keep the apprentices out of a fight over a shield they repaired.
concepts.hook: Ilyra asks for a name before she opens the workshop door.

concepts.name: Aurin Vell
concepts.motive: Bring two frightened witnesses to the hearing.
concepts.hook: Aurin offers to accompany the party through the unlit gallery.

concepts.name: Basalt Wren
concepts.motive: Get a trapped cart off a broken loading ramp.
concepts.hook: Basalt waits for someone to clear the ramp before he breaks the gate fittings.

concepts.name: Sive
concepts.motive: Find a missing apprentice before their mirror route closes.
concepts.hook: Sive appears in the standing mirror and asks who last saw the apprentice.

concepts.name: Myrine Ashrein
concepts.motive: Get the families across the open road before the storm reaches them.
concepts.hook: Myrine offers to draw attention down the broad trail while the party escorts the wagons.

concepts.name: Brother Brindle
concepts.motive: Find the missing travelers before night closes over the ford.
concepts.hook: A hound follows the party to the milepost and then stands upright to ask whom they are looking for.

concepts.name: Nura bint Sahl
concepts.motive: Recover the apprentices stranded on the Plane of Air before their guide's endurance expires.
concepts.hook: Nura can take the party across if everyone keeps the chain of hands intact.

concepts.name: Vesh Reedcurrent
concepts.role: Channel warden and submerged rescue guide.
concepts.motive: Free the snagged ferry rope before the pull of the current tears out the bracket.
concepts.hook: Vesh offers to reach the rope from underwater while someone watches the ferry's drift.

concepts.name: Bren Hazelwing
concepts.motive: Move the summons across the valley without sending the patrol after its bearer.
concepts.hook: Bren reveals blue thread tied to a gate latch and asks the party to follow it after the patrol passes.

concepts.name: Halla Duskbark
concepts.motive: Keep a party of lost travelers together through a moonless passage.
concepts.hook: She offers to inspect a loose waystone if somebody keeps the travelers within reach of her shield.

concepts.name: Rell Ashgate
concepts.motive: Get the last passenger across before someone cuts the ferry rope.
concepts.hook: Rell wants the crossing kept open. He offers to go below the water to retrieve a slipped mooring.

concepts.name: Copperflash
concepts.motive: Deliver a sealed reply before the sender has to call off a duel.
concepts.hook: He asks the party to walk the letter through the main door while he draws attention into the courtyard.

concepts.name: Minnet Branchbell
concepts.motive: Prevent a frightened crossing party from turning a meeting into a fight.
concepts.hook: Minnet asks the closest traveler by telepathy to lower their weapon and wait for an answer.

concepts.name: Merrin Netward
concepts.motive: Get two rival crews to honor a shared right of passage.
concepts.hook: Merrin has each crew’s witness mark and wants a third party to hear both accounts before the gate opens.

concepts.name: Elian Voss
concepts.role: Investigates witnesses who vanish between planes.
concepts.motive: Identify what is unsettling the boundary beneath an abandoned wayhouse.
concepts.hook: Elian asks the party to stand by his departure point while he checks whether the wayhouse has an Ethereal reflection.

concepts.name: Vela Stonewake
concepts.role: Maps ruins and listens for clues in nearby dreams.
concepts.motive: Compare a dream of a sealed passage with the actual layout.
concepts.hook: Vela asks for a watch while she sleeps within range of the missing survey team.

concepts.name: Teral Brineford
concepts.role: Guides crossings and keeps attackers away from the boats.
concepts.motive: Find the shoal animal that witnessed a missing boat’s passage.
concepts.hook: Teral asks the party to moor while he questions an animal and checks beneath the boats.

concepts.name: Marel Broadbank
concepts.role: Steers tense negotiations and discovers one relevant secret.
concepts.motive: Learn why the ferrymen stopped honoring a trade agreement.
concepts.hook: Marel asks the party to stage a calm first meeting before the ferrymen choose sides.

concepts.name: Pip Cinderbutton
concepts.role: Carries messages where disease or crowds stop other runners.
concepts.motive: Get medicine and patients through a blocked infirmary entrance.
concepts.hook: Pip asks the party to clear a second exit while they slip through the press to check the wards.

concepts.name: Miren Inkquill
concepts.motive: Recover a missing collection ledger.
concepts.hook: Miren offers to identify the object if the party helps recover her ledger.

concepts.name: Edda Brackenrow
concepts.motive: Find what damaged the orchard path.
concepts.hook: Edda asks the bent roots what crossed the path that morning.

concepts.name: Tavi Ashdown
concepts.motive: Keep the shelter open to both sides of a local dispute.
concepts.hook: Tavi waves the party inside while a disagreement builds at the shelter door.

concepts.name: Senn Reedwing
concepts.motive: Keep travelers from stepping onto a damaged span.
concepts.hook: Senn calls down a warning just before the path gives way.

concepts.name: Orla Barkmantle
concepts.motive: Hold the bridge until the last evacuee crosses.
concepts.hook: Orla waves the party through as the bridge starts to shake.

concepts.name: Bracken Mossbell
concepts.motive: Flag a dry crossing before the supply cart reaches the flooded ford.
concepts.hook: Bracken needs someone to hold the survey line while she jumps the washout.

concepts.name: Hollis Shadebuck
concepts.motive: Keep the washed-out bridge clear until rope crews can reach the far side.
concepts.hook: Hollis asks the party to move away from the bridge mouth, leaving him room to drive a hostile creature back.

concepts.name: Rowan Burrowfinch
concepts.motive: Send a message to both camps before a quarrel reaches the village.
concepts.hook: Rowan asks a beetle which camp crossed the garden wall, then offers to pass on what it saw.

concepts.name: Tansy Pipwake
concepts.motive: Get the guild ledger over the old ropeway before the lower trail closes.
concepts.hook: Tansy points to a shorter crossing and asks who will tie off the line after she jumps.

concepts.name: Kestrel Pinshank
concepts.motive: Restart the lift before its last passengers run out of drinking water.
concepts.hook: Kestrel can brace the stalled pulley with a temporary tool, but needs someone to keep the cargo platform steady.

concepts.name: Lark Ashplume
concepts.motive: Recover a route contract taken during a dispute over the road toll.
concepts.hook: Lark makes the case for releasing the courier while quietly preparing an escape route.

concepts.name: Varesh Cinderkeel
concepts.motive: Keep the passage open until the lost patrol returns.
concepts.hook: Varesh points regular traffic to the long approach so he can watch the culvert.

concepts.name: Brasswell
concepts.motive: Recover a set of copied keys before the next public shift.
concepts.hook: Brasswell knows which door could have been opened from inside.

concepts.name: Tam Mossdial
concepts.role: Courier skilled at disengaging after a hit.
concepts.motive: Get a message through the blockade without exposing the sender.
concepts.hook: Tam asks the party to watch the gate while he takes the narrow route.

concepts.name: Mira Glassbeck
concepts.role: Spellborn wizard who crosses guarded compartments.
concepts.motive: Trace an electrical fault back to its source.
concepts.hook: Mira needs someone to mark the return route in complete darkness.

concepts.speciesPublication: Tales of the Valiant Player's Guide 2 Preview
concepts.name: Tavi Reedcap
concepts.motive: Keep an upstream signal lit when the current rises.
concepts.hook: Tavi surfaces below the ferry and describes a figure pacing the shaded bank.

concepts.name: Lysa Fenwick
concepts.role: Seam scout with a throwing scarab.
concepts.motive: Get a survey map out before the lower tunnels are locked.
concepts.hook: Lysa grips the case and asks which way the party came in. A blue scarab shifts on the back of her hand.

concepts.name: Deren Valehart
concepts.role: Hatch guard with a crawling gauntlet.
concepts.motive: Keep unscheduled visitors away from the sealed lower gallery.
concepts.hook: Deren taps his chitinous fingers on the hatch and asks the party who sent them.

concepts.name: Sera Veld
concepts.role: Passage scout who screens an evacuation.
concepts.motive: Keep the underground ferry path open while the last families cross.
concepts.hook: Sera offers a hidden route through the toll gate if the party helps the families board.

concepts.name: Rusk Sedge
concepts.role: Ambush fighter who guards a ferry winch.
concepts.motive: Recover a missing ferry bell whose signal keeps the night crossing safe.
concepts.hook: Rusk has found the bell rope tied to a skiff and asks for help watching who returns for it.

concepts.name: Varek Fordwatch
concepts.role: Shield officer at a contested bridge.
concepts.motive: Get the bridge crew out before a private patrol tears down the span.
concepts.hook: Varek hands the party a saw marked with the patrol’s seal and asks them to escort the bridge crew.

concepts.name: Tovin Reedwhistle
concepts.role: Wizard who lays false trails and guides retreats.
concepts.motive: Lead the last survey crew past the guards without revealing its route.
concepts.hook: Tovin asks the party to follow the chalk reed signs while he sends the guard toward a false signal.

concepts.name: Marren Sill
concepts.motive: Recover the forged signal order before the beacon is lit.
concepts.hook: He can slip past the keeper if someone gives her a reason to leave the lantern door ajar.

concepts.name: Orla Kest
concepts.motive: Deliver a witness safely to the magistrate.
concepts.hook: Orla spots a false exit guard and asks the party to walk the witness through as if the guard belongs there.

concepts.name: Iser Mott
concepts.motive: Get a sealed dispatch to the next courier before the stair is cut off.
concepts.hook: The dispatch pouch contains two seals. Iser asks a character to take the one with their own name scratched into it.

concepts.name: Tavia Burr
concepts.motive: Keep wheel ruts away from the buried roots without closing the route to travelers.
concepts.hook: She offers to guide the party through the grove if they can persuade the carter to unhitch.

concepts.name: Nesha Flint
concepts.motive: Free a jammed gate before the patrol makes its next circuit.
concepts.hook: She can see a safe landing beyond the grate but needs the party to tell her which counterweight to release.

concepts.name: Tess Reedknot
concepts.motive: Reopen a blocked side channel before floodwater reaches the pens.
concepts.hook: Tess finds a torn rope down in the sluice and asks who cut it while the current was low.

concepts.name: Ilyra Serein
concepts.motive: Deliver a warning before the mountain winds turn.
concepts.hook: Ilyra can fly the dispatch to the next ridge, but asks the party to retrieve the lantern marking her landing site.

concepts.name: Sarruk Reedhorn
concepts.role: Short-haul escort and Defender of Idu
concepts.motive: Bring an injured traveler over the ravine.
concepts.hook: Sarruk asks for a guide rope across the last ledge before lifting his passenger.

concepts.name: Vorr Deepwake
concepts.motive: Keep strangers from blundering into the deep current or disturbing the fish traps.
concepts.hook: Vorr gestures to a stake below the waterline and offers safe crossing in exchange for a warning if an unfamiliar boat appears.

concepts.name: Tamar of Um-Shedu
concepts.motive: Account for everyone sheltering behind the gate before dusk.
concepts.hook: Tamar’s gate ledger has one more name than the people inside. The signature is still wet.

concepts.name: Makurí
concepts.motive: Find a route that bypasses a split rope bridge before the next rain.
concepts.hook: Makurí can glide across the gap with a line once the party clears the far landing.

concepts.name: Zesk Reedmark
concepts.motive: Keep the night ferry open while displaced families come downriver.
concepts.hook: Zesk found a safe ford and needs one person to carry its marker line back.

concepts.name: Werrami
concepts.motive: Walk a missing survey crew back to water before the afternoon heat.
concepts.hook: Werrami reads the crew’s tracks and offers to scout the gully ahead.

concepts.name: Célan Merle
concepts.speciesPublication: Savage Coast Campaign Book, Part 2: Player Characters
concepts.motive: Find the partner who was supposed to meet him at the tollhouse.
concepts.hook: Célan recognizes her scent halfway down the bridge, where the trail abruptly disappears.

concepts.name: Sava Flintstep
concepts.speciesPublication: Savage Coast Campaign Book, Part 2: Player Characters
concepts.motive: Keep a delivery cart out of the hands of a rival patrol.
concepts.hook: Sava offers to lure the patrol along a ledge while the party takes the cart below.

concepts.name: Vaethilalora (Vael)
concepts.motive: Get a missing charcoal crew home before the stream rises.
concepts.hook: A new flight of iron rungs leads through a locked hatch. Vael knows an exposed route around the hillside and asks the party to check the hatch.

concepts.name: Oolay
concepts.motive: Deliver a corrected sluice schedule before the culvert fills.
concepts.hook: Oolay has two working routes to the far bank. The shorter passes through sand and the longer crosses a bridge watched by the forgery’s author.

concepts.name: Hushush
concepts.motive: Bring the salt traders back through a pass before their lantern oil runs out.
concepts.hook: Hushush finds the traders’ tracks beside two fresh trails. One is their own route in reverse, although they swear they never turned around.

concepts.name: Lampnote
concepts.motive: Find the source of an extra bell note that sounds only when the gate is locked.
concepts.hook: The checkpoint clerk recorded an extra crossing after the last lantern went dark. Lampnote asks the party to repeat the route under observation.

concepts.name: Split-Tusk
concepts.motive: Hold the loading gate until the last dockhand is accounted for.
concepts.hook: A lamp smashed against the gate has left a burning spill between Split-Tusk and the alarm bell. The carts behind him are still loaded.

concepts.name: Sivi Amberwing
concepts.motive: Find a way across a broken trail before the pack animals arrive.
concepts.hook: Sivi signals from the top of a waypost and asks the party to watch where she lands.

concepts.name: Narel Claywind
concepts.motive: Get a cart of clay water jars through the pass before dawn.
concepts.hook: Narel offers passage with the caravan in exchange for help bringing one late cart in from the salt flats.

concepts.name: Vey Tern
concepts.motive: Keep travelers moving while the upper passage is closed.
concepts.hook: Vey opens a hatch above a lower landing and asks who can carry the checkpoint lantern on the way down.

concepts.name: Kesh Reedroot
concepts.motive: Keep a narrow crossing open long enough for the last travelers to pass.
concepts.hook: Kesh waves the party through the crossing and asks someone to warn the next sentry that the road behind them has closed.

concepts.name: Vesk Nhal
concepts.motive: Find a route for a missing survey crew to reach its camp before the gates close.
concepts.hook: Vesk has marked a door that disappeared at dusk. He needs someone to hold the last ordinary passage open while he finds it again.

concepts.name: Tara Embercoil
concepts.motive: Rescue a dockhand held on a moored barge.
concepts.hook: Tara can reach the barge from the water if someone draws the sentry away from the mooring.

concepts.name: Nerin Alderfold
concepts.motive: Find a route around a flooded section of tunnel before the overnight market lets out.
concepts.hook: Nerin recognizes fresh morel tracks beyond a blocked side passage. They need help moving a waterlogged beam to follow them.

concepts.name: Tess Serein
concepts.role: Shapechanging scout who can pin a pursuer at a crossing.
concepts.motive: Find the missing bridge warden before the night shift closes the span.
concepts.hook: Tess offers to check the underside of the bridge while the party questions the toll collectors.

concepts.name: Marda Flintknuckle
concepts.motive: Keep a ferry crew from hauling away the one chain that still secures the landing.
concepts.hook: Marda has tied the ferry up herself and demands to see the deed before letting the buyer aboard.

concepts.name: Nark Bluefur
concepts.role: Roadside patrol hunter who changes between wolf and goblin.
concepts.motive: Find the courier who sold his patrol route to the toll gang.
concepts.hook: A goblin pays the party for news at the inn. The same voice calls to them from the ditch after dark.

concepts.name: Safa Crosswind
concepts.role: Airborne guide who clears a landing.
concepts.motive: Keep a cliffside rescue route open until the last porter crosses.
concepts.hook: Safa gives the party a head count by telepathy while watching the cliff from above.

concepts.name: Orel Slate
concepts.role: Sentry who watches a gallery from the wall and casts web across its approaches.
concepts.motive: Keep looters away from the half-collapsed gallery until two trapped workers get out.
concepts.hook: A voice above the gallery tells the party where they can safely put their feet.

concepts.name: Kesh Brassmark
concepts.motive: Find out who has diverted the forge fuel before he signs the next delivery.
concepts.hook: Kesh asks the party to count the stamped casks while he checks the loading roster.

concepts.name: Sava Coil
concepts.motive: Stop a runner from taking the foundry’s cooling valve across the service bridge.
concepts.hook: Sava asks the party to check the valve crate while he holds the bridge.

concepts.name: Tov Flintarm
concepts.motive: Recover a stolen wage pouch without getting the quarry workers involved.
concepts.hook: Tov shows the party three sets of tracks and asks which are freshest.

concepts.name: Fenn Burr
concepts.motive: Clear a narrow path for the animals crossing the trail at dusk.
concepts.hook: Fenn offers to lead the party around the crossing if they can keep the other travelers quiet.

concepts.name: Ryn Reedcall
concepts.motive: Keep scavengers away from the trail until a stranded scout can descend.
concepts.hook: Ryn circles low and calls for the party to steady the scout’s rope.

concepts.name: Veyl Handlink
concepts.role: Guard of a tollgate built into a stairwell.
concepts.motive: Collect a debt from a smuggler before the gaoler checks his ledger.
concepts.hook: Veyl offers the party a key in exchange for the name beside a scratched-out tally.

concepts.name: Sereva Lowstring
concepts.role: Aerial gatekeeper of a footbridge across a gorge.
concepts.motive: Keep a repair crew safe until it can lower the crossing ropes.
concepts.hook: Sereva asks the party to look for a missing apprentice on the far bank.

concepts.name: Mereth Flintmark
concepts.role: Keeper of a shuttered stone quarry.
concepts.motive: Keep the quarryhands from taking the blame for a statue they found underground.
concepts.hook: Mereth offers to show the party the stone dust on the statue’s boots if they agree to meet behind a screen.

concepts.name: Tivin Reed
concepts.role: Ford negotiator who can guide travelers beneath the current.
concepts.motive: Stop a ferryman’s new anchor from tearing an eggbed loose.
concepts.hook: Tivin offers a dry sack for the party’s gear and asks them to lift the anchor from below.

concepts.name: Alda Slackwater
concepts.role: Shore ambusher who scavenges marked stones from wrecks.
concepts.motive: Get back a ballast stone before the tide takes it inland.
concepts.hook: Alda calls from under the quay and offers to trade a stolen locket for the stone.

concepts.name: Rusk
concepts.motive: Keep the quarry crew out of the abandoned haulage tunnel.
concepts.hook: Rusk taps a warning through the floor, then rises between the crew and the tunnel mouth.

concepts.name: Skirl
concepts.role: Whirlwind controller and cliff beacon tender.
concepts.motive: Keep climbers off a landing where the stone anchors are about to fail.
concepts.hook: Skirl rattles the beacon lanyard three times when the party approaches the wrong ledge.

concepts.name: Tack
concepts.motive: Find the clerk responsible for opening sealed appeals before the hearing.
concepts.hook: The same raven appears outside three shuttered offices. Its footprints lead away from none of them.

concepts.name: Varek Silt
concepts.motive: Recover a manifest before a public hearing links him to the missing cargo.
concepts.hook: Varek arrives as the harbor clerk and offers a sketch of the missing hold. The hold in the sketch was never on the ship.

concepts.name: Sethren Roofglass
concepts.motive: Get the tenants out of a building whose lightning ward was damaged during construction.
concepts.hook: Sethren needs the party to clear the stairs while he grounds the ward. The owner is still insisting the building can stay open.
